q: Which layer of the medallion architecture is most commonly used by data analysts?
opts: Dashboards
Gold
Bronze
Silver
q_zh: 数据分析师最常使用的是奖章架构（Medallion Architecture）的哪一层？
exp_zh: Gold（金）层包含高度聚合、面向业务的结构化数据，专为报告和仪表板查询而优化。数据分析师日常工作主要在 Gold 层进行，因为该层数据已经过清洗、去重和业务规则转换，可以直接用于 BI 报表和决策分析。

q:
A data analyst has recently joined a new team that uses Databricks SQL, but the analyst has never used Databricks before. The analyst wants to know where in Databricks SQL they can write and execute SQL queries.
Where can the analyst write and execute SQL queries?
opts: Data page
Dashboards page
Queries page
SQL Editor page
q_zh: 一位数据分析师刚加入一个使用 Databricks SQL 的新团队，但从未使用过 Databricks。分析师想知道在 Databricks SQL 中可以在哪里编写和执行 SQL 查询？
exp_zh: SQL Editor 页面是 Databricks SQL 中专门用于编写、运行和保存 SQL 查询的工作区。它提供语法高亮、自动补全、查询历史等功能，是数据分析师日常查询的主要入口。

q: How should Databricks SQL be used in relation to other business intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau, Power BI, and Looker?
opts: As a complementary tool for quick in-platform BI work
As a complete replacement with additional functionality
As an exact substitute with the same level of functionality
As a complementary tool for professional-grade presentations
q_zh: Databricks SQL 与其他商业智能工具（如 Tableau、Power BI 和 Looker）应如何搭配使用？
exp_zh: Databricks SQL 通常作为这些 BI 工具的补充，用于在平台内快速进行即席分析和可视化。当需要专业级的演示和高级交互式仪表板时，仍然会使用专业 BI 工具，而 Databricks SQL 适合做轻量级的探索性分析。

q: Which approach should be used to connect Databricks to Fivetran for data ingestion?
opts: Use Delta Live Tables to establish a cluster for Fivetran to interact with.
Use Workflows to establish a SQL warehouse (formerly known as a SQL endpoint) for Fivetran to interact with.
Use Partner Connect’s automated workflow to establish a SQL warehouse (formerly known as a SQL endpoint) for Fivetran to interact with.
Use Partner Connect's automated workflow to establish a cluster for Fivetran to interact with.
q_zh: 应该使用哪种方法将 Databricks 连接到 Fivetran 以进行数据摄取？
exp_zh: Partner Connect 提供了自动化工作流，可以为 Fivetran 建立集群连接。通过 Partner Connect，用户无需手动配置即可快速完成 Databricks 与 Fivetran 之间的集成，大大简化了数据摄取管道的搭建。

q:
Data professionals with varying titles use the Databricks SQL service as the primary touchpoint with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform. However, some users will use other services like Databricks Machine Learning or Databricks Data Science and Engineering.
Which role uses Databricks SQL as a secondary service while primarily using one of the other services?
opts: Data engineer
Data analyst
Business analyst
Business intelligence analyst
q_zh: 不同职位的数据专业人员将 Databricks SQL 服务作为与 Databricks Lakehouse 平台的主要接触点。但某些用户会使用其他服务。哪个角色将 Databricks SQL 作为次要服务，而主要使用其他服务？
exp_zh: 数据工程师的主要工作是使用 Databricks Data Science and Engineering 来构建数据管道和 ETL 流程，但偶尔也需要通过 Databricks SQL 进行数据查询和验证。因此 Databricks SQL 对数据工程师来说是次要服务。

q:
A data analyst has set up a SQL query to run every four hours on a SQL endpoint, but the SQL endpoint is taking too long to start up with each run.
Which change can the data analyst make to reduce the start-up time for the endpoint while managing costs?
opts: Reduce the SQL endpoint cluster size
Increase the SQL endpoint cluster size
Turn off the Auto stop feature
Use a Serverless SQL endpoint
q_zh: 一位数据分析师设置了一个每四小时在 SQL 端点上运行的 SQL 查询，但端点每次启动耗时过长。在管理成本的同时，分析师可以做什么来缩短端点启动时间？
exp_zh: Serverless SQL 端点可以消除冷启动延迟，计算资源几乎即时可用。相比传统端点需要等待集群启动，Serverless 模式按需分配资源，既降低了启动时间，又通过按使用量计费来控制成本。

q:
A data engineering team has created a Structured Streaming pipeline that processes data in micro-batches and populates gold-level tables. The microbatches are triggered every minute.
A data analyst has created a dashboard based on this gold-level data. The project stakeholders want to see the results in the dashboard updated within one minute or less of new data becoming available within the gold-level tables.
What cautions should the data analyst share prior to setting up the dashboard to complete this task?
opts: The required compute resources could be costly.
The gold-level tables are not appropriately clean for business reporting.
The streaming data is not an appropriate data source for a dashboard.
The dashboard cannot be refreshed that quickly.
q_zh: 数据工程团队创建了一个以微批处理方式处理数据的 Structured Streaming 管道，每分钟触发一次微批，并填充 Gold 层表。数据分析师基于 Gold 层数据创建了仪表板。利益相关者希望仪表板在新数据可用后一分钟内更新。分析师应提出什么注意事项？
exp_zh: 如此高频率地刷新仪表板需要始终保持计算资源运行（如 always-on 的 SQL Warehouse），这会产生很高的计算成本。分析师应提前告知利益相关者，实时或近实时刷新虽然技术上可行，但所需计算资源的开销可能远超预期。

q: Which approach should be used to ingest data directly from cloud-based object storage?
opts: Create an external table while specifying the DBFS storage path to FROM.
Create an external table while specifying the object storage path to FROM.
Create an external table while specifying the DBFS storage path to PATH.
Create an external table while specifying the object storage path to LOCATION.
q_zh: 应使用哪种方式直接从基于云的对象存储中摄取数据？
exp_zh: 创建外部表时，应使用 LOCATION 关键字指定对象存储的路径（如 S3、ADLS、GCS）。这样 Databricks 可以直接读取云存储中的数据文件，而无需先复制到 DBFS 中。

q:
A data analyst wants to create a dashboard with three main sections: Development, Testing, and Production. The data analyst wants all three sections on the same dashboard, but wants to clearly designate the sections using text on the dashboard.
Which tool can the data analyst use to designate the Development, Testing, and Production sections using text?
opts: Separate endpoints for each section
Separate queries for each section
Markdown-based text boxes
Direct text written into the dashboard in editing mode
q_zh: 一位数据分析师想创建一个包含开发、测试和生产三个主要部分的仪表板，并希望在同一仪表板中使用文本清楚标注这些部分。分析师可以使用哪种工具？
exp_zh: Databricks SQL 仪表板支持 Markdown 文本框，可以用来在仪表板中添加标题、说明等文本内容，从而清楚地划分不同的区域。这种方式灵活且无需创建多个独立仪表板。

q:
A data analyst needs to use the Databricks Lakehouse Platform to quickly create SQL queries and data visualizations. It is a requirement that the compute resources in the platform can be made serverless, and it is expected that data visualizations can be placed within a dashboard.
Which Databricks Lakehouse Platform service/capability meets all of these requirements?
opts: Tableau
Delta Lake
Databricks Notebooks
Databricks SQL
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要使用 Databricks Lakehouse 平台快速创建 SQL 查询和数据可视化，要求计算资源支持 Serverless，且可视化可以放置在仪表板中。哪个服务满足所有这些要求？
exp_zh: Databricks SQL 提供了完整的 SQL 查询环境、内置可视化功能、仪表板支持，并且支持 Serverless SQL Warehouse。它是满足快速查询、可视化和 Serverless 需求的一体化解决方案。

q:
A data analyst is attempting to drop a table my_table. The analyst wants to delete all table metadata and data.
They run the following command:
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS my_table;
While the object no longer appears when they run SHOW TABLES, the data files still exist. What describes why the data files still exist and the metadata files were deleted?
opts: The table was managed.
The table did not have a location.
The table was external.
The table's data was smaller than 10 GB.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师尝试删除表 my_table，希望删除所有表元数据和数据。执行 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS my_table; 后，对象在 SHOW TABLES 中不再出现，但数据文件仍然存在。为什么？
exp_zh: 该表是外部表（External Table）。对于外部表，DROP TABLE 只会删除 Metastore 中的元数据定义，而不会删除底层的数据文件。只有托管表（Managed Table）在删除时才会同时删除元数据和数据文件。

q:
After running DESCRIBE EXTENDED accounts.customers;, the following was returned:
Now, a data analyst runs the following command:
DROP accounts.customers;
Which describes the result of running this command?
opts: Running SELECT * FROM delta.`dbfs:/stakeholders/customers` results in an error.
Running SELECT * FROM accounts.customers will return all rows in the table.
The accounts.customers table is removed from the metastore, but the underlying data files are untouched.
The accounts.customers table is removed from the metastore, and the underlying data files are deleted.
q_zh: 运行 DESCRIBE EXTENDED accounts.customers; 后返回了图示信息。现在，数据分析师执行 DROP accounts.customers; ，结果是什么？
exp_zh: 根据 DESCRIBE EXTENDED 的输出，该表的 Location 指向外部路径，说明这是一个外部表。因此 DROP 操作只会从 Metastore 中移除元数据注册信息，而底层数据文件保持不变，仍然可以通过路径直接访问。

q: What should data analysts consider when working with personally identifiable information (PII) data?
opts: The legal requirements for the area in which the data was collected
The organization-specific best practices for PII data
All of these considerations
The legal requirements for the area in which the analysis is being performed
q_zh: 数据分析师在处理个人身份信息（PII）数据时应考虑哪些因素？
exp_zh: 处理 PII 数据时需要综合考虑所有因素：数据收集地区的法律要求、数据分析地区的法律要求，以及组织内部的 PII 数据最佳实践。三者缺一不可，确保合规和安全。

q: Delta Lake stores table data as a series of data files, but it also stores a lot of other information. What is stored alongside data files when using Delta Lake?
opts: Owner account information
Table metadata, data summary visualizations, and owner account information
Table metadata
Data summary visualizations
q_zh: Delta Lake 将表数据存储为一系列数据文件，但它还存储了许多其他信息。使用 Delta Lake 时，数据文件旁还存储了什么？
exp_zh: Delta Lake 除了存储数据文件（Parquet）外，还在 _delta_log 目录中存储表元数据，包括事务日志、Schema 信息、文件级统计信息等。这些元数据支撑了 ACID 事务、时间旅行和 Schema 演化等核心功能。

q: Which of the following is an advantage of using a Delta Lake-based data lakehouse over common data lake solutions?
opts: ACID transactions
Flexible schemas
Open-source formats
Scalable storage
q_zh: 与常见的数据湖解决方案相比，使用基于 Delta Lake 的数据湖仓有什么优势？
exp_zh: ACID 事务是 Delta Lake 相对于普通数据湖的核心优势。传统数据湖缺乏事务支持，容易出现脏读和数据不一致问题。Delta Lake 通过事务日志保证了读写操作的原子性、一致性、隔离性和持久性。

q: Which benefit of using Databricks SQL is provided by Data Explorer?
opts: It can be used to connect to third party BI cools.
It can be used to view metadata and data, as well as view/change permissions.
It can be used to produce dashboards that allow data exploration.
It can be used to make visualizations that can be shared with stakeholders.
q_zh: Databricks SQL 中的 Data Explorer 提供了什么功能？
exp_zh: Data Explorer 允许用户浏览和查看表的元数据（列名、类型、描述等）、预览数据内容，以及查看和修改表/数据库的权限设置。它是了解数据资产和管理访问控制的重要工具。

q:
The stakeholders.customers table has 15 columns and 3,000 rows of data. The following command is run:
After running SELECT * FROM stakeholders.eur_customers, 15 rows are returned. After the command executes completely, the user logs out of Databricks.
What is the status of the stakeholders.eur_customers view after logging back in two days later?
opts: The view is not available in the metastore, but the underlying data can be accessed with SELECT * FROM delta.'stakeholders.eur_customers'.
The view remains available but attempting to SELECT from it results in an empty result set because data in views are automatically deleted after logging out.
The view remains available and SELECT * FROM stakeholders.eur_customers will execute correctly.
The view has been dropped.
q_zh: stakeholders.customers 表有 15 列 3000 行数据。执行了图示命令后，SELECT * FROM stakeholders.eur_customers 返回 15 行。用户登出后两天重新登录，stakeholders.eur_customers 视图的状态是什么？
exp_zh: 根据题意，创建的是临时视图（TEMP VIEW）。临时视图仅在当前会话期间存在，用户登出后会话结束，临时视图随即被删除。因此两天后重新登录时该视图已不存在。

q:
A data analyst created and is the owner of the managed table my_table. The data analyst now wants to change ownership of the table to a single other user using Data Explorer.
Which approach can the analyst use to complete the task?
opts: Edit theOwner field in the table page by selecting the new owner's account.
Edit theOwner field in the table page by selecting the Admins group.
Edit theOwner field in the table page by selecting All Users.
Edit theOwner field in the table page by removing their own account.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师创建并拥有托管表 my_table，现在想使用 Data Explorer 将所有权转让给另一个用户。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 在 Data Explorer 的表详情页中，可以直接编辑 Owner 字段，选择新的用户账户来完成所有权转让。这是最直接的方式，只需在界面上选择目标用户即可。

q:
A data analyst has a managed table table_name in database database_name. The data analyst wants to remove the table from the database and all of the data files associated with the table. The rest of the tables in the database must continue to exist.
Which command can the analyst use to complete the task without producing an error?
opts: DROP TABLE table_name FROM database_name;
DROP TABLE database_name.table_name;
DELETE TABLE database_name.table_name;
DELETE TABLE table_name FROM database_name;
q_zh: 一位数据分析师有一个位于数据库 database_name 中的托管表 table_name，想删除该表及其所有数据文件，同时不影响数据库中的其他表。应使用哪个命令？
exp_zh: DROP TABLE database_name.table_name; 是正确的语法。对于托管表，DROP TABLE 会同时删除元数据和底层数据文件。使用 database_name.table_name 的限定名格式可以精确指定要删除的表。

q:
A data analyst runs the following command:
Which table represents the output of this command?
q_zh: 一位数据分析师运行了图示命令。哪个表代表该命令的输出结果？
exp_zh: 根据命令执行的逻辑，需要分析 SQL 语句的操作（如 JOIN、GROUP BY、聚合等），然后对比各选项中的表结构和数据，找出与命令输出一致的表。正确答案 D 准确反映了命令执行后的结果集。

q:
A data analyst runs the following command:
INSERT INTO stakeholders.suppliers TABLE stakeholders.new_suppliers;
What is the result of running this command?
table now contains the data from the suppliers table.
opts: The suppliers table now contains both the data it had before the command was run and the data from the new_suppliers table, including any duplicate data.
The suppliers table now contains both the data it had before the command was run and the data from the new_suppliers table, and any duplicate data is deleted.
The suppliers table now contains only the data from the new_suppliers table.
The suppliers table now contains the data from the new_suppliers table, and the new_suppliers
q_zh: 一位数据分析师运行了命令：INSERT INTO stakeholders.suppliers TABLE stakeholders.new_suppliers; 结果是什么？
exp_zh: INSERT INTO ... TABLE ... 语法会将 new_suppliers 表中的所有数据追加到 suppliers 表中，而保留 suppliers 表原有的数据。这是追加操作而非覆盖，因此最终 suppliers 表包含原始数据加上新数据。

q:
A data analyst is working with a nested array column products in table transactions. The analyst wants to expand the table so each unique item in products for each row has its own row where the transaction_id column is duplicated as necessary.
The data analyst is using the following incomplete command:
Which line of code should the data analyst use to fill in the blank in the above code block so that it successfully completes the task?
opts: array distinct(products)
explode(products)
flatten(products)
array(products)
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在使用 transactions 表中的嵌套数组列 products。分析师想展开表，使 products 中每个唯一项都有自己的一行。应使用哪个函数？
exp_zh: explode() 函数可以将数组中的每个元素展开为独立的行，同时保留原行的其他列值。这是处理嵌套数组数据时最常用的函数，适用于将一对多关系转为扁平结构。

opts: CREATE TABLE table_silver AS SELECT DISTINCT *
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE table_silver SELECT * FROM table_bronze;
CREATE TABLE table_silver AS MERGE DEDUPLICATE *
INSERT INTO TABLE table_silver SELECT * FROM table_bronze;
q_zh: 一个数据分析团队使用 table_bronze 作为复杂项目的数据源。利益相关者发现下游数据有重复。应如何去重并写入 Silver 层？
exp_zh: CREATE TABLE table_silver AS SELECT DISTINCT * FROM table_bronze; 使用 DISTINCT 关键字去除完全重复的行，并将结果写入新的 Silver 层表。这是从 Bronze 层到 Silver 层数据清洗的标准做法。

q:
A business analyst has been asked to create a data entity/object called sales_by_employee. It should always stay up-to-date when new data are added to the sales table. The new entity should have the columns sales_person, which will be the name of the employee from the employees table, and sales, which will be all sales for that particular sales person. Both the sales table and the employees table have an employee_id column that is used to identify the sales person.
Which of the following code blocks will accomplish this task?
q_zh: 业务分析师被要求创建名为 sales_by_employee 的数据实体，它应在 sales 表有新数据时自动保持最新，包含员工姓名和销售总额。应使用图示哪个代码块？
exp_zh: 需要创建一个视图（VIEW），因为视图会在每次查询时自动反映底层表的最新数据。正确答案 D 使用了 CREATE VIEW 结合 GROUP BY 聚合来计算每个员工的销售总额。

q:
A data analyst has been asked to use the below table sales_table to get the percentage rank of products within region by the sales:
The result of the query should look like this:
Which query will accomplish this task?
q_zh: 一位数据分析师被要求使用 sales_table 获取各区域内产品按销售额的百分比排名。结果应如图所示。应使用哪个查询？
exp_zh: PERCENT_RANK() 窗口函数用于计算分区内的百分比排名。正确的查询需要使用 PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales) 来按区域分区、按销售额排序计算百分比排名。

q: In which situation should a data analyst use higher-order functions?
opts: When custom logic needs to be applied to simple, unnested data
When custom logic needs to be converted to Python-native code
When custom logic needs to be applied at scale to array data objects
When built-in functions are taking too long to perform tasks
q_zh: 在什么情况下数据分析师应该使用高阶函数（Higher-Order Functions）？
exp_zh: 高阶函数（如 TRANSFORM、FILTER、AGGREGATE）专门用于对数组类型的数据大规模应用自定义逻辑。当内置函数无法满足对复杂嵌套数组的处理需求时，高阶函数提供了灵活且高性能的解决方案。

q:
Consider the following two statements: Statement 1:
Statement 2:
How will the result sets differ for each statement when they are run in Databricks SQL?
opts: The first statement will return all data from the customers table and matching data from the orders table. The second statement will return all data from the orders table and matching data from the customers table. Any missing data will be filled in with NULL.

When the first statement is run, only rows from the customers table that have at least one match with the orders table on customer_id will be returned. q_zh: 考虑图示两个 SQL 语句（Statement 1 和 Statement 2）。在 Databricks SQL 中运行时，两者的结果集有何不同？
exp_zh: 根据 JOIN 类型的不同，结果集会有差异。Statement 1 使用的 JOIN 类型只返回在两个表中都有匹配的行（INNER JOIN 效果），因此只有 customers 表中在 orders 表中有对应记录的行才会出现在结果中。

q:
A data analyst has created a user-defined function using the following line of code:
CREATE FUNCTION price(spend DOUBLE, units DOUBLE) RETURNS DOUBLE
RETURN spend / units;
Which code blocks can be used to apply this function to the customer_spend and customer_units
columns of the table customer_summary to create column customer_price?
opts: SELECT PRICE customer_spend, customer_units AS customer_price FROM customer_summary
SELECT price(customer_spend, customer_units) AS customer_price FROM customer_summary
SELECT function(price(customer_spend, customer_units)) AS customer_price FROM customer_summary
SELECT double(price(customer_spend, customer_units)) AS customer_price FROM customer_summary
q_zh: 一位数据分析师使用以下代码创建了用户定义函数：CREATE FUNCTION price(spend DOUBLE, units DOUBLE) RETURNS DOUBLE RETURN spend / units; 哪个代码块可以正确调用此函数？
exp_zh: 调用用户定义函数的正确语法是 function_name(arg1, arg2)。因此 SELECT price(customer_spend, customer_units) AS customer_price FROM customer_summary 是正确的调用方式，参数直接传入函数括号中。

q:
A data analyst has been asked to count the number of customers in each region and has written the following query:
If there is a mistake in the query, what characterizes the mistake?
opts: The query is using count(*), which will count all the customers in the customers table, no matter the region.
The query is missing a GROUP BY region clause.
The query is using ORDER BY, which is not allowed in an aggregation.
The query is selecting region, but region should only occur in the ORDER BY clause.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师被要求统计各区域的客户数量，并编写了图示查询。如果查询有错误，错误的特征是什么？
exp_zh: 使用聚合函数（如 COUNT）同时 SELECT 非聚合列（如 region）时，必须包含 GROUP BY 子句。缺少 GROUP BY region 会导致 SQL 无法正确按区域分组计算客户数。

q:
A data analyst is processing a complex aggregation on a table with zero null values and their query returns the following result:
Which query does the analyst need to run in order to obtain the above result?
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在一个无空值的表上执行复杂聚合，查询返回了图示结果。需要运行哪个查询来获得该结果？
exp_zh: 根据图示结果的结构和数据，需要选择正确的聚合查询。正确答案 D 使用了适当的 GROUP BY 和聚合函数组合来产生所需的输出。

q: Which of the following is a benefit of Databricks SQL using ANSI SQL as its standard SQL dialect?
opts: It is more compatible with Spark's interpreters.
It is easy to migrate existing SQL queries to Databricks SQL.
It allows for the use of Photon's computation optimizations.
It is more performant than other SQL dialects.
q_zh: Databricks SQL 使用 ANSI SQL 作为标准 SQL 方言有什么好处？
exp_zh: ANSI SQL 是行业标准，大多数数据分析师和工程师都已熟悉。使用 ANSI SQL 意味着现有的 SQL 查询可以轻松迁移到 Databricks SQL，无需大量修改，降低了学习成本和迁移难度。

q: How can a data analyst determine if query results were pulled from the cache?
opts: Go to the Query History tab and click on the text of the query. The slideout shows if the results came from the cache.
Go to the Data tab and click Last Query. The details of the query will show if the results came from the cache.
Go to the Queries tab and click on Cache Status. The status will be green if the results from the last run came from the cache.
Go to the SQL Warehouse (formerly SQL Endpoints) tab and click on Cache. The Cache file will show the contents of the cache.
q_zh: 数据分析师如何确定查询结果是否来自缓存？
exp_zh: 在 Query History 标签页中点击查询文本，弹出的侧边栏会显示该查询的详细信息，包括结果是否来自缓存。这是验证缓存命中的最直接方式。

q: Which statement about a refresh schedule is incorrect?
opts: A query being refreshed on a schedule does not use a SQL Warehouse (formerly known as SQL Endpoint).
Refresh schedules can be configured in the Query Editor.
A query can be refreshed anywhere from 1 minute to 2 weeks.
You must have workspace administrator privileges to configure a refresh schedule.
q_zh: 关于刷新计划（Refresh Schedule）的哪个说法是不正确的？
exp_zh: 说法 A 声称按计划刷新的查询不使用 SQL Warehouse，这是不正确的。任何查询执行都需要计算资源，按计划刷新的查询同样需要 SQL Warehouse 来运行。

q:
A data analyst creates a Databricks SQL Query where the result set has the following schema:
region STRING number_of_customer INT
What type of visualization will be selected by default when the analyst clicks on the "Add visualization" button on the SQL Editor page?
opts: Violin Chart
Line Chart
Bar Chart
Histogram
q_zh: 一位数据分析师创建了一个结果集包含 region STRING 和 number_of_customer INT 的查询。点击添加可视化按钮时，默认选择什么类型的可视化？
exp_zh: 当结果集包含一个分类列（STRING）和一个数值列（INT）时，Databricks SQL 默认选择柱状图（Bar Chart）。柱状图非常适合展示不同类别对应的数值比较。

q:
A data analyst has created a Query in Databricks SQL, and now wants to create two data visualizations from that Query and add both of those data visualizations to the same Databricks SQL Dashboard.
Which step will the data analyst need to take when creating and adding both data visualizations to the Databricks SQL Dashboard?
opts: Decide on a single data visualization to add to the dashboard.
Alter the Query to return two separate sets of results.
Add two separate visualizations to the dashboard based on the same Query.
Copy the Query and create one data visualization per query.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在 Databricks SQL 中创建了一个查询，想基于该查询创建两个数据可视化，并将两者添加到同一个仪表板。最佳做法是什么？
exp_zh: Databricks SQL 允许基于同一个查询创建多个不同的可视化，并将它们分别添加到仪表板。无需复制查询或修改查询，直接为同一查询创建两个独立的可视化组件即可。

q:
A data analyst has been asked to provide a list of options on how to share a dashboard with a client. It is a security requirement that the client does not gain access to any other information, resources, or artifacts in the database.
Which approach cannot be used to share the dashboard and meet the security requirement?
opts: Set a refresh schedule for the dashboard and enter the client's email address in the "Subscribers" box.
Download the Dashboard as a PDF and share it with the client.
Generate a Personal Access Token that is good for 1 day and share it with the client.
Take a screenshot of the dashboard and share it with the client.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师被要求提供与客户共享仪表板的方案列表，安全要求是客户不能访问任何其他信息、资源或数据。哪个选项可用？
exp_zh: 生成一个有效期为 1 天的 Personal Access Token（PAT）并分享给客户，可以提供临时受限的访问权限。虽然这不是最佳实践，但在给定选项中，它提供了一种有时间限制的访问方式。

q: A data analyst has been asked to produce a visualization that shows the flow of users through a website. What kind of tool is utilized for visualising this type of flow?
opts: Pivot Table
Heatmap
Sankey
Choropleth
q_zh: 一位数据分析师被要求制作展示网站用户流转的可视化图。应使用哪种工具来可视化这种流转？
exp_zh: Sankey 图（桑基图）专门用于展示流量或数量在不同节点之间的流转情况。它通过流线的宽度来表示数量大小，非常适合展示用户在网站各页面之间的导航路径和转化漏斗。

q:
A data analyst writes a query that contains a query parameter. The data analyst then adds an area chart visualization to the query. While adding the area chart visualization to a dashboard, the analyst chooses "Dashboard Parameter" for the query parameter associated with the area chart.
Which statement is correct?
opts: The area chart will use whatever is selected in the Dashboard Parameter while all or the other visualizations will remain changed regardless of their parameter use.
The area chart will use whatever is selected in the Dashboard Parameter along with all of the other visualizations in the dashboard that use the same parameter.
The area chart will use whatever value is chosen on the dashboard at the time the area chart is added to the dashboard.
The area chart will use whatever value is input by the analyst when the visualization is added to the dashboard. The parameter cannot be changed by the user afterwards.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师编写了包含查询参数的查询并添加了面积图可视化。在将该面积图添加到仪表板时，分析师选择使用仪表板参数。面积图会如何使用该参数？
exp_zh: 当选择使用仪表板参数时，面积图及仪表板上所有使用相同参数的其他可视化都会统一使用仪表板级别的参数值。这实现了全局参数控制，用户修改一次参数即可同步更新所有关联的可视化。

q:
A data analyst has been asked to configure an alert for a query that returns the income in the
accounts_receivable table for a date range. The date range is configurable using a Date query parameter. The Alert does not work.
What explains the failure of the Alert to function?
opts: The wrong query parameter is being used. Alerts only work with dropdown list query parameters, not dates.
Queries that use query parameters cannot be used with Alerts.
Queries that return results based on dates cannot be used with Alerts.
The wrong query parameter is being used. Alerts only work with Date and Time query parameters.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师被要求为一个查询配置告警，该查询返回基于日期范围的 accounts_receivable 表中的收入。日期范围通过 Date 查询参数配置。为什么无法设置此告警？
exp_zh: 使用查询参数的查询不能用于告警（Alerts）。告警需要一个固定的查询结果来监控，而带有查询参数的查询每次执行的结果取决于参数值，无法作为稳定的监控基线。

q: Which statements about adding visual appeal to visualizations in the Visualization Editor is incorrect?
opts: Visualization scale can be changed.
Data Labels can be formatted.
Tooltips can be formatted.
Borders can be added.
q_zh: 关于在可视化编辑器中为可视化添加视觉效果，哪个说法是不正确的？
exp_zh: 在 Databricks SQL 的可视化编辑器中，可以调整比例尺、格式化数据标签和自定义工具提示，但不支持添加边框。因此选项 D（可以添加边框）的说法是不正确的。

q:
A consultant has assigned a number of tasks to a data team that must be completed using the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
Which Databricks SQL projects need to be finished?
opts: Testing the quality of data as it is imported from a source
Automating complex notebook-based workflows with multiple tasks
Combining two data sources into a single, comprehensive dataset
Segmenting customers into like groups using a clustering algorithm
q_zh: 一位顾问为数据团队分配了一系列必须使用 Databricks Lakehouse 平台完成的任务。哪些是需要使用 Databricks SQL 完成的项目？
exp_zh: 将两个数据源合并为一个综合数据集是典型的 SQL 操作（如 JOIN、UNION），适合在 Databricks SQL 中完成。而数据质量测试、复杂工作流自动化和聚类算法属于数据工程或数据科学范畴。

q:
A data organization has a team of engineers developing data pipelines following the medallion architecture using Delta Live Tables. While the data analysis team working on a project is using gold-layer tables from these pipelines, they need to perform some additional processing of these tables prior to performing their analysis.
Which term is applied to this kind of work?
opts: Data blending
Data enhancement
Data testing
Last-mile ETL
q_zh: 一个数据组织的工程团队使用 Delta Live Tables 按照奖章架构开发数据管道。数据分析团队在使用 Gold 层表时发现需要额外转换。这个过程叫什么？
exp_zh: Last-mile ETL（最后一公里 ETL）是指在 Gold 层数据已经准备好的基础上，数据分析师根据特定分析需求进行的额外转换和处理。这是连接标准化 Gold 层数据和具体分析用例之间的桥梁。

q: Which statement describes descriptive statistics?
opts: A branch of statistics that uses summary statistics to categorically describe and summarize data.
A branch of statistics that uses a variety of data analysis techniques to infer properties of an underlying distribution of probability.
A branch of statistics that uses quantitative variables that must take on a finite or countably infinite set of values.
A branch of statistics that uses summary statistics to quantitatively describe and summarize data.
q_zh: 哪个描述说明了描述性统计学（Descriptive Statistics）？
exp_zh: 描述性统计学使用汇总统计量（如均值、中位数、标准差等）来定量描述和总结数据的特征。它关注的是'数据是什么样的'，而不是做推断或预测。注意是'定量'描述而非'分类'描述。

q: In which circumstance will there be a substantial difference between the variable's mean and median values?
opts: When the variable contains no outliers
When the variable contains a lot of extreme outliers
When the variable is of the categorical type
When the variable is of the boolean type
q_zh: 在什么情况下变量的均值和中位数会有显著差异？
exp_zh: 当变量包含大量极端异常值（Outliers）时，均值会被拉向异常值的方向，而中位数不受极端值影响。因此两者之间会产生显著差异，这也是判断数据分布偏斜程度的一种方式。

q:
A data analyst is working with gold-layer tables to complete an ad-hoc project. A stakeholder has provided the analyst with an additional dataset that can be used to augment the gold-layer tables already in use.
Which term is used to describe this data augmentation?
opts: Data enhancement
Ad-hoc improvements
Last-mile dashboarding
Last-mile ETL
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在使用 Gold 层表完成临时项目。利益相关者提供了一个额外数据集来增强已有的 Gold 层表。这种将外部数据补充到现有数据中的做法叫什么？
exp_zh: Data Enhancement（数据增强）是指用额外的外部数据来补充和丰富现有数据集。与 Last-mile ETL 不同，数据增强的重点是引入新的数据源来扩展分析维度。

q:
A data analyst needs to query the data in my_table. They want to return the values in columns user_id and email_address where records fit the following filter criteria: age is greater than 25 and country is Canada. The analyst does not want to return values from any other columns.
Which code block will accomplish the above task?
opts: SELECT * FROM my_table WHERE age > 25 AND country = ’Canada’;
SELECT user_id, email_address FROM my_table WHERE age > 25 AND country = ’Canada’;
SELECT age, country FROM my_table WHERE age > 25 AND country = ’Canada’;
SELECT user_id, email_address FROM my_table WHERE age = 25 AND country > ’Canada’;
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要从 my_table 中查询 user_id 和 email_address 列，筛选条件为 age > 25 且 country = 'Canada'。应使用哪个查询？
exp_zh: SELECT user_id, email_address FROM my_table WHERE age > 25 AND country = 'Canada'; 是正确的。它精确指定了需要返回的列（user_id 和 email_address），并使用 WHERE 子句正确组合了两个筛选条件。

q: Which example of data projects represents a common analytics application to be completed in Databricks SQL?
opts: Augmenting gold-layer tables with additional external information
Automating complex notebook-based workflows with multiple tasks
Testing the quality of data as it is imported from a source
Segmenting customers into like groups using a clustering algorithm
q_zh: 哪个数据项目示例代表了 Databricks SQL 中常见的分析应用？
exp_zh: 使用额外外部信息增强 Gold 层表是 Databricks SQL 中典型的分析应用场景。数据分析师经常需要将外部数据源与已有的 Gold 层数据结合，以获得更丰富的分析视角。

q: What is a benefit of using Databricks SQL for business intelligence (BI) analytics projects instead of using third-party BI tools?
opts: Computations, data, and analytical tools on the same platform
Advanced dashboarding capabilities
Simultaneous multi-user support
Automated alerting systems
q_zh: 与使用第三方 BI 工具相比，使用 Databricks SQL 进行商业智能分析项目有什么好处？
exp_zh: Databricks SQL 最大的优势是计算、数据和分析工具在同一个平台上。这消除了在不同系统之间移动数据的需求，减少了延迟和数据一致性问题，提高了整体工作效率。

q:
A data analyst wants the following output:
Which statement will produce this output?
q_zh: 一位数据分析师想要获得图示的输出结果。哪个 SQL 语句能产生该输出？
exp_zh: 根据期望输出的结构，需要分析各选项中的 SQL 语句逻辑。正确答案 D 中的查询使用了恰当的聚合函数、GROUP BY 子句和列别名来产生与目标一致的结果。

q: What is an advantage of using a Delta Lake-based data lakehouse over classic enterprise data warehouse solutions?
opts: Open-source formats
Schema enforcement
ACID transactions
Generic optimizations
q_zh: 与传统企业数据仓库解决方案相比，使用基于 Delta Lake 的数据湖仓有什么优势？
exp_zh: 开源格式是 Delta Lake 相对于传统企业数据仓库的独特优势。Delta Lake 基于 Parquet 等开源格式，避免了供应商锁定，用户可以使用各种工具访问数据，灵活性更高。

q:
Query History provides Databricks SQL users with a lot of benefits. A data analyst has been asked to share all of these benefits with their team as part of a training exercise. One of the benefit statements the analyst provided to their team is incorrect.
Which statement about Query History is incorrect?
opts: It can be used to troubleshoot slow running queries.
It can be used to view the query plan of queries that have run.
It can be used to debug queries.
It can be used to automate query execution on multiple warehouses (formerly endpoints).
q_zh: Query History 为 Databricks SQL 用户提供了许多好处。在培训中，分析师需要分享所有好处。哪个说法是不正确的？
exp_zh: Query History 可用于排查慢查询、查看查询执行计划和调试查询，但不能用于在多个 Warehouse 上自动执行查询。自动化执行需要通过调度器或 API 来实现，不属于 Query History 的功能。

q:
A data scientist has asked a data analyst to create histograms for every continuous variable in a data set. The data analyst needs to identify which columns are continuous in the data set.
What describes a continuous variable?
opts: A quantitative variable that never stops changing
A quantitative variable that can take on a finite or countably infinite set of values
A quantitative variable that can take on an uncountable set of values
A categorical variable in which the number of categories continues to increase over time
q_zh: 数据科学家要求数据分析师为数据集中的每个连续变量创建直方图。分析师需要识别哪些列是连续的。什么描述了连续变量？
exp_zh: 连续变量是一种可以取不可数无穷多个值的定量变量，例如温度、身高、收入等。与离散变量（有限或可数无穷个值）不同，连续变量在任意两个值之间都可以有无限多个可能的值。

q:
A data analyst has been asked to use the below table sales_table to rank products within region by the sales:
The result of the query should look like this:
Which query will accomplish this task?
q_zh: 一位数据分析师被要求使用 sales_table 按区域对产品按销售额进行排名。结果应如图所示。应使用哪个查询？
exp_zh: RANK() 窗口函数用于在分区内按指定列排序并生成排名。正确的查询需要使用 RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sales DESC) 来按区域分区、按销售额降序排名。

opts: dbfs:/accounting/data/accounting.db
dbfs:/accounting/data
dbfs:/accounting/data.db
dbfs:/user/hive/warehouse/accounting.db
q_zh: 在 Databricks SQL 中使用以下语句创建了数据库：CREATE SCHEMA accounting LOCATION 'dbfs:/accounting/data'; 该数据库的数据将存储在哪里？
exp_zh: 当 CREATE SCHEMA 指定了 LOCATION 时，数据直接存储在指定的路径 dbfs:/accounting/data 下，而不是默认的 hive/warehouse 位置，也不会自动添加 .db 后缀。

q:
A data analyst is processing a complex aggregation on a table with zero null values and the query returns the following result:
Which query did the analyst execute in order to get this result?
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在一个无空值的表上执行复杂聚合，查询返回了图示结果。分析师执行了哪个查询来获得这个结果？
exp_zh: 根据图示结果集的结构和数值，需要分析各选项中的聚合逻辑。正确答案 D 中的查询使用了正确的聚合函数和分组条件来产生匹配的输出。

q:
A managed table and an unmanaged (external) table were both created in Databricks SQL, and data were ingested into each table. Later, both tables were dropped.
What is the status of data for each of those tables?
opts: The data in both tables were deleted.
The data in the managed table were deleted, and the data in the unmanaged (external) table were left untouched.
The data in the unmanaged (external) table were deleted and the data in the managed table were left untouched, for both tables the metadata was the same.
The data in both tables were left untouched.
q_zh: 在 Databricks SQL 中分别创建了一个托管表和一个非托管（外部）表，并向两者都写入了数据。之后两个表都被删除了。各自数据的状态是什么？
exp_zh: 托管表的数据随 DROP 一起删除，因为 Databricks 完全管理其数据生命周期。非托管（外部）表的数据保持不变，因为 Databricks 只管理元数据，数据文件存储在用户指定的外部位置。

q: Which statement about subqueries is correct?
opts: Subqueries are not available in Databricks SQL.
Subqueries can be used like other user-defined functions to transform data into different data types.
Subqueries can retrieve data without requiring the creation of a table or view.
Subqueries can be used like other built-in functions to transform data into different data types.
q_zh: 关于子查询（Subqueries）的哪个说法是正确的？
exp_zh: 子查询可以在不创建表或视图的情况下检索数据。它作为嵌套在主查询中的独立查询运行，适用于需要临时数据集进行过滤、计算或比较的场景，无需持久化中间结果。

q: Which location can be used to determine the owner of a managed table?
opts: Review the Owner field in the table page using Catalog Explorer
Review the Owner field in the database page using Data Explorer
Review the Owner field in the schema page using Data Explorer
Review the Owner field in the table page using the SQL Editor
q_zh: 在哪里可以查看托管表的所有者？
exp_zh: 在 Catalog Explorer 的表页面中可以查看 Owner 字段。Catalog Explorer（Unity Catalog 中的数据浏览工具）提供了表的详细信息视图，包括所有者、Schema、权限等。

q: Which statement about visualizations is true?
opts: All visualizations must use the same data in order to be included in the same Databricks SQL dashboard.
Line charts are the preferred visualization type for categorical data.
Different visualizations can be used to tell different stories about the data.
There is no difference between the bar chart and a histogram in Databricks SQL.
q_zh: 关于可视化的哪个说法是正确的？
exp_zh: 不同的可视化类型（柱状图、折线图、散点图等）可以从不同角度展现数据的故事。选择合适的可视化类型对于有效传达数据洞察至关重要，每种图表都有其最适合的使用场景。

q: What describes the variance of a set of values?
opts: Variance is a measure of how far a single observed value is from a set of values.
Variance is a measure of how far an observed value is from the variable’s maximum or minimum value.
Variance is a measure of central tendency of a set of values.
Variance is a measure of how far a set of values is spread out from the set's central value.
q_zh: 什么描述了一组值的方差？
exp_zh: 方差衡量的是一组值相对于其中心值（均值）的离散程度。方差越大，数据点越分散；方差越小，数据点越集中在均值附近。它是描述数据分布特征的重要统计量。

q: Which SQL standards does Databricks SQL use as its default SQL dialect?
opts: Databricks SQL
Spark SQL
ANSI
Delta SQL
q_zh: Databricks SQL 默认使用哪种 SQL 标准作为其 SQL 方言？
exp_zh: Databricks SQL 默认使用 ANSI SQL 标准。这确保了与行业标准的兼容性，使得熟悉标准 SQL 的分析师可以无缝迁移查询，同时保证了跨平台的一致行为。

q:
A data analyst is working in an organization that utilizes a multi-hop, medallion architecture. They have been tasked with creating a new Gold table from an existing Silver table.
Which query is performing a hop from a Silver table to a Gold table?
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在使用多跳奖章架构的组织中工作，任务是从现有 Silver 表创建新的 Gold 表。图示哪个查询执行了从 Silver 到 Gold 的跳转？
exp_zh: 从 Silver 表到 Gold 表的跳转通常涉及聚合、业务逻辑转换或维度建模。正确答案 C 中的查询从 Silver 表读取数据，应用适当的转换后写入 Gold 表。

q: What is used as a compute resource for Databricks SQL?
opts: Standard clusters
Single-node clusters
SQL warehouses
Downstream BI tools integrated with Databricks SQL
q_zh: Databricks SQL 使用什么作为计算资源？
exp_zh: SQL Warehouse（SQL 仓库）是 Databricks SQL 专用的计算资源。它经过优化专门用于 SQL 查询执行，支持自动扩缩容和 Serverless 模式，与通用集群不同，专注于 SQL 工作负载的性能优化。

q:
A data analyst has opened up the SQL Editor page and written a new SQL statement. The data analyst now wants to save that statement to easily refer back to it later to add it to a dashboard. The results of the SQL statement must be able to be displayed as a counter, table, or a data visualization.
Which approach should the data analyst use to accomplish this task?
opts: Save the SQL statement as a Dashboard
Save the SQL statement within a Notebook
Save the SQL statement as a Query
Save the SQL statement in the Query History page
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在 SQL Editor 页面编写了新的 SQL 语句，想保存该语句以便后续引用并添加到仪表板。结果需要可以被查看。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 将 SQL 语句保存为 Query（查询）。保存后的查询可以随时重新运行、编辑，并且可以基于它创建可视化和仪表板组件。这是 Databricks SQL 中管理和复用 SQL 语句的标准方式。

q:
A data analyst wants to create a Databricks SQL dashboard with multiple data visualizations and multiple counters.
What must be completed before adding the data visualizations and counters to the dashboard?
opts: All data visualizations and counters must be created using Queries.
A SQL warehouse (formerly known as SQL endpoint) must be turned on and selected.
A markdown-based tile must be added to the top of the dashboard displaying the dashboard’s name.
The dashboard owner must also be the owner of the queries, data visualizations, and counters.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师想创建包含多个数据可视化和计数器的 Databricks SQL 仪表板。在添加可视化和计数器之前必须完成什么？
exp_zh: 所有数据可视化和计数器都必须先通过 Query 创建。Databricks SQL 的仪表板组件基于已保存的查询和可视化构建，因此需要先创建查询并添加可视化，然后才能将它们放入仪表板。

q:
An analyst has been asked to combine the data in two tables: suppliers and new_suppliers. It’s possible that some of the supplier_id values match in both tables, meaning that those particular suppliers have already been added to the suppliers table. If that is the case, the data should be unchanged.
Which command will combine the two tables without duplicating the rows with the same supplier_id?
ON suppliers.supplier_id = new_suppliers.supplier_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
ON suppliers.supplier_id = new_suppliers.supplier_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
ON suppliers.supplier_id = new_suppliers.supplier_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
ON suppliers.supplier_id = new_suppliers.supplier_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
opts: MERGE INTO suppliers USING new_suppliers
COPY INTO suppliers USING new_suppliers
UPDATE suppliers USING new_suppliers
INSERT INTO suppliers USING new_suppliers
q_zh: 一位分析师被要求合并两个表：suppliers 和 new_suppliers。部分 supplier_id 可能在两个表中匹配，意味着需要更新这些供应商的信息。应使用哪个命令？
exp_zh: MERGE INTO 语句可以同时处理匹配行的更新（UPDATE）和不匹配行的插入（INSERT），即 UPSERT 操作。这是合并两个可能有重叠数据的表时的最佳选择，确保已存在的记录被更新，新记录被插入。

q: What does Partner Connect do when connecting Power BI and Tableau?
opts: Creates a Personal Access Token, downloads and installs an ODBC driver, and downloads a configuration file for connection by Power BI or Tableau to a SQL Warehouse (formerly known as a SQL Endpoint).
Creates a Personal Access Token for authentication into Databricks SQL and emails it to you.
Downloads a configuration file for connection by Power BI or Tableau to a SQL Warehouse (formerly known as a SQL Endpoint).
Downloads and installs an ODBC driver.
q_zh: Partner Connect 在连接 Power BI 和 Tableau 时做了什么？
exp_zh: Partner Connect 自动完成三个步骤：创建用于身份验证的 Personal Access Token、下载并安装 ODBC 驱动程序、下载连接配置文件。这种自动化流程大大简化了 BI 工具与 Databricks 的集成过程。

q:
A data analyst is working with a nested array column products in table transactions. The analyst wants to return the first item in the array for each row.
The data analyst is using the following incomplete command:
Which lines of code should the data analyst use to fill in the blank in the above code block so that it successfully completes the task?
opts: products.1
products.0
products[0]
products[1]
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在使用 transactions 表中的嵌套数组列 products，想返回每行数组中的第一个元素。应使用什么表达式？
exp_zh: 在 Databricks SQL 中，数组索引从 0 开始，因此 products[0] 返回数组中的第一个元素。这与大多数编程语言的数组索引规则一致，是访问数组元素的标准语法。

q:
A dashboard contains a bar chart visualization. The bar chart has a Date widget parameter associated with it.
Which statement about the Date widget parameter is true?
opts: The Date widget parameter provides a start date and an end date that is used by a WHERE clause in the query that provides data to the bar chart.
The Date widget parameter provides a start date and an end date that sets the x-axis range of the bar chart.
The Date widget parameter provides a start date and an end date that filters all visualizations in the dashboard.
The Date widget parameter functions only as a text box that tells the dashboard's users what date range the dashboard is using.
q_zh: 仪表板包含一个带有 Date 小部件参数的柱状图可视化。关于 Date 小部件参数的哪个说法是正确的？
exp_zh: Date 小部件参数提供开始日期和结束日期，用于查询中的 WHERE 子句来过滤数据。它直接影响查询的数据范围，而不是控制图表的显示范围或全局过滤所有可视化。

q:
A data analyst needs to share a Databricks SQL dashboard with stakeholders that are not permitted to have accounts in the Databricks deployment. The stakeholders need to be notified every time the dashboard is refreshed.
Which approach can the data analyst use to accomplish this task with minimal effort?
opts: By granting the stakeholders’ email addresses permissions to the dashboard
By adding the stakeholders’ email addresses to the refresh schedule subscribers list
By granting the stakeholders’ email addresses to the SQL Warehouse (formerly known as endpoint) subscribers list
By downloading the dashboard as a PDF and emailing it to the stakeholders each time it is refreshed
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要与没有 Databricks 账户权限的利益相关者共享仪表板，并在每次刷新时通知他们。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 通过将利益相关者的电子邮件地址添加到刷新计划的订阅者列表中，他们会在每次仪表板刷新时收到包含最新结果的邮件通知，无需拥有 Databricks 账户即可查看。

q: What describes Partner Connect in Databricks?
opts: It allows for free use of Databricks partner tools through a common API.
It allows multi-directional connection between Databricks and Databricks partners easier.
It exposes connection information to third-party tools via Databricks partners.
It is a feature that runs Databricks partner tools on a Databricks SQL Warehouse (formerly known as a SQL Endpoint).
q_zh: 什么描述了 Databricks 中的 Partner Connect？
exp_zh: Partner Connect 使 Databricks 与合作伙伴工具之间的双向连接变得更加简便。它提供了预配置的集成工作流，自动设置认证和连接参数，减少了手动配置的工作量。

q: In which scenario should a data analyst create and use a user-defined function (UDF)?
opts: When the result of logic needs to be restricted to certain users
When logic needs to be deployed within a subquery
When complex logic cannot be implemented with built-in capabilities
When simple logic needs to be optimized for scaling purposes
q_zh: 在什么场景下数据分析师应创建和使用用户定义函数（UDF）？
exp_zh: 当复杂的业务逻辑无法通过内置函数实现时，应创建 UDF。例如，特殊的数据清洗规则、复杂的计算公式或领域特定的转换逻辑，这些场景下 UDF 可以封装可复用的自定义逻辑。

q:
A data analyst has produced a visualization. A stakeholder has viewed the visualization and is complaining that the visualization is difficult to interpret. After looking at the visualization, the analyst determines that the scale of the y-axis must be changed.
Where are the controls for changing the scale of the y-axis in Databricks SQL?
opts: Query Editor -> Y Axis
Dashboard Editor -> Axes -> Y Axis
Visualization Editor -> Y Axis
Settings -> User Settings -> Scaling
q_zh: 一位数据分析师制作了一个可视化，利益相关者反馈图表难以解读。分析师发现 Y 轴的缩放比例不合适。应该在哪里调整 Y 轴比例？
exp_zh: 在 Visualization Editor（可视化编辑器）的 Y Axis 设置中可以调整 Y 轴的缩放比例和范围。这是修改可视化图表坐标轴属性的正确位置。

q: Which example of data projects represents a common analytics application to be completed in Databricks SQL?
opts: Testing the latency of real-time streaming workloads
Performing analysis-specific ETL on gold-layer tables
Predicting customer churn by automatically developing time-series models
Monitoring the performance of deployed machine learning solutions
q_zh: 哪个数据项目示例代表了 Databricks SQL 中常见的分析应用？
exp_zh: 在 Gold 层表上进行分析特定的 ETL（即 Last-mile ETL）是 Databricks SQL 中典型的分析应用。数据分析师经常需要对已有的 Gold 层数据进行额外的转换和聚合以满足特定的分析需求。

q:
A data analyst has two data sources that are providing similar but complementary information. The analyst wants to combine these sources of data into a single, comprehensive dataset for ongoing use for their team in a variety of different projects.
Which terms is used to describe this type of work?
opts: Last-mile ETL
Ad-hoc improvements
Data testing
Data blending
q_zh: 一位数据分析师有两个提供相似但互补信息的数据源，想将它们合并为一个综合数据集以供持续使用。这个过程叫什么？
exp_zh: Data Blending（数据混合）是将来自不同来源的互补数据集合并为一个统一数据集的过程。它不同于简单的 JOIN，更强调整合不同角度的数据以形成更完整的视图。

q:
A data analyst has been asked to determine which customers have placed an order in the past year and which customers have not placed an order in the past year. This can be determined with one statement by joining the customers table (which is unique by customer ID) and the orders table.
Which type of join should the data analyst use?
opts: Left Semi Join
Left Join
Middle Join
Left Anti Join
q_zh: 一位数据分析师被要求确定哪些客户在过去一年内有下单和没有下单。一条语句即可完成。应使用哪种 JOIN？
exp_zh: Left Join（左连接）可以同时显示匹配和不匹配的客户记录。通过 LEFT JOIN 订单表，有订单的客户会有匹配的订单数据，没有订单的客户对应的订单列为 NULL，从而区分两类客户。

q:
A data analyst has come across a column in a table that contains personally identifiable information (PII). The data analyst should not have access to this type of PII data.
How should the data analyst proceed?
opts: Stop working with the data and delete the table and any existing metadata or data files.
Stop working with the data and proceed with the project using other data.
Stop working with the data and notify their supervisor to ensure the data is handled following organizational and legal best practices.
Drop the column containing PII data and continue with the project without notifying anybody.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在表中发现了包含个人身份信息（PII）的列，但分析师不应该访问此类数据。应如何处理？
exp_zh: 分析师应立即停止使用该数据，并通知上级以确保数据按照组织和法律要求进行处理。擅自删除或继续使用都不恰当，正确的做法是上报并遵循组织的数据治理流程。

q:
A data engineering team has created a Structured Streaming pipeline that processes data in micro-batches and populates gold-level tables. The microbatches are triggered every 10 minutes.
A data analyst has created a dashboard based on this gold-level data. The project stakeholders want to see the results in the dashboard updated within 10 minutes or less of new data becoming available within the gold-level tables.
What is the ability to ensure the streamed data is included in the dashboard at the standard requested by the project stakeholders?
opts: A refresh schedule with an always-on SQL Warehouse (formerly known as SQL Endpoint)
A refresh schedule with an interval of 10 minutes or less
A refresh schedule with stakeholders included as subscribers
A refresh schedule with a Structured Streaming cluster
q_zh: 数据工程团队创建了每 10 分钟触发一次微批的 Structured Streaming 管道，填充 Gold 层表。数据分析师创建了基于该数据的仪表板。为保持仪表板与流数据的同步更新，需要什么？
exp_zh: 需要设置间隔为 10 分钟或更短的刷新计划，以确保仪表板能够跟上流数据的更新频率。如果刷新间隔长于数据更新间隔，仪表板将无法反映最新数据。

q: Where in the Databricks SQL workspace can a data analyst configure a refresh schedule for a query when the query is not attached to a dashboard or alert?
opts: Data Explorer
The Visualization Editor
The Query Editor
The Dashboard Editor
q_zh: 当查询未附加到仪表板或告警时，数据分析师可以在 Databricks SQL 工作区的哪里配置查询的刷新计划？
exp_zh: 在 Query Editor（查询编辑器）中可以直接为独立查询配置刷新计划。无需将查询附加到仪表板或告警，即可在查询编辑器界面设置定期自动刷新。

q:
A stakeholder has provided a data analyst with a lookup dataset in the form of a 50-row CSV file. The data analyst needs to upload this dataset for use as a table in Databricks SQL.
Which approach should the data analyst use to quickly upload the file into a table for use in Databricks SQL?
opts: Create a table by uploading the file using the Create page within Databricks SQL.
Create a table via a connection between Databricks and the desktop facilitated by Partner Connect.
Create a table by uploading the file to cloud storage and then importing the data to Databricks.
Create a table by manually copying and pasting the data values into cloud storage and then importing the data to Databricks.
q_zh: 利益相关者提供了一个 50 行的 CSV 查找数据集。数据分析师需要将其上传为 Databricks SQL 中的表。应使用哪种方式？
exp_zh: 通过 Databricks SQL 中的 Create 页面直接上传 CSV 文件是最快捷的方式。对于小型查找数据集（如 50 行 CSV），直接上传功能可以自动识别文件结构并创建表，无需复杂的配置。

q: Which open-source project helps to enable the data lakehouse by adding organization, reliability, performance, and data governance to data lake architectures?
opts: MLflow
Apache Spark
Delta Lake
Databricks SQL
q_zh: 哪个开源项目通过为数据湖架构增加组织性、可靠性、性能和数据治理来实现数据湖仓？
exp_zh: Delta Lake 是一个开源存储层，在数据湖之上添加了 ACID 事务、可扩展元数据处理、Schema 强制执行和时间旅行等功能，将传统数据湖升级为数据湖仓。

q: Which data visualization use cases is best completed using Databricks SQL relative to other visualization tools?
opts: Presentation-grade visualizations for publication
Organization-branded visualizations for marketing material
Custom, interactive visualizations on small data
Simple, exploratory visualizations on big data
q_zh: 相比其他可视化工具，Databricks SQL 最适合完成哪种数据可视化用例？
exp_zh: Databricks SQL 最适合在大数据上进行简单的探索性可视化。它的优势在于与数据平台深度集成，可以直接对海量数据执行查询并快速生成可视化，而无需数据导出。

q:
A data analyst has written and saved a series of queries that reveal trends that need to be monitored by several stakeholders.
Which tool should the data analyst use to share the results of all of the queries to be viewed at once?
opts: A SQL warehouse (formerly known as a SQL endpoint)
A Query History page
A dashboard
A data visualization tab on a Query page
q_zh: 一位数据分析师编写并保存了一系列揭示趋势的查询，需要让多个利益相关者监控这些结果。应使用什么工具？
exp_zh: 仪表板（Dashboard）可以将多个查询的可视化结果集中展示在一个页面上，便于利益相关者一站式查看所有趋势数据。它还支持自动刷新和邮件订阅通知。

q:
A data analyst needs to create an empty managed table table_name in database database_name with a specific schema. The table needs to be recreated and empty, regardless of whether or not the table already exists.
Which command can the analyst use to complete the task?
opts: CREATE TABLE database_name.table_name USING (width INT, length INT, height INT);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE database_name.table_name USING (width INT, length INT, height INT);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE database_name.table_name (width INT, length INT, height INT);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE table_name FROM database_name USING (width INT, length INT, height INT);
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要在数据库 database_name 中创建一个特定 Schema 的空托管表 table_name，无论表是否已存在都需要重新创建为空表。应使用哪个命令？
exp_zh: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE database_name.table_name (width INT, length INT, height INT); 是正确的语法。OR REPLACE 确保如果表已存在则替换，列定义直接放在括号中，使用逗号分隔。

q:
Data professionals with varying responsibilities use the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
Which role in the Databricks Lakehouse Platform use Databricks SQL as their primary service?
opts: Data scientist
Data engineer
Platform architect
Business analyst
q_zh: 在 Databricks Lakehouse 平台中，哪个角色将 Databricks SQL 作为其主要服务？
exp_zh: 业务分析师（Business Analyst）主要使用 Databricks SQL 进行查询、数据分析和可视化。他们的日常工作以 SQL 查询和仪表板为中心，不需要深入使用数据工程或机器学习服务。

q:
A data analyst is working with the following table my_table:
customer_name dollars_spent
Hex Sprockets [125.34, 100.15, 9003.99]
Dented Fenders [16.99, 200.85, 33.49, 88.17]
The analyst now wants to divide each value in the dollars_spent array by 100 to get the spend in terms of hundreds of dollars using the following code block:
SELECT
customer_name, FROM my_table
Which line of code can be used to fill in the blank so that the above code block successfully completes the task?
opts: TRANSFORM(hundreds_spent, dollars_spent / 100)
TRANSFORM(dollars_spent, value / 100) AS hundreds_spent
TRANSFORM(dollars_spent, value -> value / 100) AS hundreds_spent
TRANSFORM(dollars_spent, dollars_spent / 100) AS hundreds_spent
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在使用包含 customer_name 和 dollars_spent（数组类型）列的 my_table 表。分析师想将数组中每个值除以 100 生成新数组 hundreds_spent。应使用哪个表达式？
exp_zh: TRANSFORM(dollars_spent, value -> value / 100) AS hundreds_spent 使用了高阶函数 TRANSFORM 和 Lambda 表达式。TRANSFORM 对数组中的每个元素应用指定的转换函数，value -> value / 100 将每个值除以 100。

q: Where can an admin or Data owner grant database, table, and view permissions to a group?
opts: Dashboard
Data
SQL Warehouses (formerly SQL Endpoints)
Settings
q_zh: 管理员或数据所有者可以在哪里向群组授予数据库、表和视图权限？
exp_zh: 在 Data 页面（即 Data Explorer/Catalog Explorer）中可以管理数据对象的权限。管理员可以在此浏览数据资产并为用户或群组授予相应的访问权限。

q:
A data architect has informed a data analyst team that its organization will now use a data design pattern that will logically organize data in a lakehouse, with the goal of incrementally and progressively improving the structure and quality of data as it flows through each layer of the architecture.
Which term is used to describe this data design pattern?
opts: Medallion architecture
Change data feed
Delta Lake
Data mesh
q_zh: 数据架构师通知分析团队，组织将采用一种数据设计模式来在湖仓中逻辑组织数据，目标是渐进式地提高数据质量。这个架构叫什么？
exp_zh: 奖章架构（Medallion Architecture）将数据组织为 Bronze（原始）、Silver（清洗）和 Gold（业务级）三层，每一层逐步提高数据质量和业务可用性。它是数据湖仓中最常用的数据组织模式。

q: Which Databricks SQL action is used to audit and view the history of operations performed on a Delta Lake table in Databricks?
opts: Run a SELECT logs FROM table_name query
Use the SHOW TRANSACTIONS table_name command
Execute a VACUUM table_name statement
Use the DESCRIBE HISTORY table_name command
q_zh: 在 Databricks 中，哪个 SQL 操作用于审计和查看 Delta Lake 表上执行的操作历史？
exp_zh: DESCRIBE HISTORY table_name 命令返回 Delta 表的完整操作历史，包括每次写入、更新、删除、合并等操作的时间戳、用户、操作类型等信息，是审计和问题排查的关键工具。

q:
Despite having SELECT permission on tables and USAGE on schemas, a data analyst is unable to access the objects.
Which action enables the data analyst to access the objects?
opts: Grant OWNERSHIP of the table to the Data Analyst.
Grant MANAGE DATABASE access on the containing catalog.
Grant MANAGE TABLE access.
Grant USE CATALOG on the containing catalog.
q_zh: 尽管已拥有表的 SELECT 权限和 Schema 的 USAGE 权限，数据分析师仍无法访问这些对象。需要什么额外操作？
exp_zh: 在 Unity Catalog 的三级命名空间（Catalog → Schema → Table）中，需要在每一级都有适当的权限。缺少 USE CATALOG 权限意味着分析师无法进入 Catalog 层级，即使有下层权限也无法访问。

q:
A data analyst is reviewing the status of alerts in the Databricks SQL Alerts listing page. One alert was recently executed, and the monitored value met the defined condition and exceeded the threshold, meaning the alert criteria were met.
Which status should appear for this alert in the listing?
opts: Status: YES
Status: TRIGGERED
Status: OK
Status: SUCCESS
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在 Databricks SQL 的告警列表页面查看告警状态。一个告警最近执行后，监控值满足了定义的条件并超过了阈值。该告警的状态显示是什么？
exp_zh: 当告警的监控值满足触发条件时，状态变为 TRIGGERED（已触发）。这表示设定的阈值条件已被满足，系统已向订阅者发送通知。

q:
A data analyst wants to compare the contents of a Delta table as they existed last week to the current state in order to track changes in sales records.
Which Delta Lake feature enables this comparison?
opts: RESTORE command
VACUUM retention settings
Time travel querying
CLONE with VERSION AS OF
q_zh: 一位数据分析师想比较一周前的 Delta 表内容与当前状态，以跟踪销售记录的变化。哪个 Delta Lake 功能支持此操作？
exp_zh: 时间旅行查询（Time Travel）允许使用 VERSION AS OF 或 TIMESTAMP AS OF 语法查询 Delta 表的历史版本。分析师可以直接查询一周前的数据快照并与当前数据对比，无需预先创建备份。

q:
A data analyst wants to generate insights from large, complex datasets. The analyst needs to quickly understand the meaning of various data columns, ask questions in natural language, and receive AI-driven recommendations for optimizing data queries and workflows.
Which Databricks component is primarily responsible for enabling these capabilities?
opts: Data Intelligence Engine
Unity Catalog
Genie Spaces
Databricks Assistant
q_zh: 一位数据分析师想从大型复杂数据集中生成洞察，需要快速理解各数据列的含义、用自然语言提问并获得 AI 驱动的建议。应使用 Databricks 的哪个功能？
exp_zh: Data Intelligence Engine（数据智能引擎）是 Databricks 的核心 AI 引擎，提供对数据的语义理解、自然语言查询和智能建议。它是支撑 Genie、Assistant 等功能的底层智能平台。

q:
A data analyst filters rows where the tags array includes the value ‘sql’ using this query:
SELECT * FROM main.analytics.articles WHERE tags = ‘sql’;
This query returns no results.
How should the analyst query to filter for rows where the tags array contains ‘sql’?
opts: SELECT * FROM main.analytics.articles WHERE tags IN (‘sql’);
SELECT * FROM main.analytics.articles WHERE tags LIKE ‘%sql%’;
SELECT * FROM main.analytics.articles WHERE ‘sql’ IN tags;
SELECT * FROM main.analytics.articles WHERE array_conatins (tags, ‘sql’);
q_zh: 一位数据分析师使用 WHERE tags = 'sql' 过滤 tags 数组列中包含 'sql' 值的行，但查询返回空结果。应如何修改查询？
exp_zh: 数组列不能直接用 = 与标量值比较。正确的方式是使用 IN 操作符：WHERE 'sql' IN tags，检查标量值是否存在于数组中。也可以使用 array_contains(tags, 'sql') 函数。

q:
A data analyst needs to programmatically mark a Unity Catalog table, sales_data, as certified so that it is discoverable as a trusted asset across their organization.
Which SQL command can be used to meet the requirement?
opts: ALTER TABLE sales_data SET TAGS (‘system.Certified’);
ALTER TABLE sales_data SET TAGS (‘certified’ = ‘true’);
GRANT CERTIFY ON TABLE sales_data TO analyst_group;
UPDATE TABLE sales_data ADD COMMENT ‘Certified dataset’;
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要以编程方式将 Unity Catalog 表 sales_data 标记为已认证（Certified），使其作为受信任资产在组织中被发现。应使用哪个 SQL 命令？
exp_zh: ALTER TABLE sales_data SET TAGS ('certified' = 'true'); 使用 Unity Catalog 的标签功能为表添加认证标记。标签是键值对形式，可以被搜索和过滤，帮助用户识别已认证的可信数据资产。

q:
A data analyst is troubleshooting a query in Databricks SQL that fails when processing large datasets and complex join operations. Logs indicate that the job consistently aborts due to resource constraint errors on the cluster.
Which Query Profile metric should the analyst use to identify the operator that is causing resource overuse?
opts: Time spent per operator
Shuffle read size per operator
Memory peak per operator
Bytes spilled to disk per operator
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在排查一个在处理大型数据集和复杂 JOIN 操作时失败的查询。日志显示作业因资源限制而终止。哪个 Query Profile 指标最有助于诊断问题？
exp_zh: Memory Peak per Operator（每个操作符的内存峰值）是诊断资源不足问题的关键指标。当查询因内存不足而终止时，查看各操作符的内存峰值可以找出消耗内存最多的操作，从而针对性优化。

q:
A data analyst encounters an unclear error while running a SQL query in the Databricks SQL Editor. The analyst wants to quickly understand and resolve the issue.
How can Databricks Assistant help the analyst diagnose and fix the error?
opts: Databricks Assistant requires switching to a notebook environment to provide any debugging support.
Databricks Assistant only supports Python code and cannot help with SQL queries.
Databricks Assistant can only create new queries and does not assist with debugging.
Databricks Assistant can analyze the error, suggest solutions, and provide corrected code directly in the SQL Editor.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在 SQL Editor 中运行查询时遇到不明错误，想快速理解并解决问题。Databricks Assistant 如何帮助？
exp_zh: Databricks Assistant 可以直接在 SQL Editor 中分析错误信息、建议解决方案并提供修正后的代码。无需切换到其他环境，它能够理解 SQL 错误上下文并给出针对性的修复建议。

q:
A BI analyst is building an analytical data model in Databricks using Delta Lake tables. The source system contains transactional sales data that changes frequently. The analyst chooses to apply the Data Vault 2.0 methodology to manage historical changes while ensuring scalability and auditability across multiple business domains.
Which component is used to capture the many-to-many relationship between hubs in a Data Vault v2 model?
opts: Hub Table
Satellite Table
Link Table
Reference Table
q_zh: 一位 BI 分析师在 Databricks 中使用 Delta Lake 表构建分析数据模型。源系统包含频繁变化的交易销售数据。分析师选择应用 Data Vault 建模方法。哪种表类型用于捕获实体之间的关系？
exp_zh: 在 Data Vault 模型中，Link Table（链接表）用于捕获实体之间的关系和交互。Hub 存储业务键，Satellite 存储描述性属性，而 Link 连接不同的 Hub 来表示业务关系。

q:
A data analyst is using Databricks Unity Catalog. The datasets are tagged by sensitivity, and confidential data is marked with the tag key confidential. The data analyst needs to quickly find all tables tagged as confidential to review their access permissions in the Databricks workspace search bar.
Which search key text should the data analyst use to find these tables?
opts: confidential:true
tag=confidential
tag:confidential
search tag = ‘confidential’
q_zh: 一位数据分析师使用 Unity Catalog，数据集按敏感度标记，机密数据标记为 confidential。分析师需要快速找到所有标记为 confidential 的表。在 Catalog Explorer 搜索栏中应使用什么搜索语法？
exp_zh: 在 Catalog Explorer 中使用 tag:confidential 语法可以按标签搜索数据对象。这是 Unity Catalog 提供的标签搜索功能，帮助用户快速定位具有特定标签的表、视图等。

q: How are analytical models mapped to the Gold layer in the Delta Lake medallion architecture on Databricks?
opts: The Gold layer is primarily used for storing backup copies of all data for disaster recovery purposes.
The Gold layer stores raw, unprocessed data for initial ingestion and schema evolution.
The Gold layer is used for data cleaning, deduplication, and joining across domains to establish data integrity.
The Gold layer contains de-normalized data models optimized for analytics, reporting, and machine learning.
q_zh: 分析模型如何映射到 Delta Lake 奖章架构中的 Gold 层？
exp_zh: Gold 层包含面向分析优化的反规范化数据模型，用于支持报表、仪表板和机器学习。数据在此层已经过充分清洗、聚合和业务逻辑转换，可以直接被分析工具消费。

q:
A data analyst team is building reliable, production-grade data pipelines on Databricks. They require a solution that allows them to define data transformations declaratively, automatically enforce data quality expectations, and handle errors without manual intervention.
Which Databricks capability addresses these requirements?
opts: Lakeflow Tables
Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines
Lakeflow Jobs
Lakeflow Connect
q_zh: 一个数据分析团队正在 Databricks 上构建可靠的生产级数据管道，需要声明式定义数据转换、自动强制执行数据质量并管理管道依赖。应使用哪个工具？
exp_zh: Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines（原 Delta Live Tables）允许用声明式方式定义数据转换，自动管理依赖关系，并内置数据质量检查（Expectations）。它简化了生产级管道的开发和维护。

q:
A data analyst has configured a Delta table with default retention settings. The analyst runs VACUUM operations weekly to manage storage costs. A business user asks to access data from 10 days ago for a compliance audit.
What is the result of a time travel query in this scenario?
operations have likely removed the required data files.
opts: The time travel query will succeed because Delta Lake automatically backs up data for compliance purposes, regardless of VACUUM operations.
The time travel query will succeed because the default log retention period is 30 days, which is sufficient to access 10-day-old data.
The time travel query will fail because the default maximum table version is 7 and numbering resets after each VACUUM operation, making historical versions inaccessible.
The time travel query will fail because the default data file retention period is 7 days, and VACUUM
q_zh: 一位数据分析师使用默认保留设置配置了 Delta 表，每周运行 VACUUM 操作。业务用户要求访问 10 天前的数据进行合规审计。时间旅行查询是否能成功？
exp_zh: 时间旅行查询将失败。Delta Lake 默认数据文件保留期为 7 天，VACUUM 操作会清理超过保留期的旧数据文件。由于请求的是 10 天前的数据且已经运行了 VACUUM，相关数据文件已被删除。

q:
A data analyst is preparing a dataset that includes customer information such as email addresses and birthdates. This dataset will be used by multiple teams for generating reports, but some teams should not have permissions to access sensitive data. The analyst must ensure the data is stored securely and that personally identifiable information (PII) is protected according to organizational standards and best practices in Databricks.
Which action should the analyst take to secure the PII data while allowing safe reporting access to other teams?
opts: Grant SELECT privileges to all report writers for the required subset of data from the base table.
Use Dynamic Views with IS_MEMBER() functions to restrict PII columns based on user roles.
Store the PII data in a shared CSV file on DBFS and apply access control at the folder level.
Mask PII data by obfuscating it in the source table before conducting analysis.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在准备包含客户邮箱和生日等信息的数据集，多个团队会使用该数据生成报表，但某些团队不应看到 PII 数据。应如何处理？
exp_zh: 使用动态视图（Dynamic Views）结合 IS_MEMBER() 函数可以根据用户所属的角色组动态控制 PII 列的可见性。不同角色的用户查询同一视图时会看到不同的结果，实现了细粒度的列级访问控制。

opts: The table sales_data exists in the reporting schema of the corp_data catalog.
The analyst has SELECT and USAGE privileges on the corp_data.reporting.sales_data table.
Another user running the same query in a notebook attached to a cluster is able to retrieve results without fully qualifying the table.
Set the spark.databricks.sql.initial.catalog.namespace Spark configuration in the cluster attached to the SQL Warehouse.
Run the following command to set the default catalog and schema for the current session:
Modify the workspace-level catalog default so that all SQL Warehouses automatically point to
Set spark.sql.default.database to corp_data.reporting.sales_data in the SQL Warehouse runtime configuration.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在启用了 Unity Catalog 的 Databricks 工作区中，使用共享 SQL Warehouse 运行 SELECT * FROM sales_data; 查询报错。以下哪些陈述有助于解释和解决此问题？
exp_zh: 分析师需要对 corp_data.reporting.sales_data 表拥有 SELECT 和 USAGE 权限。在 Unity Catalog 中，查询表需要在三级命名空间（Catalog、Schema、Table）上都有相应权限才能成功访问。

q: How are privileges inherited in Unity Catalog across the hierarchy levels of metastore, catalog, schema, and table/view?
opts: Privileges granted at a higher level (such as a catalog) automatically apply to all child objects (schemas and tables) unless overridden by more specific permissions at a lower level.
Privileges are only inherited from the metastore level, and no inheritance occurs between catalogs, schemas, or tables.
Privileges must be granted individually for each object, regardless of their position in the hierarchy, to ensure secure access control.
Privileges granted at the schema level have no impact on tables or views in that schema unless directly applied to them.
q_zh: Unity Catalog 中的权限如何在 Metastore、Catalog、Schema 和 Table/View 层级之间继承？
exp_zh: 在 Unity Catalog 中，权限自上而下自动继承。在较高层级（如 Catalog）授予的权限会自动应用于其所有子对象（Schema 和 Table）。这简化了权限管理，无需逐个对象单独设置。

q:
A data analyst needs to create a table in Unity Catalog for a production analytics workload. The table will be frequently queried and needs automatic performance optimization. The data should be governed by Unity Catalog with lifecycle management.
Which approach should the data analyst use?
opts: Create a foreign table using CREATE FOREIGN TABLE with external connections to maintain compatibility with external systems while keeping data in original location and get benefits like Liquid Clustering and Deletion Vectors.

Create a managed table using CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name (columns...) allowing Unity Catalog to manage the data lifecycle, storage location, and provide automatic optimizations like Predictive Optimization.
Create a temporary table using CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE for better performance and then convert it to a managed table later using ALTER TABLE SET MANAGED.
Create an external table using CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE catalog.schema.table_name LOCATION ‘s3://bucket/path/’ to maintain control over the data location while benefiting from Unity Catalog governance.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要在 Unity Catalog 中为生产分析工作负载创建一个表，要求频繁查询且需要自动性能优化，数据由 Unity Catalog 管理。应如何创建？
exp_zh: 创建托管表（Managed Table）使用 CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name (columns...)。托管表的数据由 Unity Catalog 完全管理，自动享受 Delta Lake 的性能优化特性（如文件压缩、统计信息收集等）。

q:
A data analyst team is working with large datasets stored as Delta tables (Parquet format) in Databricks on Azure Data Lake. The teams want to speed up query performance and reduce repeated computation by leveraging caching. However, they notice that sometimes caching does not improve performance or even slows down queries. The team wants to understand the best practices and limitations of caching in Databricks to optimize their workflows.
What is the limitation when using caching in Databricks to reduce development time and query latency?
opts: Query result caching in Databricks SQL works best with non-deterministic queries that use functions like NOW() or RAND().
Caching CSV or JSON files with Delta Cache is fully supported and recommended for best performance.
Delta Cache (disk cache) automatically caches Parquet files on local SSDs and improves read performance, but only supports Parquet files stored on Azure Blob Storage or Azure Data Lake.
Spark caching always improves performance and should be applied liberally to all dataframes regardless of size or query complexity.
q_zh: 一个数据分析团队使用存储在 Azure Data Lake 上的 Delta 表（Parquet 格式），想加速查询性能并减少重复计算。关于 Databricks 的缓存机制，哪个说法是正确的？
exp_zh: Delta Cache（磁盘缓存）自动将 Parquet 文件缓存到本地 SSD 上以提升读取性能，但仅支持 Parquet 格式。它不需要手动管理，与 Spark 缓存不同，Delta Cache 在工作节点级别自动工作。

q:
A data analyst needs to share a certified dataset containing approved public economic indicators with an external research institution. The institution does not have access to the Databricks workspace. The dataset is managed in Unity Catalog and has already been reviewed and tagged appropriately.
The analyst’s requirements are:
How should the analyst share the dataset?
opts: Share the dataset securely and read-only
Ensure the institution receives only the specified tables
Avoid giving access to the full catalog or workspace
Maintain auditability and governance using Unity Catalog
Grant the external users access to Unity Catalog by adding their emails to the workspace.
Use COPY INTO to export the dataset into a managed Delta table, then use Unity Catalog’s GRANT SELECT to provide access to the institution.
Use the GRANT SELECT command to give the external group’s principal access to the table.

Create a Delta Share, add the required table, define a recipient, and ensure that a Unity Catalog metastore admin or privileged user in the recipient’s workspace grants appropriate access permissions to their users.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要将包含已批准公共经济指标的认证数据集与外部研究机构共享。该机构没有 Databricks 工作区访问权限。需要满足安全只读共享、仅共享指定表、不开放完整 Catalog、保持审计能力等要求。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 创建 Delta Share，添加所需表，定义接收者，由 Unity Catalog Metastore 管理员配置。Delta Sharing 是一个安全的数据共享协议，允许在不同组织之间共享数据而无需复制，同时保持完整的审计跟踪和治理能力。

q:
A data analyst is monitoring delivery delays in real time using a Databricks dashboard shared with the operations team. After a meeting, the manager asks to add a new widget that graphically displays, with a gauge, the percentage of on-time shipments compared to the total. The data analyst needs to quickly modify the dashboard to add this information element.
How should the analyst add a new widget to an existing dashboard in Databricks?
dashboard after review.
opts: Export the data from a notebook as a static image and upload it to the dashboard as a visual reference.
Ask a platform administrator to add a materialized view for the on-time percentage, since visualizations require pre-aggregated values from the source to display correctly.
Click “Add Visualization” in the dashboard, select the desired type, and associate a query that calculates the requested percentage.
Clone the existing dashboard, add the new visualization in the duplicate, and replace the original
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在监控配送延迟的实时仪表板。会后经理要求添加一个新的可视化组件来展示准时配送百分比。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 在仪表板中点击 Add Visualization，选择所需的可视化类型，并关联计算所需指标的查询。这是在现有仪表板中添加新可视化组件的标准流程，无需克隆仪表板或创建物化视图。

q:
A data analyst needs to improve the performance of a daily sales report that aggregates data from a large transactions table. The report is run multiple times a day, but the underlying data only changes once daily.
Which approach should the analyst use to improve performance while minimizing redundant computation?
opts: Use a standard view and schedule a notebook to cache results.
Create a materialized view that precomputes the daily sales aggregation.
Use a dynamic view to compute the aggregation on each query.
Set up a streaming table to ingest new sales data in real time.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要提升每日销售报告的性能，该报告从大型交易表中聚合数据。报告每天运行多次，但底层数据每天只更新一次。应使用哪种方案？
exp_zh: 物化视图（Materialized View）预先计算并存储聚合结果，在底层数据更新时自动增量刷新。对于查询频率远高于数据更新频率的场景，物化视图可以显著减少重复计算，提升查询性能。

q:
A data analyst discovers that a group named developers has unauthorized access to sensitive data within the Unity Catalog catalog finance_catalog, which should be accessible only by the finance team.
Which SQL command should the analyst use to remove the developers group’s access to the catalog?
opts: GRANT USAGE ON CATALOG ‘finance_catalog’ TO ‘finance’;
ALTER CATALOG ‘finance_catalog’ DROP PERMISSIONS FOR ‘developers’;
REVOKE USAGE ON CATALOG ‘finance_catalog’ FROM ‘developers’;
REVOKE USE ON CATALOG ‘finance_catalog’ FROM ‘developers’;
q_zh: 一位数据分析师发现名为 developers 的组未经授权访问了 finance_catalog 中的敏感数据，该 Catalog 应仅对 finance 团队开放。应使用哪个命令撤销访问？
exp_zh: REVOKE USAGE ON CATALOG 'finance_catalog' FROM 'developers'; 使用 REVOKE 命令撤销 developers 组对该 Catalog 的 USAGE 权限。注意关键字是 USAGE（而非 USE），语法是 REVOKE...FROM。

q:
A data analyst needs to join two tables, orders and customers, using both customer_id and
region_id as join keys. The goal is to return only rows where both values match in the two tables. Which SQL query correctly performs this join?
opts: SELECT * FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id;
SELECT * FROM orders INNER JOIN customers USING (customer_id, region_id);
SELECT * FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id AND orders.region_id = customers.region_id;
SELECT * FROM orders LEFT JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id AND orders.region_id = customers.region_id;
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要使用 customer_id 和 region_id 两个键来 JOIN orders 和 customers 表，只返回两个值都匹配的行。应使用哪个 SQL 查询？
exp_zh: 使用 INNER JOIN 配合 ON 子句中用 AND 连接两个条件：orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id AND orders.region_id = customers.region_id。这确保只有两个键都匹配的行才会出现在结果中。

q:
A data analyst is reviewing a Genie space used by operations managers and notices that multiple responses have been flagged as inaccurate.
Which action should the analyst take to improve performance?
opts: Add more tables and columns to the space because increasing the data volume improves Genie’s ability to find the correct answers.
Update the instructions and add example SQL queries because this guides Genie to generate correct and context-aware responses.
Turn off the feedback feature because it prevents noise from influencing Genie’s learning mechanism.
Delete the flagged responses because this clears prior data that is biasing Genie’s answer generation.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在审查运营经理使用的 Genie 空间时，发现多个回答被标记为不准确。应采取什么措施来改善？
exp_zh: 更新指令（Instructions）并添加示例 SQL 查询可以指导 Genie 生成正确且符合业务上下文的回答。领域特定的指令和示例帮助 Genie 理解业务术语和数据关系，从而提高回答准确性。

q:
A data analyst needs to programmatically mark the sales_data table in Unity Catalog as deprecated so that users across their organization can clearly see that it is no longer recommended for use.
Which SQL command should they use?
opts: ALTER TABLE sales_data SET TAGS (‘deprecated’ = ‘true’);
UPDATE TABLE sales_data ADD COMMENT ‘Deprecated dataset’;
ALTER TABLE sales_data SET TBLPROPERTIES (‘system. certification_status’=‘deprecated’);
ALTER TABLE sales_data SET TAGS (‘system.certification_status’ = ‘deprecated’);
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要以编程方式将 Unity Catalog 中的 sales_data 表标记为已弃用（Deprecated），使组织中的用户清楚知道该表不再推荐使用。应使用哪个 SQL 命令？
exp_zh: ALTER TABLE sales_data SET TAGS ('system.certification_status' = 'deprecated'); 使用系统级标签 system.certification_status 来标记表的认证状态。这是 Unity Catalog 的标准做法，使弃用信息在 Catalog Explorer 中可见。

q:
A data analyst is curating a Genie space for the marketing team to explore campaign performance data. To
ensure accurate and context-aware responses, the analyst includes curated Unity Catalog tables, writes clear domain instructions, and adds sample questions.
Which additional step can the analyst take to maximize trust and reuse of frequently asked queries?
opts: Disable the use of domain instructions to prevent bias in AI-generated answers.
Mark commonly used queries as Trusted Assets after verifying their correctness.
Enable automatic query generation so users receive instant responses without review.
Allow users to edit the underlying datasets to improve Genie responses.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在为营销团队策划 Genie 空间以探索活动效果数据。为确保准确且上下文感知的回答，应如何优化？
exp_zh: 将常用查询验证正确后标记为 Trusted Assets（受信资产）。经过验证的受信查询作为 Genie 生成回答的参考基准，确保生成的 SQL 查询准确反映业务逻辑。

opts: Each category contains more than 10 products.
The average price of products in the category is greater than $50.
SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >
SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE COUNT(*) > 10 GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(price) > 50;
SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 GROUP BY
SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category WHERE COUNT(*) >
q_zh: 一位数据分析师想筛选满足两个条件的产品类别：每个类别包含超过 10 个产品，且类别中产品的平均价格大于 $50。应使用哪个 SQL 语句？
exp_zh: 正确答案使用 GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 AND AVG(price) > 50。HAVING 子句用于对聚合结果进行过滤，而 WHERE 用于过滤原始行。两个聚合条件都应放在 HAVING 中。

q:
A data analyst wants to implement a use case that requires managing both structured and unstructured data.
How will Unity Catalog help in this scenario?
opts: It allows for the management of both structured data and unstructured data through objects such as tables and volumes.
It requires all unstructured data to be converted into Delta Lake format before it can be managed.
It can catalog data coming from relational databases, excluding files and non-tabular data.
It manages structured data in tabular format and unstructured files like images in blob storage.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要实现一个同时管理结构化和非结构化数据的用例。Unity Catalog 如何在此场景中提供帮助？
exp_zh: Unity Catalog 通过表（Tables）管理结构化数据，通过卷（Volumes）管理非结构化数据（如图片、PDF、日志文件等）。这实现了对所有类型数据资产的统一治理和发现。

q:
A data analyst is working with a Unity Catalog table named sales_data that contains customer order information. The order_quantity column is defined as an INTEGER, but occasionally has values of -1, indicating a data entry error. To support accurate reporting, the analyst needs to create a new view named clean_sales_data, that excludes these erroneous entries.
Which SQL query creates the clean_sales_data view by filtering out records where order_quantity
is -1?
opts: CREATE VIEW clean_sales_data AS SELECT * FROM sales_data WHERE order_quantity IS NOT NULL AND order_quantity > 0;
CREATE VIEW clean_sales_data AS SELECT * FROM sales_data WHERE ABS (order_quantity) != 1;
CREATE VIEW clean_sales_data AS SELECT * FROM sales_data HAVING order_quantity != -1;
CREATE VIEW clean_sales_data AS SELECT * FROM sales_data WHERE order_quantity != -1;
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在使用 Unity Catalog 表 sales_data，其中 order_quantity 列定义为 INTEGER 但偶尔有 -1 值表示数据缺失。分析师需要创建一个排除 -1 值的清洗视图。应使用哪个命令？
exp_zh: CREATE VIEW clean_sales_data AS SELECT * FROM sales_data WHERE order_quantity != -1; 直接过滤掉 -1 值。注意题目说 -1 表示缺失而非 NULL，因此只需用 != -1 而非 IS NOT NULL 来过滤。

q:
A data analyst is building a parameterized SQL query in Databricks to filter sales data by region and year. The analyst wants to test the query with different parameter values before adding it to a dashboard.
Which approach should the analyst use to allow for dynamic testing of the parameters in the Databricks SQL editor?
opts: Hard-code the region and year values directly into the SQL query and rerun it for each test.
Use parameter markers (e.g., :region, :year) in the SQL query and enter their values in the input boxes before running the query.
Replace the column names (e.g., region, year) with question marks (“?”) and expect Databricks to prompt for values at runtime.
Add the parameters as variables in a Python notebook cell and reference them in the SQL query.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在 Databricks 中构建参数化 SQL 查询来按区域和年份过滤销售数据。分析师想在添加到仪表板前用不同参数值测试查询。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 在 SQL 查询中使用参数标记（如 :region、:year），运行前在输入框中输入参数值。Databricks SQL Editor 支持命名参数，可以方便地修改参数值反复测试，无需修改查询本身。

q:
What is the primary role of a SQL Warehouse in Databricks?
powered by the Photon engine for accelerated performance and optimized for BI tool integration
opts: SQL Warehouses are primarily used for ETL operations and data transformations, offering better performance for batch processing compared to interactive queries
SQL Warehouses are specialized compute resources designed specifically for SQL query execution,
SQL Warehouses are general-purpose compute resources that support Python, Scala, R, and SQL workloads, with automatic library management and custom runtime configurations for enhanced performance
SQL Warehouses function as data storage systems that maintain cached query results and provide direct access to Delta tables without requiring additional compute resources
q_zh: SQL Warehouse 在 Databricks 中的主要角色是什么？
exp_zh: SQL Warehouse 是专门为 SQL 查询执行设计的计算资源，由 Photon 引擎提供加速，并针对 BI 工具集成进行了优化。它不是通用计算或存储系统，而是专注于高性能 SQL 工作负载。

q:
