A data analyst is setting up a Genie space in Databricks.
Which sequence should the analyst use for defining reasonable sample questions to help guide user interactions and improve Genie’s accuracy?
opts: Create a dedicated notebook for each sample question, write the corresponding SQL query in the notebook, and link these notebooks to the Genie space using a workspace object reference.
Navigate to “Configure” > “Settings” and enter the sample questions directly into the “Description” field. Genie automatically parses this text to guide users.
Upload a spreadsheet with sample questions to the space, manually map each question to a SQL query in a separate document, and periodically update the mappings as new questions arise.
Click “Configure” > “Context” in the Genie space, use the “SQL Queries” tab to add sample questions and matching SQL, then review and resolve any inconsistencies in the guidance provided.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在设置 Genie 空间。应按什么流程来定义合理的示例问题以引导用户交互并提高 Genie 的准确性？
exp_zh: 在 Genie 空间中点击 Configure > Context，使用 SQL Queries 标签页添加示例问题和对应的 SQL 查询，然后标记为 Trusted Assets。这确保 Genie 以经过验证的查询为参考来回答类似问题。

q:
A data analyst has noticed that a key dashboard is loading slowly and suspects a specific SQL query may be causing performance issues. To diagnose the root cause, the analyst wants to review query execution characteristics, such as execution time, data scanned, and rows processed over time. The analyst is using the Databricks SQL environment and has access to admin tools and workspace objects.
How should the analyst investigate query performance over time?
opts: Use the SQL Dashboard Editor to identify slow-performing queries by reviewing visualization types and layout.
Use Lakehouse Monitoring to view real-time alerts and trends across all data pipelines that run in Unity Catalog.
Use the Query Profiler to examine long-term trends in query performance across multiple executions.
Use Query Insights to view metrics, such as duration, rows read, and execution history for the query.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师注意到关键仪表板加载缓慢，怀疑某个 SQL 查询导致了性能问题。想查看查询执行详细信息。应使用什么工具？
exp_zh: Query Insights 提供了查询的详细指标，包括执行时长、读取的行数、执行历史等信息。它帮助分析师快速定位性能瓶颈，是诊断慢查询的首选工具。

q:
A BI analyst has created a Genie space containing customer sales data and needs to share it with external stakeholders who are not workspace members. The stakeholders require the ability to ask questions about the data but should not have access to the underlying Databricks workspace or compute resources.
How should the BI analyst share the Genie space with external stakeholders?
permissions on the Genie space.
opts: Share the Genie space with embedded credentials and assign the stakeholders as account users with published dashboard access.
Export the Genie space data to CSV files and share via email with instructions to upload to their own Databricks workspace.
Create individual workspace accounts for each stakeholder and assign Databricks SQL access entitlement with CAN RUN permissions.
Grant the stakeholders workspace membership with Consumer access entitlement and CAN VIEW
q_zh: 一位 BI 分析师创建了包含客户销售数据的 Genie 空间，需要与非工作区成员的外部利益相关者共享。利益相关者需要能提问和查看可视化。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 通过共享带有嵌入凭据的 Genie 空间，并将利益相关者设为账户用户且赋予已发布仪表板的访问权限。这使得外部用户可以在不拥有完整工作区访问权限的情况下使用 Genie 空间。

q:
A company uses a star schema to analyze sales data. The sales fact table records transactions, and dimension tables include products, stores, and dates.
How are primary and foreign keys used to enable efficient joining between these tables?
opts: The fact table and dimension tables are joined using arbitrary columns, and primary/foreign key relationships are not required in a star schema.
The fact table contains primary keys that directly match the primary keys in each dimension table, allowing for one-to-one joins.
Both fact and dimension tables use only foreign keys, and joins are performed using non-unique columns.
Each dimension table has a primary key, which is referenced as a foreign key in the fact table. This structure allows the fact table to join with multiple dimension tables for analytical queries.
q_zh: 一家公司使用星型模式分析销售数据。销售事实表记录交易，维度表包括产品、门店和日期。主键和外键如何用于实现跨表分析查询？
exp_zh: 在星型模式中，每个维度表有自己的主键，事实表通过外键引用这些主键。这种结构允许通过 JOIN 将事实表与多个维度表连接，实现跨维度的灵活分析查询。

q:
A BI analyst is designing a Databricks SQL dashboard that tracks monthly revenue for three product categories across two years. Leadership wants a chart that makes it straightforward to compare each category’s trend over time and quickly spot seasonal patterns or declines without relying on additional filters or calculations.
Which visualization type in Databricks SQL will clearly communicate the revenue trends and category comparisons described?
opts: Multi-series line chart plotting month on the x-axis and revenue on the y-axis for each category.
Single-value counter displaying combined revenue for the entire two-year period.
Pie chart showing each category’s percentage of total revenue for the final month.
Scatter chart with revenue on the x-axis and profit margin on the y-axis for all transactions.
q_zh: 一位 BI 分析师正在设计 Databricks SQL 仪表板，跟踪三个产品类别在两年内的月度收入。领导层希望图表能直观比较各类别的月度趋势。应选择什么可视化类型？
exp_zh: 多系列折线图以月份为 X 轴、收入为 Y 轴，为每个产品类别各画一条线。这是比较多个类别随时间变化趋势的最佳可视化方式，能清晰展示各类别的走势和对比关系。

q:
A data engineer is ingesting large volumes of semi-structured log data stored in an S3 bucket into Databricks. The data arrives continuously throughout the day, and the engineer needs to implement an efficient, scalable solution that supports incremental loads, handles schema changes gracefully, and minimizes manual intervention.
Which approach should be used for ingesting this data?
opts: Build a custom Spark Structured Streaming job that tracks processed files via checkpointing and manual schema management.
Use Auto Loader to incrementally ingest data from S3.
Build a custom API-driven ingestion pipeline to pull data from S3.
Use Delta Sharing to share data with Databricks from external systems.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在将存储在 S3 中的大量半结构化日志数据导入 Databricks。数据全天持续到达，需要实现增量、高效且自动处理新文件的摄取方案。应使用什么工具？
exp_zh: Auto Loader 自动增量检测和摄取云存储中的新文件，通过文件通知或目录列表方式发现新数据。它自动处理 Schema 推断和演化，无需手动管理已处理文件的状态。

q:
A data analyst needs to quickly estimate the number of unique user sessions in a dataset containing billions of records on Databricks SQL. Due to performance constraints, the analyst must ensure the query runs efficiently and delivers results with acceptable accuracy.
What is the primary advantage of using APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT instead of COUNT_DISTINCT in this scenario?
opts: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT provides exact counts, while COUNT DISTINCT only provides estimates.
APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT can only be used with string columns, while COUNT DISTINCT works with numeric columns.
APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT uses the HyperLogLog++ algorithm to provide fast approximate counts with configurable accuracy (default 5% relative standard deviation).
APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT requires less memory by storing only the first 1000 unique values.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要在包含数十亿条记录的数据集上快速估算唯一用户会话数。由于性能限制，需要在精确度和速度之间取得平衡。APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT 与 COUNT DISTINCT 有何区别？
exp_zh: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT 使用 HyperLogLog++ 算法提供快速近似计数，精度可配置。相比 COUNT DISTINCT 需要精确去重，APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT 在海量数据上速度快得多，误差通常在 2% 以内。

q:
A data analyst is evaluating options to optimize query performance on a large table with frequently changing query filters. The analyst is considering using Liquid Clustering versus traditional Hive-style partitioning.
What is the primary advantage of Liquid Clustering over traditional partitioning for tables with evolving query patterns?
opts: Liquid Clustering provides better compression ratios than partitioned tables, reducing storage costs.
Liquid Clustering allows changing clustering columns without rewriting existing data, while partitioning requires reprocessing and rewriting data to change the partitioning structure.
Liquid Clustering automatically creates backup copies of data files, while partitioning does not.
Liquid Clustering supports more data types than partitioning, including nested structures and arrays.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在评估优化大表查询性能的选项。分析师比较 Liquid Clustering 和传统 Hive 分区。两者的关键区别是什么？
exp_zh: Liquid Clustering 允许在不重写现有数据的情况下更改聚类列，而传统分区更改需要重建整个表。这种灵活性使得 Liquid Clustering 特别适合查询模式经常变化的场景。

q:
A data analyst is configuring a Genie space to support natural language questions about product sales, including fields like region_code, sku, and channel_type. The analyst notices that Genie often generates ambiguous or incorrect queries due to unclear column meanings.
Which two actions will help to improve Genie’s accuracy and relevance when interpreting user questions? (Choose two.)
opts: Provide sample values for ambiguous columns to help Genie infer the data’s meaning and usage.
Write domain-specific instructions that describe how terms like region and channel relate to the business.
Add more columns from the underlying tables to give Genie access to a broader set of data points for reasoning.
Add descriptions to columns using Unity Catalog so Genie can use them as context during query generation.
Include example queries that reflect how business users refer to the data in everyday language.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在配置 Genie 空间以支持关于产品销售的自然语言问题，涉及 region_code、sku 和 channel_type 等字段。分析师发现 Genie 经常误解这些字段。应如何改善？
exp_zh: 正确做法是：(B) 编写领域特定指令描述 region 和 channel 等术语与业务的关系，以及 (D) 在 Unity Catalog 中为列添加描述以便 Genie 在生成查询时使用上下文信息。两者结合可以显著提高 Genie 的理解准确性。

q:
A data analyst is preparing a quarterly analytics dashboard in Databricks and needs to share it with external stakeholders who are not members of the Databricks workspace. The stakeholders should be able to view the dashboard securely without being granted workspace access or edit permissions.
Which approach should the analyst use to meet the requirements?
permissions on the dashboard, even if they are not currently members of the workspace.
opts: Enable external sharing by publishing the dashboard, turning on embedded credentials, and sharing the link with stakeholders.
Add the external stakeholders as workspace admins in the Databricks environment and grant them CAN MANAGE permissions on the dashboard.
Assign the stakeholders to the All workspace users group and provide them with CAN EDIT
Export the dashboard as a PDF file and email it to the stakeholders, since Databricks dashboards offer an export-to-PDF feature.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在准备季度分析仪表板，需要与非 Databricks 工作区成员的外部利益相关者共享。利益相关者应能查看但不能编辑。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 通过发布仪表板、启用嵌入凭据并将链接分享给利益相关者来实现外部共享。嵌入凭据允许非工作区用户通过链接访问仪表板而无需拥有 Databricks 账户。

q:
A data analyst is setting up a new AI/BI Genie space in Databricks to support natural language querying and ensure high-quality, governed responses.
Which component is essential for configuring an effective Genie space that returns accurate and useful results?
opts: An external data warehouse configured to store and replicate all data used by the Genie space.
A standalone chatbot application integrated with Databricks through custom APIs for user interaction.
Well-annotated datasets registered to Unity Catalog, curated sample queries, and domain-specific instructions to guide natural language translation.
A dedicated physical server allocated for the Genie space to maximize availability and scalability.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在设置新的 AI/BI Genie 空间以支持自然语言查询并确保高质量、受治理的回答。配置有效 Genie 空间的关键组件是什么？
exp_zh: 有效的 Genie 空间需要：在 Unity Catalog 中注册且有良好注释的数据集、精心策划的示例查询，以及领域特定的指令来指导 Genie 的理解和回答生成。这三要素缺一不可。

q:
A company has started using the Databricks Platform and currently has only one workspace. They need to manage data access across different teams and want to ensure proper isolation and security controls.
Given this setup, which approach should be used?
opts: Create a unique catalog with all schemas inside of it.
Use Unity Catalog’s built-in environment separation features.
Create a schema and share the schema for production, development, and testing.
Create a catalog for production, another for development, and another for testing.
q_zh: 一家公司开始使用 Databricks 平台，目前只有一个工作区。需要管理不同团队的数据访问并确保适当的隔离和安全控制。应如何组织？
exp_zh: 为生产、开发和测试各创建一个独立的 Catalog，实现环境隔离。这是 Unity Catalog 推荐的最佳实践，通过 Catalog 级别的权限控制确保不同环境之间的数据安全隔离。

q:
A data analyst is exploring user engagement trends and wants to create a visualization while working interactively in a Databricks notebook. The analyst executes a SQL query using %sql and wants to turn the result into a line chart showing weekly user counts over time.
Which step allows the analyst to create the chart directly in the notebook?
opts: Save the query as a table, export it to Excel, and use Excel’s charting tools.
Wrap the SQL query in a Python plotly.express call using %python.
Use %sql to run the query, then copy the result into a new dashboard to access visualization options.
Use the display() function or %sql to run the query, then click the + icon in the result cell to add a visualization.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师在 Databricks Notebook 中使用 %sql 执行查询，想直接在 Notebook 内将结果转化为可视化图表。应如何操作？
exp_zh: 使用 display() 函数或 %sql 执行查询后，点击结果单元格中的 + 图标即可添加可视化。Databricks Notebook 内置了可视化功能，无需导出到外部工具。

q:
A data analyst needs to generate a sales report by joining a Unity Catalog-managed table with a table stored in a MySQL database. The analyst wants the join to be efficient, performed within Databricks, and governed using Unity Catalog permissions and lineage.
Which approach should the data analyst use to meet these requirements?
opts: Use Lakehouse Federation to create a foreign catalog for the MySQL database, then write a SQL query joining the Delta table and the federated MySQL table directly in Databricks.
Write a Python script to connect to both sources separately, download the data and join them in memory outside Databricks.
Fully ingest the MySQL table into Databricks and store it as a new Delta table before joining.
Register the MySQL table as a temporary view in Databricks using a standard Spark JDBC read, then join it with the Unity Catalog-managed table using Databricks SQL.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要将 Unity Catalog 托管表与 MySQL 数据库中的表 JOIN 生成销售报告。要求 JOIN 在 Databricks 内高效完成且无需复制数据。应使用什么方案？
exp_zh: Lakehouse Federation 允许创建外部 Catalog 连接到 MySQL 等外部数据源，然后直接在 Databricks SQL 中编写 JOIN 查询。数据无需预先导入，实现了跨数据源的联邦查询。

q:
A data analyst is enabling analytics on raw Parquet files stored in an external Amazon S3 bucket. The files must be queried directly using Databricks SQL without duplicating the data. The analyst also wants to register the table with Unity Catalog to enforce data governance policies such as access control and lineage tracking.
Which SQL command should the analyst use to create a Unity Catalog-enabled external table that directly references the Parquet files?
opts: CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name USING PARQUET AS SELECT * FROM parquet.‘s3://my-bucket/data/’;
CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name OPTIONS (‘path’ ‘s3://my-bucket/ data/’) STORED AS PARQUET;
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE catalog.schema.table_name USING DELTA LOCATION ‘s3:// my-bucket/data/’;
CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name USING PARQUET LOCATION ‘s3://my-bucket/data/’;
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要在外部 S3 存储桶中的原始 Parquet 文件上启用分析，要求直接通过 Databricks SQL 查询而不复制数据，并由 Unity Catalog 管理。应使用哪个建表命令？
exp_zh: CREATE TABLE catalog.schema.table_name USING PARQUET LOCATION 's3://my-bucket/data/'; 使用 LOCATION 指向外部 S3 路径，USING PARQUET 指定文件格式。这创建了一个由 Unity Catalog 管理元数据的外部表。

q:
A data analyst is migrating data lakehouse workloads to Databricks. The analyst manages a large table with thousands of columns and several billion rows. The analyst is concerned about scan performance, query speed, and handling the overhead of processing such a large volume of data.
In which two ways does the Photon engine help the team address these challenges? (Choose two.)
opts: Photon uses a caching layer to transcode data into a CPU-efficient format for faster scan performance.
Photon processes data row by row for maximum compatibility with legacy systems.
Photon automatically parallelizes all queries across multiple clusters without additional configuration.
Photon automatically merges small files into a single large file before processing.
Photon leverages a columnar, vectorized execution engine for efficient scan and aggregation operations.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师正在将数据湖仓工作负载迁移到 Databricks，管理一个有数千列和数十亿行的大表。分析师担心扫描性能和聚合查询的延迟。Photon 的哪些特性有助于解决这些问题？
exp_zh: A：Photon 使用缓存层将数据转码为 CPU 高效格式以加快扫描速度。E：Photon 利用列式向量化执行引擎高效完成扫描和聚合操作。两者结合使 Photon 在大规模数据处理上显著优于传统引擎。

q:
An analyst needs external datasets and analytics assets to enrich their lakehouse reporting. The organization uses Databricks with Unity Catalog enabled and wants fast, governed access to third-party data without complex ETL or replication.
What is the benefit of using Databricks Marketplace in this context?
opts: It provides a marketplace for purchasing compute resources and serverless SQL warehouses that are managed outside the Unity Catalog framework.
It enables scheduling of ETL pipelines to load partner data into proprietary formats before use in Databricks SQL.
It allows the BI Analyst to copy external datasets into their workspace for offline analysis, eliminating dependency on provider access.
It enables direct, governed access to live external data, notebooks, models, and dashboards via Delta Sharing—without data replication.
q_zh: 一位分析师需要外部数据集和分析资产来丰富湖仓报告。组织使用启用了 Unity Catalog 的 Databricks，希望快速、受治理地访问第三方数据。Databricks Marketplace 如何帮助？
exp_zh: Databricks Marketplace 通过 Delta Sharing 协议提供对外部数据、Notebook、模型和仪表板的直接治理访问，无需复制数据。它让分析师可以安全地发现和使用第三方数据资产来增强分析。

q:
A data analyst uses Databricks to create a dashboard that monitors daily sales volumes and store performance. To ensure that area managers always see up-to-date data without having to manually intervene, the data analyst wants to automate the dashboard data refresh.
Which process should the data analyst use to automatically refresh the data displayed, avoiding manual intervention?
opts: Set the Dashboard query to ‘auto-update’ by using a browser extension that reloads the tab at set intervals.
Export the dashboard as a PDF the night before, so the team can see “recent” data the next day.
Use the dashboard’s built-in scheduling option to set an automatic refresh at regular intervals.
Ask all users to press the “Refresh” button on the dashboard whenever they want updated data.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师使用 Databricks 创建了监控每日销售量和门店表现的仪表板。为确保区域经理始终看到最新数据而无需手动干预，应如何设置？
exp_zh: 使用仪表板内置的调度选项设置定期自动刷新。Databricks SQL 仪表板支持设置刷新频率（如每小时、每天），到达设定时间时自动运行查询并更新可视化，用户无需手动刷新。

q:
A data analyst needs to automate scheduled ETL jobs that ingest and transform data from multiple sources. The analyst wants to use multiple programming languages for flexibility and ensure that the pipeline can automatically handle schema changes as new data arrives.
Which approach in Databricks should be used to meet this requirement?
opts: Databricks Workflows with Apache Spark notebooks and manual schema management
Unity Catalog with manual ETL scripts and cron-based scheduling
Separate Delta tables for each data source with fixed schemas
Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines with Auto Loader
q_zh: 一位数据分析师需要自动化从多个数据源摄取和转换数据的定时 ETL 作业，需要多语言灵活性并确保管道具有内置质量检查。应使用哪个方案？
exp_zh: Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines 配合 Auto Loader 提供了声明式管道定义、自动增量摄取、内置数据质量检查和 Schema 演化支持。这是构建自动化、可靠 ETL 管道的最完整解决方案。

q:
A data analyst is given a sales table with the columns product_id, sale_date, and sale_amount. The analyst’s goal is to calculate the total sales per product per day, with exactly one row per product per day.
They first try the following SQL query:
SELECT product_id, sale_date, sale_amount, SUM(sale_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date) AS daily_total FROM sales ORDER BY product_id, sale_date;
However, this produces multiple rows for the same product and date instead of one aggregated row per product/date combination.
Which corrected SQL query will produce exactly one row per product per day with the total sales for that
day?
q_zh: 一位数据分析师被给予一个包含 product_id、sale_date 和 sale_amount 列的销售表。目标是计算每个产品每天的总销售额，且每个产品每天恰好一行。应使用哪个查询？
exp_zh: 需要使用 GROUP BY product_id, sale_date 并配合 SUM(sale_amount) 来聚合每个产品每天的总销售额。正确答案 D 的查询使用了正确的分组和聚合逻辑。

q: Which of the following is hosted completely in the control plane of the classic Databricks architecture?
opts: Worker node
JDBC data source
Databricks web application
Databricks Filesystem
Driver node
q_zh: 在经典的Databricks架构中，以下哪项完全托管在控制平面中？
exp_zh: 控制平面包含Databricks web应用、集群管理器、作业调度器等管理组件。数据平面包含计算节点（驱动节点和工作节点）和数据存储。JDBC数据源是外部连接。

q: Which of the following benefits of using the Databricks Lakehouse Platform is provided by Delta Lake?
opts: The ability to manipulate the same data using a variety of languages
The ability to collaborate in real time on a single notebook
The ability to set up alerts for query failures
The ability to support batch and streaming workloads
The ability to distribute complex data operations
q_zh: 使用Databricks Lakehouse平台的以下哪个好处是由Delta Lake提供的？
exp_zh: Delta Lake统一了批处理和流处理，支持使用相同的表进行批量和流式读写。

q: Which of the following describes the storage organization of a Delta table?
opts: Delta tables are stored in a single file that contains data, history, metadata, and other attributes.
Delta tables store their data in a single file and all metadata in a collection of files in a separate location.
Delta tables are stored in a collection of files that contain data, history, metadata, and other attributes.
Delta tables are stored in a collection of files that contain only the data stored within the table.
Delta tables are stored in a single file that contains only the data stored within the table.
q_zh: 以下哪个选项描述了Delta表的存储组织？
exp_zh: Delta表以Parquet文件集合存储数据，同时包含事务日志（_delta_log目录）记录所有变更、历史、元数据等信息。

q: Which of the following data lakehouse features results in improved data quality over a traditional data lake?
opts: A data lakehouse provides storage solutions for structured and unstructured data.
A data lakehouse supports ACID-compliant transactions.
A data lakehouse allows the use of SQL queries to examine data.
A data lakehouse stores data in open formats.
A data lakehouse enables machine learning and artificial Intelligence workloads.
q_zh: 与传统数据湖相比，以下哪个数据湖仓一体功能可以改善数据质量？
exp_zh: ACID事务确保数据一致性，防止部分写入和脏读，从而提升数据质量。

q: A data engineer is running code in a Databricks Repo that is cloned from a central Git repository. A colleague of the data engineer informs them that changes have been made and synced to the central Git repository. The data engineer now needs to sync their Databricks Repo to get the changes from the central Git repository. Which of the following Git operations does the data engineer need to run to accomplish this task?
opts: Merge
Push
Pull
Commit
Clone
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在从中央Git仓库克隆的Databricks Repo中运行代码。同事告知已向中央Git仓库提交更改。数据工程师现在需要同步他们的Databricks Repo以获取中央Git仓库的更改。需要运行以下哪个Git操作？
exp_zh: 从远程仓库拉取更新到本地仓库应使用`pull`操作。

q: Which of the following is a benefit of the Databricks Lakehouse Platform embracing open source technologies?
opts: Cloud-specific integrations
Simplified governance
Ability to scale storage
Ability to scale workloads
Avoiding vendor lock-in
q_zh: 以下哪项是Databricks Lakehouse平台采用开源技术的好处？
exp_zh: 采用开源技术（如Apache Spark、Delta Lake、MLflow）可以避免供应商锁定，提高可移植性。

q: Which of the following describes a scenario in which a data engineer will want to use a single-node cluster?
opts: When they are working interactively with a small amount of data
When they are running automated reports to be refreshed as quickly as possible
When they are working with SQL within Databricks SQL
When they are concerned about the ability to automatically scale with larger data
When they are manually running reports with a large amount of data
q_zh: 以下哪个场景描述了数据工程师希望使用单节点集群的情况？
exp_zh: 单节点集群适用于开发、测试或处理小数据量的交互式工作负载，成本较低。

q: Which of the following can be used to simplify and unify siloed data architectures that are specialized for specific use cases?
opts: None of these
Data lake
Data warehouse
All of these
Data lakehouse
q_zh: 以下哪项可用于简化和统一为特定用例而专门化的孤岛式数据架构？
exp_zh: 数据湖仓一体（Data Lakehouse）结合了数据湖和数据仓库的优点，能统一存储和分析，消除孤岛。

q: Which data lakehouse feature results in improved data quality over a traditional data lake?
opts: A data lakehouse stores data in open formats.
A data lakehouse allows the use of SQL queries to examine data.
A data lakehouse provides storage solutions for structured and unstructured data.
A data lakehouse supports ACID-compliant transactions.
q_zh: 与传统数据湖相比，哪个数据湖仓一体功能可以改善数据质量？
exp_zh: ACID事务确保数据一致性，防止部分写入和脏读，从而提升数据质量。

q: In which scenario will a data team want to utilize cluster pools?
opts: An automated report needs to be version-controlled across multiple collaborators.
An automated report needs to be runnable by all stakeholders.
An automated report needs to be refreshed as quickly as possible.
An automated report needs to be made reproducible.
q_zh: 在哪种情况下，数据团队会希望使用集群池？
exp_zh: 集群池可以预先分配集群实例，减少启动时间，因此适用于需要快速刷新或频繁启动作业的场景。

q: What is hosted completely in the control plane of the classic Databricks architecture?
opts: Worker node
Databricks web application
Driver node
Databricks Filesystem
q_zh: 在经典的Databricks架构中，什么完全托管在控制平面？
exp_zh: 控制平面包含Databricks web应用、集群管理器、作业调度器、Hive metastore等。

q: A data engineer needs to determine whether to use the built-in Databricks Notebooks versioning or version their project using Databricks Repos. What is an advantage of using Databricks Repos over the Databricks Notebooks versioning?
opts: Databricks Repos allows users to revert to previous versions of a notebook
Databricks Repos is wholly housed within the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform
Databricks Repos provides the ability to comment on specific changes
Databricks Repos supports the use of multiple branches
q_zh: 与Databricks Notebook版本控制相比，使用Databricks Repos的一个优势是什么？
exp_zh: Databricks Repos基于Git，支持分支、合并等完整的版本控制功能。

q: What is a benefit of the Databricks Lakehouse Architecture embracing open source technologies?
opts: Avoiding vendor lock-in
Simplified governance
Ability to scale workloads
Cloud-specific integrations
q_zh: Databricks Lakehouse架构采用开源技术的好处是什么？
exp_zh: 采用开源技术可以避免供应商锁定，提高可移植性和灵活性。

q: A data engineer is running code in a Databricks Repo that is cloned from a central Git repository. A colleague of the data engineer informs them that changes have been made and synced to the central Git repository. The data engineer now needs to sync their Databricks Repo to get the changes from the central Git repository. Which Git operation does the data engineer need to run to accomplish this task?
opts: Clone
Pull
Merge
Push
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在从中央Git仓库克隆的Databricks Repo中运行代码。同事告知已向中央Git仓库提交更改。数据工程师现在需要同步他们的Databricks Repo以获取中央Git仓库的更改。需要运行哪个Git操作？
exp_zh: 从远程仓库拉取更新应使用`pull`操作。

q: Which file format is used for storing Delta Lake Table?
opts: CSV
Parquet
JSON
Delta
q_zh: Delta Lake表使用哪种文件格式存储数据？
exp_zh: Delta Lake表的数据以Parquet格式存储，同时包含事务日志（_delta_log）。

q: Which two components function in the DB platform architecture’s control plane? (Choose two.)
opts: Virtual Machines
Compute Orchestration
Serverless Compute
Compute
Unity Catalog
q_zh: 在Databricks平台架构中，哪两个组件在控制平面中运行？
exp_zh: 控制平面包括管理组件：计算编排（Compute Orchestration）和Unity Catalog。计算资源属于数据平面。

q: What can be used to simplify and unify siloed data architectures that are specialized for specific use cases?
opts: Delta Lake
Data lake
Data warehouse
Data lakehouse
q_zh: 什么可用于简化和统一为特定用例专门化的孤岛式数据架构？
exp_zh: 数据湖仓一体（Data Lakehouse）统一了数据湖和数据仓库的优势，消除孤岛。

q: How can Git operations be performed outside of Databricks Repos?
opts: Commit
Pull
Merge
Clone
q_zh: 如何在不使用Databricks Repos的情况下执行Git操作？
exp_zh: `clone` 操作通常在外部Git客户端执行，然后将仓库导入Databricks Repos。

q: A data organization leader is upset about the data analysis team’s reports being different from the data engineering team’s reports. The leader believes the siloed nature of their organization’s data engineering and data analysis architectures is to blame. How could Data lakehouse alleviate this issue?
opts: Both teams would respond more quickly to ad-hoc requests
Both teams would use the same source of truth for their work
Both teams would reorganize to report to the same department
Both teams would be able to collaborate on projects in real-time
q_zh: 一位数据组织负责人对数据分析团队的报告与数据工程团队的报告不一致感到不满。负责人认为这是组织数据工程和数据分析架构的孤岛性质所致。数据湖仓一体如何缓解此问题？
exp_zh: 数据湖仓一体为所有团队提供统一的数据源（单一事实来源），消除因数据不同步导致的报告差异。

q: What is stored in a Databricks customer’s cloud account?
opts: Databricks web application
Cluster management metadata
Notebooks
Data
q_zh: Databricks客户的云账户中存储了什么？
exp_zh: 客户的数据（如存储在云对象存储中的文件）位于客户的云账户中。Databricks管理组件在Databricks账户中。

q: An organization needs an optimized storage layer that supports ACID transactions and schema enforcement. Which technology should the organization use?
opts: Delta Lake
Unity Catalog
Cloud File Storage
Data lake
q_zh: 一个组织需要支持ACID事务和模式强制的优化存储层。应该使用哪种技术？
exp_zh: Delta Lake是提供ACID事务、模式强制和时间旅行的存储层。

q: A data engineer is attempting to write Python and SQL in the same command cell and is running into an error. The engineer believed it was possible to use a Python variable in a SQL select statement. Why does the command fail?
opts: Databricks supports language interoperability in the same cell but only between Scala and SQL.
Databricks supports multiple languages but only one per notebook.
Databricks supports one language per cell.
Databricks supports language interoperability but only if a special character is used.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师试图在同一个命令单元格中编写Python和SQL，但遇到了错误。工程师原以为可以在select语句中使用Python变量。命令为什么会失败？
exp_zh: Databricks笔记本的每个单元格只能使用一种语言。

q: Which compute option should be chosen in a scenario where small-scale ad-hoc Python scripts need to be run at high frequency and should wind down quickly after these queries have finished running?
opts: All-purpose Cluster
Job Cluster
Serverless Compute
SQL Warehouse
q_zh: 在需要高频运行小规模临时Python脚本，并且应在查询完成后迅速关闭的场景中，应选择哪种计算选项？
exp_zh: Serverless Compute可以自动启动和关闭，无需管理集群，适合高频、短生命周期的临时工作负载。

q: A data engineer is working on a personal laptop and needs to perform complex transformations on data stored in a Delta Lake on cloud storage. The engineer decides to use Databricks Connect to interact with Databricks clusters and work in their local IDE. How does Databricks Connect enable the engineer to develop, test, and debug code seamlessly on their personal laptop while interacting with Databricks clusters?
opts: By providing a local environment that mimics the Databricks runtime, enabling the engineer to develop, test, and debug code using a specific IDE that is required by Databricks
By providing a local environment that mimics the Databricks runtime, enabling the engineer to develop, test, and debug code only through Databricks’ own web interface
By allowing direct execution of Spark jobs from the local machine without needing a network connection
By providing a local environment that mimics the Databricks runtime, enabling the engineer to develop, test, and debug code using their preferred IDE
q_zh: 一位数据工程师在个人笔记本电脑上工作，需要对存储在云存储上的Delta Lake中的数据进行复杂转换。工程师决定使用Databricks Connect与Databricks集群交互，并在本地IDE中工作。Databricks Connect如何使工程师能够在个人笔记本电脑上无缝开发、测试和调试代码，同时与Databricks集群交互？
exp_zh: Databricks Connect提供了一个本地环境，模拟Databricks运行时，允许工程师使用自己偏好的IDE开发、测试和调试代码，然后将作业提交到远程集群执行。

q: What is the maximum output supported by a job cluster to ensure a notebook does not fail?
opts: 25MBs
10MBs
30MBs
15MBs
q_zh: 为确保笔记本不失败，作业集群支持的最大输出是多少？
exp_zh: Databricks作业集群的输出大小限制为10MB，超过此限制可能导致失败。

q: A data engineer needs to conduct Exploratory Analysis on data residing in a database that is within the company’s custom-defined network in the cloud. The data engineer is using SQL for this task. Which type of SQL Warehouse will enable the data engineer to process large numbers of queries quickly and cost-effectively?
opts: Serverless compute for notebooks
Pro SQL Warehouse
Classic SQL Warehouse
Serverless SQL Warehouse
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要对位于公司自定义云网络内的数据库中的数据进行探索性分析，并使用SQL完成任务。哪种类型的SQL Warehouse能使数据工程师快速且经济地处理大量查询？
exp_zh: Pro SQL Warehouse提供高性能和成本优化，适合大规模查询。

q: A data engineer is debugging a Python notebook in Databricks that processes a dataset using PySpark. The notebook fails with an error during a DataFrame transformation. The engineer wants to inspect the state of variables, such as the input DataFrame and intermediate results, to identify where the error occurs. Which tool should the engineer use to debug the notebook and inspect the values of variables like DataFrames?
opts: Use the Databricks CLI to download and analyze driver logs for detailed error messages
Use the Python Notebook Interactive Debugger to set breakpoints and inspect variable values in real-time
Use the Ganglia UI to monitor cluster resource usage and identify hardware issues
Use the Spark UI to analyze the execution plan and identify stages where the job failed
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在调试一个在Databricks中使用PySpark处理数据集的Python笔记本。笔记本在DataFrame转换过程中出错。工程师希望检查变量状态，如输入DataFrame和中间结果，以确定错误发生的位置。应该使用哪个工具来调试笔记本并检查DataFrame等变量的值？
exp_zh: Python Notebook Interactive Debugger允许设置断点并实时检查变量值。

q: A data engineer wants to create an external table in Databricks that references data stored in an Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) location. The goal is to enable Databricks to access and query this external data without moving it into the Databricks-managed storage. Which step should the data engineer take to successfully create the external table?
opts: Use the CREATE MANAGED TABLE statement and specify the LOCATION clause with the path to the external data.
CREATE UNMANAGED TABLE statement without specifying a LOCATION clause.
Use the CREATE TABLE statement and specify the LOCATION clause with the path to the external data.
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE statement without specifying a LOCATION clause.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师想要在Databricks中创建一个外部表，引用存储在Azure Data Lake Storage中的数据。目标是在不将数据移动到Databricks托管存储的情况下访问和查询这些外部数据。应该采取哪个步骤来成功创建外部表？
exp_zh: 使用CREATE TABLE ... LOCATION 语句可以创建外部表，LOCATION指定外部路径。

q: A data engineer is developing a small proof of concept in a notebook. When running the entire notebook, the Cluster usage spikes. The data engineer wants to keep the development requirements and get real-time results. Which Cluster meets these requirements?
opts: All Purpose Cluster with autoscaling
Job Cluster with Photon enabled and autoscaling
Job Cluster with autoscaling enabled
All-Purpose Cluster with a large fixed memory size
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在笔记本中开发一个小型概念验证。运行整个笔记本时，集群使用量激增。工程师希望保持开发需求并实时获取结果。哪个集群满足这些要求？
exp_zh: 交互式开发应使用All-Purpose Cluster，并启用自动缩放以应对使用高峰，同时保持实时交互。

q: A data engineer needs to process SQL queries on a large dataset with fluctuating workloads. The workload requires automatic scaling based on the volume of queries, without the need to manage or provision infrastructure. The solution should be cost-efficient and charge only for the compute resources used during query execution. Which compute option should the data engineer use?
opts: Databricks SQL Analytics
Databricks Runtime for ML
Databricks Jobs
Serverless SQL Warehouse
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要对波动负载的大型数据集处理SQL查询。工作负载需要根据查询量自动缩放，无需管理或配置基础设施。解决方案应具有成本效益，且仅对查询执行期间使用的计算资源收费。应该使用哪种计算选项？
exp_zh: Serverless SQL Warehouse 自动缩放，按使用量付费，无需管理基础设施，完全符合要求。

q: An organization has implemented a data pipeline in Databricks and needs to ensure it can scale automatically based on varying workloads without manual cluster management. The goal is to meet the company’s Service Level Agreements (SLAs), which require high availability and minimal downtime, while Databricks automatically handles resource allocation and optimization. Which approach fulfills these requirements?
opts: Deploy Job Clusters with fixed configurations, dedicated to specific tasks, without automatic scaling.
Use Spot Instances to allocate resources dynamically while minimizing costs, with potential interruptions.
Use Interactive Clusters in Databricks, adjusting cluster sizes manually based on workload demands.
Use Serverless compute in Databricks to automatically scale and provision resources with minimal manual intervention.
q_zh: 一个组织在Databricks中实施了数据管道，需要确保其能根据变化的工作负载自动扩展，无需手动集群管理。目标是满足公司的服务级别协议，要求高可用性和最小停机时间，同时由Databricks自动处理资源分配和优化。哪种方法满足这些要求？
exp_zh: Serverless compute 自动扩展和配置资源，满足高可用性要求，且无需手动干预。

q: A data engineer has written a function in a Databricks Notebook to calculate the population of bacteria in a given medium. Analysts use this function in the notebook and sometimes provide input arguments of the wrong data type, which can cause errors during execution. Which Databricks feature will help the data engineer quickly identify if an incorrect data type has been provided as input?
opts: The Spark User interface has a Debug tab that contains the variables used in this session.
The Databricks debugger enables breakpoints that will raise an error if the wrong data type is submitted.
The Databricks debugger enables the use of a variable explorer to see at a glance the value of the variables.
The Data Engineer should add print statements to determine the value of the variable.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师在Databricks笔记本中编写了一个函数，用于计算给定培养基中的细菌数量。分析师在笔记本中使用此函数，有时会提供错误数据类型的输入参数，导致执行错误。哪个Databricks功能可以帮助数据工程师快速识别是否提供了错误的数据类型作为输入？
exp_zh: Databricks调试器允许设置断点，当错误数据类型传入时会在运行时引发错误，从而帮助定位。

q: Which languages are supported by Serverless compute clusters? (Choose two.)
opts: SQL
Python
R
Scala
Java
q_zh: Serverless计算集群支持哪些语言？（选择两项）
exp_zh: Serverless计算支持SQL（通过Serverless SQL Warehouses）和Python（用于笔记本和作业）。

q: A Data Engineer is designing Bronze layer in Databricks Medallion Architecture. The raw data is collected from multiple sources (Clickstream in JSON, Transactions in CSV). The task is to design the Bronze layer of the Medallion Architecture to ingest and store this raw data for further processing. Which operation applies to the Bronze layer?
opts: Ingest raw data without transformations, preserving original schemas, and store in Delta format.
Clean and standardize raw data by removing null values and enforcing schemas.
Apply complex business logic to enrich raw data with customer segmentation labels.
Aggregate and transform source data to calculate daily sales performance metrics.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在设计Databricks Medallion架构中的青铜层。原始数据从多个来源收集（JSON格式的点击流，CSV格式的交易）。任务是设计Medallion架构的青铜层，以摄取和存储这些原始数据供进一步处理。哪个操作适用于青铜层？
exp_zh: 青铜层用于原始数据摄取，保持原样，以Delta格式存储。清洗、标准化、丰富、聚合属于银层和金层。

q: What is the primary function of the Silver layer in the Databricks medallion architecture?
opts: Store historical data solely for auditing purposes
Aggregate and enrich data for business analytics
Validate, clean, and deduplicate data for further processing
Ingest raw data in its original state
q_zh: Databricks Medallion架构中银层的主要功能是什么？
exp_zh: 银层对青铜层原始数据进行验证、清洗、去重，形成结构化、可靠的数据，供后续分析。

q: A data engineer needs to combine sales data from an on-premises PostgreSQL database with customer data in Azure Synapse for a comprehensive report. The goal is to avoid data duplication and ensure up-to-date information. How should the data engineer achieve this using Databricks?
opts: Export data from both sources to CSV files and upload them to Databricks
Use Lakehouse Federation to query both data sources directly
Manually synchronize data from both sources into a single database
Develop custom ETL pipelines to ingest data into Databricks
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要将本地PostgreSQL数据库中的销售数据与Azure Synapse中的客户数据结合，生成综合报告。目标是避免数据重复并确保信息最新。数据工程师应如何使用Databricks实现这一目标？
exp_zh: Lakehouse Federation允许直接查询外部数据源，无需复制数据，确保实时性。

q: A data engineering team wants to validate a new ingestion pipeline locally while ensuring large aggregations run in serverless compute in their Databricks workspace. They plan to use Databricks Connect and have the option to attach to either a shared cluster or serverless. Which workspace requirement should be confirmed first to avoid connection failures?
opts: Verify that the workspace has Unity Catalog disabled and the Databricks Connect version is less than the serverless Runtime version.
Verify that the workspace has Unity Catalog enabled and that the Databricks Connect version supports serverless for the target Runtime release.
Verify that only assigned access mode clusters are used because serverless is not supported by Databricks Connect.
Verify that the local Spark version equals the serverless Spark version to satisfy Spark Connect parity.
q_zh: 一个数据工程团队希望本地验证新的摄取管道，同时确保大型聚合在其Databricks工作区的无服务器计算中运行。他们计划使用Databricks Connect，并可以选择连接到共享集群或无服务器。首先应该确认哪个工作区要求以避免连接失败？
exp_zh: Databricks Connect需要启用Unity Catalog，并且Databricks Connect版本必须支持目标运行时版本的无服务器，以确保兼容性。

q: A data engineer needs to conduct Exploratory Analysis on data residing in a database that is within the company’s custom-defined network in the cloud. The data engineer is using SQL for this task. Which type of SQL Warehouse will enable the data engineer to process large numbers of queries quickly and cost-effectively?
opts: Classic SQL Warehouse
Serverless SQL Warehouse
Pro SQL Warehouse
All-purpose compute cluster
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要对位于公司自定义云网络内的数据库中的数据进行探索性分析，并使用SQL完成任务。哪种类型的SQL Warehouse能使数据工程师快速且经济地处理大量查询？
exp_zh: Serverless SQL Warehouse 自动缩放，按使用量付费，无需管理基础设施，适合大规模查询。

q: A data engineer must deliver a trustworthy customer 360 dataset in Databricks for data scientists and BI teams. The engineer plans to join deduplicated customer records with cleaned transaction data, enforce schema and data quality checks, and create a conformed “customer_transactions” view. Later, highly aggregated, domain-specific tables (for weekly spend and executive summaries) will be produced for dashboards. Where should the engineer build the conformed “customer_transactions” dataset, and where should the aggregated, report-ready tables reside?
opts: Build both “customer_transactions” and aggregated, report-ready tables in Silver to keep the model simpler.
Build “customer_transactions” in Bronze and put the aggregated, report-ready tables in Silver.
Build “customer_transactions” in Gold and put the aggregated, report-ready tables in Silver.
Build “customer_transactions” in Silver and put the aggregated, report-ready tables in Gold.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师必须为数据科学家和BI团队在Databricks中交付一个可信的客户360数据集。工程师计划将去重的客户记录与清洗后的交易数据连接，执行模式和数据质量检查，并创建一个一致的“customer_transactions”视图。之后，将为仪表板生成高度聚合的、特定于领域的表（用于每周支出和高管摘要）。工程师应该在哪个层构建一致的“customer_transactions”数据集，聚合的、准备报告的表应该驻留在哪里？
exp_zh: 一致的数据集（如customer_transactions）属于银层，因为它代表清洗、去重和验证后的数据，适合广泛分析使用。高度聚合、面向报告的表应放在金层。

q: A data engineer requires rapid iteration on pipelines while maintaining reliable rollbacks after bad ingests, ensuring audit trails for regulatory compliance, and providing consistent access to a single source of truth for both AI and BI workloads. Which strategy should the data engineer apply to meet the needs?
opts: Delta Lake ACID transactions and time travel, governed by Unity Catalog for consistent access and lineage.
DBFS CSV storage with manual file versioning and nightly copies for rollback.
Ephemeral in-memory DataFrames for audit trails and BI distribution.
Cloud objects storage only, with ad hoc SQL queries for recovery and governance.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要在管道上快速迭代，同时保持数据摄取错误后的可靠回滚，确保符合法规的审计跟踪，并为AI和BI工作负载提供对单一事实来源的一致访问。数据工程师应采用哪种策略来满足需求？
exp_zh: Delta Lake提供ACID事务和时间旅行，Unity Catalog管理访问和沿袭，满足这些需求。

q: A data engineer is setting up a new Databricks pipeline that ingests clickstream events from Kafka and daily product catalogs from cloud object storage. To ensure auditability and easy reprocessing, the engineer wants to land all source data. Later stages will handle cleaning, deduplication, and business modeling before the data is used in dashboards. Which approach aligns to Medallion Architecture principles?
opts: Land both sources in Gold with denormalized star schemas to optimize BI while retaining full source fidelity.
Land streaming events from Kafka in silver, and the product catalog directly in Gold to minimize layers for batch data.
Land both sources in the Bronze layer append-only with minimal validation, then build Silver/Gold downstream for quality and analytics.
Land both sources directly into the Silver layer with schema enforcement and deduplication to reduce downstream complexity.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在设置一个新的Databricks管道，从Kafka摄取点击流事件，并从云对象存储摄取每日产品目录。为了确保可审计性和轻松重新处理，工程师希望落地所有源数据。后续阶段将处理清洗、去重和业务建模，然后将数据用于仪表板。哪种方法符合Medallion架构原则？
exp_zh: Medallion架构建议将所有源数据以仅追加方式存放在青铜层，最小化验证，然后在银层和金层进行清洗、去重和业务建模。

q: A data engineer is building a PySpark ingestion pipeline in a local IDE and must execute heavy DataFrame transformations on a remote Databricks cluster for scale while stepping through business logic locally. CREATE TABLE all_transactions AS SELECT * FROM march_transactions UNION SELECT * FROM april_transactions;
CREATE TABLE all_transactions AS SELECT * FROM march_transactions OUTER JOIN SELECT * FROM april_transactions;
CREATE TABLE all_transactions AS SELECT * FROM march_transactions INTERSECT SELECT * FROM april_transactions;
q_zh: 一个数据工程团队有两个表。第一个表 march_transactions 是三月份所有零售交易的集合。第二个表 april_transactions 是四月份所有零售交易的集合。表之间没有重复记录。应该运行哪个命令来创建一个新表 all_transactions，其中包含 march_transactions 和 april_transactions 中的所有记录，且无重复？
exp_zh: UNION 操作符合并两个查询的结果并去重。由于原表无重复，结果将包含所有记录。

q: A data analyst has developed a query that runs against Delta table. They want help from the data engineering team to implement a series of tests to ensure the data returned by the query is clean. However, the data engineering team uses Python for its tests rather than SQL. Which operation could the data engineering team use to run the query and operate with the results in PySpark?
opts: SELECT * FROM sales
spark.delta.table
spark.sql
spark.table
q_zh: 一位数据分析师开发了一个针对 Delta 表的查询。他们希望数据工程团队帮助实施一系列测试，以确保查询返回的数据是清洁的。但是，数据工程团队使用 Python 进行测试，而不是 SQL。数据工程团队可以使用哪个操作来运行查询并在 PySpark 中操作结果？
exp_zh: spark.sql 可以执行 SQL 查询并返回 DataFrame，便于后续在 Python 中操作。

q: A data engineer needs to create a table in Databricks using data from their organization’s existing SQLite database. They run the following command: Which line of code fills in the above blank to successfully complete the task?
opts: org.apache.spark.sql.jdbc
autoloader
org.apache.spark.sql.sqlite
sqlite
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要使用其组织现有 SQLite 数据库中的数据在 Databricks 中创建一个表。他们运行以下命令：哪行代码填入空白以成功完成任务？
exp_zh: 使用 JDBC 数据源，格式指定为 org.apache.spark.sql.jdbc，并配置相应的选项。

q: A data engineer wants to create a relational object by pulling data from two tables. The relational object does not need to be used by other data engineers in other sessions. In order to save on storage costs, the data engineer wants to avoid copying and storing physical data. Which relational object should the data engineer create?
opts: Spark SQL Table
View
Delta Table
Temporary view
q_zh: 一位数据工程师想通过从两个表中拉取数据创建一个关系对象。该关系对象不需要被其他会话中的其他数据工程师使用。为了节省存储成本，数据工程师希望避免复制和存储物理数据。数据工程师应该创建哪个关系对象？
exp_zh: 临时视图仅在当前会话中可用，不存储数据，符合要求。

q: Which command will return the number of null values in the member_id column?
opts: SELECT count(member_id) FROM my_table;
SELECT count(member_id) - count_null(member_id) FROM my_table;
SELECT count_if(member_id IS NULL) FROM my_table;
SELECT null(member_id) FROM my_table;
q_zh: 哪个命令将返回 member_id 列中空值的数量？
exp_zh: count_if(member_id IS NULL) 统计满足条件的行数，即空值数量。

q: Which benefit is provided by the array functions from Spark SQL?
opts: An ability to work with data in a variety of types at once
An ability to work with data within certain partitions and windows
An ability to work with time-related data in specified intervals
An ability to work with complex, nested data ingested from JSON files
q_zh: Spark SQL 的数组函数提供了什么好处？
exp_zh: 数组函数用于处理复杂嵌套数据，如 JSON 中的数组。

q: A data engineer is working with two tables. Each of these tables is displayed below in its entirety. The data engineer runs the following query to join these tables together: Which of the following will be returned by the above query?
opts: data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在处理两个表，每个表如下所示。工程师运行以下查询来连接这些表：上述查询将返回以下哪个结果？
exp_zh: 根据 LEFT JOIN 逻辑，返回左表所有行，右表匹配的行，无匹配则 NULL。正确显示了结果。

q: Which SQL code snippet will correctly demonstrate a Data Definition Language (DDL) operation used to create a table?
opts: CREATE TABLE employees ( id INT, name STRING );
DROP TABLE employees;
ALTER TABLE employees ADD COLUMN salary DECIMAL(10,2);
INSERT INTO employees (id, name) VALUES (1 'Alice');
q_zh: 哪个 SQL 代码片段正确演示了用于创建表的数据定义语言（DDL）操作？
exp_zh: CREATE TABLE 是 DDL，用于定义表结构。

q: What are the transformations typically included in building the Bronze layer?
opts: Include columns Load date/time, process ID
Business rules and transformations
Perform extensive data cleansing
Aggregate data from multiple sources
q_zh: 构建青铜层通常包含哪些转换？
exp_zh: 青铜层通常只添加元数据列如加载时间、处理 ID，不进行业务规则、清洗或聚合。

q: A global retail company sells products across multiple categories (e.g., Electronics, Clothing) and regions (e.g., North, South, East, West). The sales team has provided the data engineer with a PySpark dataframe named sales_df as below and the team wants the data engineer to analyze the sales data to help them make strategic decisions. Calculate the total sales amount for each product category and store the results in a new dataframe called category_sales. What will generate the expected result of category_sales?
opts: category_sales = sales_df.groupBy("category").agg(sum("sales_amount").alias ("total_sales_amount"))
category_sales = sales_df.sum("sales_amount").groupBy("category").alias ("total_sales_amount"))
category_sales = sales_df.agg(sum("sales_amount").groupBy("category").alias ("total_sales_amount"))
category_sales = sales_df.groupBy("region").agg(sum("sales_amount").alias ("total_sales_amount"))
q_zh: 一家全球零售公司在多个类别（例如，电子产品、服装）和地区（例如，北、南、东、西）销售产品。销售团队向数据工程师提供了一个名为 sales_df 的 PySpark 数据框，团队希望数据工程师分析销售数据以帮助他们做出战略决策。计算每个产品类别的总销售额，并将结果存储在一个名为 category_sales 的新数据框中。哪个选项会生成 category_sales 的预期结果？
exp_zh: 使用 groupBy("category").agg(sum("sales_amount")) 计算每个类别的总和。

q: A company sells products across multiple categories (e.g., Electronics, Clothing) and regions. The sales team has provided the data engineer with a PySpark dataframe named sales_df as below, and wants the data engineer to analyze the sales data to help make strategic decisions. The data engineer needs to calculate the total sales amount for each region and store the results in a new Dataframe called ‘region_sales’. Given the expected result: Which code will generate the expected result?
opts: region_sales = sales_df.groupBy("category").sum("sales_amount").alias ("total_sales_amount")
region_sales = sales_df.groupBy("region").agg(sum("sales_amount").alias ("total_sales_amount"))
region_sales = sales_df.sum("sales_amount").groupBy("region").alias ("total_sales_amount")
region_sales = sales_df.agg(sum("sales_amount").groupBy("region").alias ("total_sales_amount"))
q_zh: 一家公司在多个类别（例如，电子产品、服装）和地区销售产品。销售团队向数据工程师提供了名为 sales_df 的 PySpark 数据框，希望数据工程师分析销售数据以帮助做出战略决策。数据工程师需要计算每个地区的总销售额，并将结果存储在一个名为 ‘region_sales’ 的新数据框中。给定预期结果，哪个代码将生成预期结果？
exp_zh: 使用 groupBy("region").agg(sum("sales_amount")) 计算每个地区的总和。

q: A data engineering team is using Kafka to capture event data and then ingest it into Databricks. The team wants to be able to see these historical events. Medallion architecture is already in place and is mindful of costs. Where should this historical event data be stored?
opts: Gold
Silver
Bronze
Raw layer
q_zh: 一个数据工程团队正在使用 Kafka 捕获事件数据，然后将其摄取到 Databricks 中。团队希望能够查看这些历史事件。Medallion 架构已经就位，并且团队注意成本。这些历史事件数据应该存储在哪里？
exp_zh: 青铜层存储原始数据，成本最低，适合保存历史事件。

q: What are two characteristics of the Gold Layer? (Choose two.)
opts: Historical lineage
Raw Data
Normalized
De-normalized
Read-optimized
q_zh: Gold 层的两个特征是什么？（选择两项）
exp_zh: Gold 层通常包含去规范化的数据，并针对读取进行优化，以支持 BI 和报告。

q: A data engineer team has decided to implement a new data platform on Databricks and is currently deciding how to store each kind of data on each data layer. What is the appropriate layer and data pairing for medallion architecture?
opts: Silver Layer - Raw data from deposit account application
Bronze Layer - Summary of cash deposit amount for each country and city
Silver Layer - Cleansed master customer data
Gold Layer - Deduplicated money transfer transaction
q_zh: 一个数据工程团队决定在 Databricks 上实施一个新的数据平台，目前正在决定如何在每个数据层存储每种类型的数据。对于 Medallion 架构，什么是合适的层和数据配对？
exp_zh: 银层包含清洗后的主数据，如客户数据。青铜层是原始数据，金层是聚合数据。

q: A data engineer has been provided a PySpark DataFrame named df with columns product and revenue. The data engineer needs to compute complex aggregations to determine each product's total revenue, average revenue, and transaction count. Which code snippet should the data engineer use?
opts: data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,
q_zh: 一位数据工程师获得了一个名为 df 的 PySpark DataFrame，包含列 product 和 revenue。数据工程师需要计算复杂的聚合以确定每个产品的总收入、平均收入和交易计数。应该使用哪个代码片段？
exp_zh: 使用 groupBy("product").agg(sum("revenue"), avg("revenue"), count("*")) 实现。

q: A data engineer is developing an ETL process based on Spark SQL. The execution fails. The data engineer checks the Spark UI and can see the ERRORS as follows: "java.lang.OutofMemoryError: Java heap space" Which two corrective actions should the data engineer perform to resolve this issue? (Choose two.)
opts: Narrow the filters in order to collect less data in the query
Upsize the worker nodes and activate autoshuffle partitions
Upsize the driver node and deactivate autoshuffle partitions
Cache the dataset in order to boost the query performance
Fix the shuffle partitions to 50 to ensure the allocation
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在开发基于 Spark SQL 的 ETL 过程。执行失败。数据工程师检查 Spark UI 并看到错误如下："java.lang.OutofMemoryError: Java heap space"。数据工程师应该执行哪两项纠正措施来解决此问题？（选择两项）
exp_zh: OutOfMemoryError 可能是数据量过大，可缩小过滤范围减少数据量，或增加 worker 节点内存并启用自动 shuffle 分区调整。

q: A data engineer is working in a Python notebook on Databricks to process data, but notices that the output is not as expected. The data engineer wants to investigate the issue by stepping through the code and checking the values of certain variables during execution. Which tool should the data engineer use to inspect the code execution and variables in real-time?
opts: Cluster Logs
Job Execution Dashboard
Python Notebook Interactive Debugger
SQL Analytics
q_zh: 一位数据工程师在 Databricks 上的 Python 笔记本中处理数据，但发现输出与预期不符。数据工程师希望通过逐步执行代码并在执行期间检查某些变量的值来调查问题。数据工程师应该使用哪个工具来实时检查代码执行和变量？
exp_zh: Python Notebook Interactive Debugger 允许设置断点、单步执行和检查变量。

q: Which of the following code blocks will remove the rows where the value in column age is greater than 25 from the existing Delta table my_table and save the updated table?
opts: SELECT * FROM my_table WHERE age > 25;
UPDATE my_table WHERE age > 25;
DELETE FROM my_table WHERE age > 25;
UPDATE my_table WHERE age <= 25;
DELETE FROM my_table WHERE age <= 25;
q_zh: 以下哪个代码块将从现有的 Delta 表 my_table 中删除 age 列值大于 25 的行，并保存更新后的表？
exp_zh: DELETE 语句用于删除行，条件 WHERE age > 25 删除年龄大于 25 的行。

q: A data analyst has created a Delta table sales that is used by the entire data analysis team. They want help from the data engineering team to implement a series of tests to ensure the data is clean. However, the data engineering team uses Python for its tests rather than SQL. Which of the following commands could the data engineering team use to access sales in PySpark?
opts: SELECT * FROM sales
There is no way to share data between PySpark and SQL.
spark.sql("sales")
spark.delta.table("sales")
spark.table("sales")
q_zh: 一位数据分析师创建了一个 Delta 表 sales，供整个数据分析团队使用。他们希望数据工程团队帮助实施一系列测试以确保数据清洁。但是，数据工程团队使用 Python 进行测试，而不是 SQL。数据工程团队可以使用以下哪个命令在 PySpark 中访问 sales？
exp_zh: spark.table("table_name") 用于读取表。

q: Which of the following commands will return the location of database customer360?
opts: DESCRIBE LOCATION customer360;
DROP DATABASE customer360;
DESCRIBE DATABASE customer360;
ALTER DATABASE customer360 SET DBPROPERTIES ('location' = '/user');
USE DATABASE customer360;
q_zh: 以下哪个命令将返回数据库 customer360 的位置？
exp_zh: DESCRIBE DATABASE database_name 会显示数据库的详细信息，包括位置。

q: A data engineer wants to create a new table containing the names of customers that live in France. They have written the following command: A senior data engineer mentions that it is organization policy to include a table property indicating that the new table includes personally identifiable information (PII). Which line of code fills in the above blank to successfully complete the task?
opts: PII
"COMMENT PII"
TBLPROPERTIES PII
COMMENT "Contains PII"
q_zh: 一位数据工程师想要创建一个包含居住在法国的客户姓名的新表。他们编写了以下命令：一位高级数据工程师提到，组织政策要求包含一个表属性，表明新表包含个人身份信息。哪行代码填入空白以成功完成任务？
exp_zh: 添加表属性应使用 COMMENT 或 TBLPROPERTIES。此处使用 COMMENT 添加注释最合适。

q: A data engineer is attempting to drop a Spark SQL table my_table. The data engineer wants to delete all table metadata and data. They run the following command: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS my_table While the object no longer appears when they run SHOW TABLES, the data files still exist. Which of the following describes why the data files still exist and the metadata files were deleted?
opts: The table's data was larger than 10 GB
The table's data was smaller than 10 GB
The table was external
The table did not have a location
The table was managed
q_zh: 一位数据工程师试图删除 Spark SQL 表 my_table。工程师想要删除所有表元数据和数据。他们运行以下命令：DROP TABLE IF EXISTS my_table 当运行 SHOW TABLES 时对象不再出现，但数据文件仍然存在。以下哪个选项描述了为什么数据文件仍然存在而元数据文件被删除？
exp_zh: 对于外部表，DROP TABLE 只删除元数据，而实际数据文件保留。

q: A data engineer wants to create a data entity from a couple of tables. The data entity must be used by other data engineers in other sessions. It also must be saved to a physical location. Which of the following data entities should the data engineer create?
opts: Database
Function
View
Temporary view
Table
q_zh: 一位数据工程师想从几个表中创建一个数据实体。该数据实体必须能在其他会话中被其他数据工程师使用，并且必须保存到物理位置。工程师应该创建以下哪个数据实体？
exp_zh: 表（Table）持久化存储数据，可跨会话访问。视图不存储数据，临时视图仅在会话内有效。

q: Which of the following commands can be used to write data into a Delta table while avoiding the writing of duplicate records?
opts: DROP
IGNORE
MERGE
APPEND
INSERT
q_zh: 以下哪个命令可用于将数据写入 Delta 表，同时避免写入重复记录？
exp_zh: MERGE INTO 可以根据条件更新或插入，避免重复。

q: A data engineer runs a statement every day to copy the previous day's sales into the table transactions. Each day's sales are in their own file in the location "/transactions/raw". Today, the data engineer runs the following command to complete this task: After running the command today, the data engineer notices that the number of records in table transactions has not changed. Which of the following describes why the statement might not have copied any new records into the table?
opts: The format of the files to be copied were not included with the FORMAT_OPTIONS keyword.
The names of the files to be copied were not included with the FILES keyword.
The previous day's file has already been copied into the table.
The PARQUET file format does not support COPY INTO.
The COPY INTO statement requires the table to be refreshed to view the copied rows.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师每天运行一条语句，将前一天的销售数据复制到表 transactions 中。每天的数据都在自己的文件中，位于 "/transactions/raw" 路径下。今天，数据工程师运行以下命令来完成此任务：运行命令后，数据工程师注意到表 transactions 中的记录数没有变化。以下哪项描述了为什么该语句可能没有将任何新记录复制到表中？
exp_zh: COPY INTO 会跟踪已处理的文件，如果前一天的已经被处理过，就不会再复制。

q: A data engineer has configured a Structured Streaming job to read from a table, manipulate the data, and then perform a streaming write into a new table. The code block used by the data engineer is below: If the data engineer only wants the query to execute a micro-batch to process data every 5 seconds, which of the following lines of code should the data engineer use to fill in the blank?
opts: trigger("5 seconds")
trigger()
trigger(once="5 seconds")
trigger(processingTime="5 seconds")
trigger(continuous="5 seconds")
q_zh: 一位数据工程师配置了一个结构化流作业，从表读取数据、处理数据，然后流式写入新表。数据工程师使用的代码块如下：如果数据工程师只想让查询每 5 秒执行一个微批处理，应该使用以下哪行代码填空？
exp_zh: trigger(processingTime="5 seconds") 设置处理时间触发模式，每 5 秒一个微批。

q: Which of the following describes when to use the CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE (formerly CREATE INCREMENTAL LIVE TABLE) syntax over the CREATE LIVE TABLE syntax when creating Delta Live Tables (DLT) tables using SQL?
opts: CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE should be used when the subsequent step in the DLT pipeline is static.
CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE should be used when data needs to be processed incrementally.
CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE is redundant for DLT and it does not need to be used.
CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE should be used when data needs to be processed through complicated aggregations.
CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE should be used when the previous step in the DLT pipeline is static.
q_zh: 在使用 SQL 创建 Delta Live Tables 表时，以下哪项描述了何时使用 CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE 语法而不是 CREATE LIVE TABLE 语法？
exp_zh: 当需要增量处理数据时，应使用 CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE。

q: Which of the following describes the type of workloads that are always compatible with Auto Loader?
opts: Streaming workloads
Machine learning workloads
Serverless workloads
Batch workloads
Dashboard workloads
q_zh: 以下哪项描述了始终与 Auto Loader 兼容的工作负载类型？
exp_zh: Auto Loader 专为增量处理新文件设计，主要用于流式工作负载，也可用于批处理。

q: A data engineer is using the following code block as part of a batch ingestion pipeline to read from a composable table: Which of the following changes needs to be made so this code block will work when the transactions table is a stream source?
opts: Replace predict with a stream-friendly prediction function
Replace schema(schema) with option ("maxFilesPerTrigger", 1)
Replace "transactions" with the path to the location of the Delta table
Replace format("delta") with format("stream")
Replace spark.read with spark.readStream
q_zh: 一位数据工程师使用以下代码块作为批处理摄取管道的一部分，从可组合表读取数据。当 transactions 表是流源时，需要进行以下哪项更改才能使此代码块正常工作？
exp_zh: 读取流源应使用 spark.readStream 而不是 spark.read。

q: Which of the following queries is performing a streaming hop from raw data to a Bronze table?
opts: data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,
q_zh: 以下哪个查询正在执行从原始数据到青铜表的流式跳跃？
exp_zh: 使用 readStream 从源读取，并写入 Bronze 表。

exp_zh: COPY INTO 会跟踪已处理的文件，如果前一天的已经被处理过，就不会再复制。

q: Which command can be used to write data into a Delta table while avoiding the writing of duplicate records?
opts: DROP
INSERT
MERGE
APPEND
q_zh: 哪个命令可用于将数据写入 Delta 表，同时避免写入重复记录？
exp_zh: MERGE INTO 可以根据条件更新或插入，避免重复。

q: A data engineer has configured a Structured Streaming job to read from a table, manipulate the data, and then perform a streaming write into a new table. The code block used by the data engineer is below: Which line of code should the data engineer use to fill in the blank if the data engineer only wants the query to execute a micro-batch to process data every 5 seconds?
opts: trigger("5 seconds")
trigger(continuous="5 seconds")
trigger(once="5 seconds")
trigger(processingTime="5 seconds")
q_zh: 一位数据工程师配置了一个结构化流作业，从表读取数据、处理数据，然后流式写入新表。数据工程师使用的代码块如下：如果数据工程师只想让查询每 5 秒执行一个微批处理，应该使用哪行代码填空？
exp_zh: trigger(processingTime="5 seconds") 设置处理时间触发模式，每 5 秒一个微批。

q: What is used by Spark to record the offset range of the data being processed in each trigger in order for Structured Streaming to reliably track the exact progress of the processing so that it can handle any kind of failure by restarting and/or reprocessing?
opts: Checkpointing and Write-ahead Logs
Replayable Sources and Idempotent Sinks
Write-ahead Logs and Idempotent Sinks
Checkpointing and Idempotent Sinks
q_zh: Spark 使用什么来记录每个触发器中正在处理的数据的偏移量范围，以便结构化流可靠地跟踪处理的精确进度，从而能够通过重启和/或重新处理来处理任何类型的故障？
exp_zh: 检查点（Checkpointing）和预写日志（Write-ahead Logs）用于存储偏移量和状态，实现容错。

q: What describes when to use the CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE (formerly CREATE INCREMENTAL LIVE TABLE) syntax over the CREATE LIVE TABLE syntax when creating Delta Live Tables (DLT) tables using SQL?
opts: CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE should be used when the subsequent step in the DLT pipeline is static.
CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE should be used when data needs to be processed incrementally.
CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE should be used when data needs to be processed through complicated aggregations.
CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE should be used when the previous step in the DLT pipeline is static.
q_zh: 在使用 SQL 创建 Delta Live Tables 表时，什么描述了何时使用 CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE 语法而不是 CREATE LIVE TABLE 语法？
exp_zh: 当需要增量处理数据时，应使用 CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE。

q: Which type of workloads are compatible with Auto Loader?
opts: Streaming workloads
Machine learning workloads
Serverless workloads
Batch workloads
q_zh: 哪些类型的工作负载与 Auto Loader 兼容？
exp_zh: Auto Loader 主要用于流式工作负载，也可用于批处理，但最核心的是流式。

q: Which query is performing a streaming hop from raw data to a Bronze table?
opts: data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,
q_zh: 哪个查询正在执行从原始数据到青铜表的流式跳跃？
exp_zh: 使用 readStream 从源读取，并写入 Bronze 表。

q: A data engineer has configured a Structured Streaming job to read from a table, manipulate the data, and then perform a streaming write into a new table. The code block used by the data engineer is below: The data engineer only wants the query to process all of the available data in as many batches as required. Which line of code should the data engineer use to fill in the blank?
opts: trigger(availableNow=True)
trigger(processingTime="once")
trigger(continuous="once")
trigger(once=True)
q_zh: 一位数据工程师配置了一个结构化流作业，从表读取数据、处理数据，然后流式写入新表。数据工程师使用的代码块如下：数据工程师只想让查询以所需的批次数处理所有可用数据。应该使用哪行代码填空？
exp_zh: trigger(availableNow=True) 触发可用数据处理模式，一次性处理所有当前可用数据。

q: A data engineer has joined an existing project and they see the following query in the project repository: CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE loyal_customers AS SELECT customer_id FROM STREAM(LIVE.customers) WHERE loyalty_level = 'high'; What describes why the STREAM function is included in the query?
opts: The STREAM function is not needed and will cause an error.
The data in the customers table has been updated since its last run.
The customers table is a streaming live table.
The customers table is a reference to a Structured Streaming query on a PySpark DataFrame.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师加入了一个现有项目，他们在项目仓库中看到以下查询：CREATE STREAMING LIVE TABLE loyal_customers AS SELECT customer_id FROM STREAM(LIVE.customers) WHERE loyalty_level = 'high'; 什么描述了为什么查询中包含 STREAM 函数？
exp_zh: STREAM(LIVE.customers) 表示 customers 表是一个流式表，需要增量处理。

q: Which Structured Streaming query is performing a hop from a Silver table to a Gold table?
opts: data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,
q_zh: 哪个结构化流查询正在执行从银表到金表的跳跃？
exp_zh: 从银表读取，经过聚合后写入金表。

q: When should a data engineer use the MERGE INTO command instead of the INSERT INTO command?
opts: When the location of the data needs to be changed
When the target table is an external table
When the source is not a Delta table
When the target table cannot contain duplicate records
q_zh: 什么时候数据工程师应该使用 MERGE INTO 命令而不是 INSERT INTO 命令？
exp_zh: MERGE INTO 用于根据条件更新或插入，避免重复记录，适用于需要 upsert 的场景。

q: A data engineer is designing a data pipeline. The source system generates files in a shared directory that is also used by other processes. As a result, the files should be kept as is and will accumulate in the directory. The data engineer needs to identify which files are new since the previous run in the pipeline, and set up the pipeline to only ingest those new files with each run. Which tool can the data engineer use to solve this problem?
opts: Unity Catalog
Delta Lake
Databricks SQL
Auto Loader
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在设计一个数据管道。源系统在一个共享目录中生成文件，该目录也被其他进程使用。因此，文件应保持原样，并将在目录中累积。数据工程师需要识别自上次管道运行以来哪些文件是新的，并设置管道每次只摄取这些新文件。数据工程师可以使用哪个工具来解决此问题？
exp_zh: Auto Loader 可以自动识别并仅处理新文件，支持增量摄取。

q: Which tool is used by Auto Loader to process data incrementally?
opts: Checkpointing
Spark Structured Streaming
Databricks SQL
Unity Catalog
q_zh: Auto Loader 使用哪个工具来增量处理数据？
exp_zh: Auto Loader 基于 Spark Structured Streaming 实现增量处理。

q: A data engineer is writing a script designed to ingest new data from cloud storage. In the event of the schema change, the ingestion should fail. It should fail until the changes downstream source can be found and verified as intended. Which command will meet the requirements?
opts: failOnNewColumns
none
rescue
addNewColumns
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在编写一个脚本，旨在从云存储摄取新数据。如果发生 Schema 更改，摄取应该失败，直到下游源的变化被发现并确认为预期更改。哪个命令可以满足要求？
exp_zh: failOnNewColumns 选项会在检测到新列时使作业失败。

q: A data engineer needs to ingest from both streaming and batch sources for a firm that relies on highly accurate data. Occasionally, some of the data picked up by the sensors that provide a streaming input are outside the expected parameters. If this occurs, the data must be dropped, but the stream should not fail. Which feature of Spark Declarative Pipelines meets this requirement?
opts: Change Data Capture
Error Handling
Monitoring
Expectations
q_zh: 一家依赖高度准确数据的公司需要从流式和批处理源摄取数据。偶尔，提供流式输入的传感器拾取的一些数据超出了预期参数。如果发生这种情况，必须丢弃这些数据，但流不应失败。Spark 声明式管道的哪个功能满足此要求？
exp_zh: Expectations 允许定义数据质量规则，违反规则的行可以被丢弃而不停止流。

q: A data engineer has inherited a Databricks pipeline from a previous team. The pipeline is missing SLAs and costs more than the allotted budget. On analysis, it is noted that the cluster is not being fully utilized, and the dataset is getting skewed. How should the data engineer resolve this issue?
opts: Use coalesce() on the dataset to merge partitions and reduce skew.
Increase the number of executors for the job.
Repartition the dataset to have it be more optimally spread across all nodes.
Increase the executor memory for the job.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师从前团队继承了一个 Databricks 管道。管道未达到 SLA，且超出预算。分析发现，集群未被充分利用，数据集出现倾斜。数据工程师应如何解决此问题？
exp_zh: 重新分区（repartition）可以更均匀地分布数据，减少倾斜，提高集群利用率。

q: A data engineer streams customer orders into a Kafka topic (orders_topic) and is currently writing the ingestion script of Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines (SDP). The data engineer needs to ingest the data from Kafka brokers to SDP using Databricks. What is the correct code for ingesting the data?
opts: data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,
q_zh: 一位数据工程师将客户订单流式传输到 Kafka 主题（orders_topic），目前正在编写 Lakeflow Spark 声明式管道的摄取脚本。数据工程师需要使用 Databricks 将数据从 Kafka 代理摄取到 SDP。正确的摄取代码是什么？
exp_zh: 使用 readStream 从 Kafka 读取，格式为 kafka，并设置必要选项。

q: A data engineer has developed an ETL that produce a Delta managed table with liquid clustering feature activated as output. Several consumers are having issues regarding time delay when reading this table. How could the Data Engineer be sure about the OPTIMIZE command has been executed explicitly?
opts: Check the system table system.storage.predictive_optimization_operations_history
Use SHOW TABLES EXTENDED to check the partitions columns used
Use DESCRIBE DETAIL table to see the file size and number of files for the table
Use DESCRIBE HISTORY table to check if exists any OPTIMIZE operation
q_zh: 一位数据工程师开发了一个 ETL，生成了一个启用了 liquid clustering 功能的 Delta 托管表作为输出。几个消费者在读取此表时遇到延迟问题。数据工程师如何确认 OPTIMIZE 命令是否已明确执行？
exp_zh: DESCRIBE HISTORY 可以查看表的历史操作，包括 OPTIMIZE。

q: A data engineer is working on a Databricks project that utilizes cloud storage. The data engineer wants to load several JSON files from containers on a storage account as soon as the file arrives within the storage account. Which syntax should the data engineer follow to first load the files into a dataframe and check that it is working as expected using Python?
opts: df = spark.read.json("input/path")
df = spark.readStream.format("cloud").option("json").load("/input/path")
df = spark.readStream.format("json").load("input/path")
df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles").option("cloudFiles.format", "json").load("/input/path")
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在一个利用云存储的 Databricks 项目上工作。数据工程师希望在文件到达存储账户后立即从存储账户的容器中加载多个 JSON 文件。数据工程师应遵循哪种语法，首先将文件加载到数据框中，并使用 Python 检查其是否按预期工作？
exp_zh: 使用 Auto Loader 的 readStream.format("cloudFiles") 语法。

q: A data engineer is processing ingested streaming tables and needs to filter out NULL values in the order_datetime column from the raw streaming table orders_raw and store the results in a new table, orders_valid using a Spark Declarative Pipeline. Which code snippet should the data engineer use?
opts: data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在处理已摄取的流式表，需要从原始流式表 orders_raw 中过滤掉 order_datetime 列中的 NULL 值，并使用 Spark 声明式管道将结果存储在新表 orders_valid 中。应该使用哪个代码片段？
exp_zh: 使用 SDP 的约束或 WHERE 子句过滤 NULL 值。

q: What is the functionality of AutoLoader in Databricks?
opts: Auto Loader automatically ingests and processes new files from cloud storage, handling both batch and streaming data with support for schema evolution.
Auto Loader automatically ingests and processes new files from cloud storage, handling both batch and streaming data, but does not support schema evolution.
Auto Loader automatically ingests and processes new files from cloud storage, handling only streaming data with no support for schema evolution.
Auto Loader automatically ingests and processes new files from cloud storage, handling batch data with support for schema evolution.
q_zh: Databricks 中 Auto Loader 的功能是什么？
exp_zh: Auto Loader 自动从云存储摄取新文件，支持批处理和流处理，并支持 schema 演化。

q: A data engineer is using the Databricks OPTIMIZE command on a Delta table. What happens when OPTIMIZE is run twice on the same table with the same data?
opts: It has no effect because it is idempotent.
It changes the number of tuples per file significantly.
It further reduces file sizes by re-clustering the data.
It triggers a full liquid clustering process.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在对 Delta 表使用 Databricks OPTIMIZE 命令。当对同一表、相同数据运行两次 OPTIMIZE 时会发生什么？
exp_zh: OPTIMIZE 是幂等的，第二次运行不会改变文件结构。

q: A data engineer is inspecting an ETL pipeline based on a Pyspark job that consistently encounters performance bottlenecks. Based on developer feedback, the data engineer assumes the job is low on compute resources. To pinpoint the issue, the data engineer observes the Spark UI and finds out the job has a high CPU time compared to Task time. Which course of action should the data engineer take?
opts: High CPU time vs Task time means an under-utilized cluster. The data engineer may need to repartition data to spread the jobs more evenly throughout the cluster.
High CPU time vs Task time means efficient use of cluster and no change needed
High CPU time vs Task time means a CPU over-utilized job. The data engineer may need to consider executor and core tuning or resizing the cluster
High CPU time vs Task time means over-utilized memory and the need to increase parallelism
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在检查一个基于 Pyspark 作业的 ETL 管道，该作业一直遇到性能瓶颈。根据开发人员反馈，数据工程师假设作业的计算资源不足。为了查明问题，数据工程师观察 Spark UI，发现作业的 CPU 时间与任务时间之比很高。数据工程师应该采取什么行动？
exp_zh: 高 CPU 时间与任务时间比表明作业是 CPU 密集型的，可能需要调整执行器和核心或调整集群大小。

q: A data engineer needs to parse only png files in a directory that contains files with different suffixes. Which code should the data engineer use to achieve this task?
opts: df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles") .option("cloudFiles.format", "binaryFile") .append("/*.png")
df = spark.readstream. format("cloudFiles") .option("cloudFiles.format", "binaryFile") .option("pathGlobfilter", "*.png") .load(<base-path>)
df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles") .option("cloudFiles.format", "binaryFile") .option("pathGlobfilter", "*.png") .append()
df = spark.readstream.format("cloudFiles") .option("cloudFiles.format", "binaryFile") .load("/*.png")
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要解析一个包含不同后缀文件的目录中仅有的 png 文件。数据工程师应该使用哪个代码来完成此任务？
exp_zh: 使用 pathGlobFilter 选项过滤文件模式，只加载 .png 文件。

q: A data engineer has inherited a Databricks pipeline from a previous team. The pipeline is missing its SLAs, and an initial investigation has identified memory spills in Spark. These increased runtimes are also driving up costs. The data engineer needs to reduce the runtime without significantly increasing costs. What should the data engineer do first to address this issue?
opts: Tweak the "spark.sql.shuffle.partitions" configuration.
Enable autoscaling in the cluster to match the requirements
Use a photon enabled execution engine.
Ensure the cluster uses memory optimized node types.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师从前团队继承了一个 Databricks 管道。管道未达到 SLA，初步调查发现 Spark 中存在内存溢出。这些增加的运行时间也推高了成本。数据工程师需要在不显著增加成本的情况下减少运行时间。数据工程师应该首先做什么来解决此问题？
exp_zh: 调整 spark.sql.shuffle.partitions 可以减少 shuffle 分区数，从而减少内存溢出。

q: A data engineer is facing performance bottlenecks in an e-commerce transactions Delta table. The table is a managed Unity Catalog table, and it uses partitioning and Z-ordering in its data layout scheme. The predictive optimization for Unity Catalog tables is also enabled. The table has a frequently changing query filter, and the data engineer does not observe a benefit of the Data Layout or the Predictive Optimization. How should the data engineer fix the data layout bottlenecks?
opts: Re-write the Data Layout with Liquid Clustering and cluster by the Z-Ordered columns.
Enable Delta Caching so that query results can be read through caches.
Tweak the Z-Order columns and run OPTIMIZE manually.
Switch the Data layout from Partition+Z-Ordering to Automatic Liquid Clustering.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师面临电子商务交易 Delta 表的性能瓶颈。该表是托管在 Unity Catalog 中的表，在其数据布局方案中使用分区和 Z-order。Unity Catalog 表的预测优化也已启用。该表的查询过滤器经常变化，数据工程师没有观察到数据布局或预测优化的好处。数据工程师应如何修复数据布局瓶颈？
exp_zh: 当查询条件经常变化时，静态分区和 Z-order 可能失效，应切换到自动 Liquid Clustering。

q: A data engineer needs to optimize the data layout and query performance for an e-commerce transactions Delta table. The table is partitioned by "purchase_date" a date column which helps with time-based queries but does not optimize searches on user statistics "customer_id", a high-cardinality column. The table is usually queried with filters on "customer_id" within specific date ranges, but since this data is spread across multiple files in each partition, it results in full partition scans and increased runtime and costs. How should the data engineer optimize the Data Layout for efficient reads?
opts: Alter table implementing liquid clustering on "customer_id" while keeping the existing partitioning.
Alter the table implementing liquid clustering by "customer_id" and "purchase_date".
Alter the table to partition by "customer_id".
Enable delta caching on the cluster so that frequent reads are cached for performance.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要优化电子商务交易 Delta 表的数据布局和查询性能。该表按日期列“purchase_date”分区，这有助于基于时间的查询，但不优化对高基数列“customer_id”的搜索。该表通常使用特定日期范围内的“customer_id”过滤器进行查询，但由于此数据分布在每个分区的多个文件中，导致全分区扫描，增加了运行时间和成本。数据工程师应如何优化数据布局以实现高效读取？
exp_zh: 在 customer_id 和 purchase_date 上使用 Liquid Clustering，可以同时优化两个维度的查询。

q: A data analyst has a series of queries in a SQL program. The data analyst wants this program to run every day. They only want the final query in the program to run on Sundays. They ask for help from the data engineering team to complete this task. Which of the following approaches could be used by the data engineering team to complete this task?
opts: They could submit a feature request with Databricks to add this functionality.
They could wrap the queries using PySpark and use Python's control flow system to determine when to run the final query.
They could only run the entire program on Sundays.
They could automatically restrict access to the source table in the final query so that it is only accessible on Sundays.
They could redesign the data model to separate the data used in the final query into a new table.
q_zh: 一位数据分析师有一个 SQL 程序中的一系列查询。分析师希望该程序每天运行，但只想让程序中的最后一个查询在周日运行。他们向数据工程团队寻求帮助来完成此任务。数据工程团队可以使用以下哪种方法来完成此任务？
exp_zh: 可以使用 PySpark 包装查询，利用 Python 的控制流（如日期判断）来决定是否运行最终查询。

q: A data engineer has a single-task Job that runs each morning before they begin working. After identifying an upstream data issue, they need to set up another task to run a new notebook prior to the original task. Which of the following approaches can the data engineer use to set up the new task?
opts: They can clone the existing task in the existing Job and update it to run the new notebook.
They can create a new task in the existing Job and then add it as a dependency of the original task.
They can create a new task in the existing Job and then add the original task as a dependency of the new task.
They can create a new job from scratch and add both tasks to run concurrently.
They can clone the existing task to a new Job and then edit it to run the new notebook.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师有一个单任务作业，每天早上开始工作前运行。在识别出一个上游数据问题后，他们需要在原任务之前设置另一个任务运行一个新笔记本。数据工程师可以使用以下哪种方法来设置新任务？
exp_zh: 在现有作业中创建新任务，并将其设置为原任务的依赖（即新任务先运行，原任务依赖于它）。

q: An engineering manager wants to monitor the performance of a recent project using a Databricks SQL query.
