For the first week following the project's release, the manager wants the query results to be updated every minute. However, the manager is concerned that the compute resources used for the query will be left running and cost the organization a lot of money beyond the first week of the project's release. Which of the following approaches can the engineering team use to ensure the query does not cost the organization any money beyond the first week of the project's release?
opts: They can set a limit to the number of DBUs that are consumed by the SQL Endpoint.
They can set the query's refresh schedule to end after a certain number of refreshes.
They cannot ensure the query does not cost the organization money beyond the first week of the project's release.
They can set a limit to the number of individuals that are able to manage the query's refresh schedule.
They can set the query's refresh schedule to end on a certain date in the query scheduler.
q_zh: 一位工程经理希望使用 Databricks SQL 查询监控最近项目的性能。在项目发布后的第一周，经理希望查询结果每分钟更新一次。但是，经理担心用于查询的计算资源将在第一周后继续运行，给组织带来大量成本。工程团队可以使用以下哪种方法来确保查询在项目发布一周后不会给组织带来任何成本？
exp_zh: 可以在查询调度器中设置刷新计划在特定日期结束。

q: A data engineer wants to schedule their Databricks SQL dashboard to refresh once per day, but they only want the associated SQL endpoint to be running when it is necessary. Which of the following approaches can the data engineer use to minimize the total running time of the SQL endpoint used in the refresh schedule of their dashboard?
opts: They can ensure the dashboard's SQL endpoint matches each of the queries' SQL endpoints.
They can set up the dashboard's SQL endpoint to be serverless.
They can turn on the Auto Stop feature for the SQL endpoint.
They can reduce the cluster size of the SQL endpoint.
They can ensure the dashboard's SQL endpoint is not one of the included query's SQL endpoint.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师希望每天刷新一次 Databricks SQL 仪表板，但他们只希望关联的 SQL 端点在必要时运行。数据工程师可以使用以下哪种方法来最小化其仪表板刷新计划中使用的 SQL 端点的总运行时间？
exp_zh: 开启 SQL 端点的自动停止功能，可以在无活动时自动关闭，节省成本。

q: A data engineer has a Job with multiple tasks that runs nightly. Each of the tasks runs slowly because the clusters take a long time to start. Which of the following actions can the data engineer perform to improve the start up time for the clusters used for the Job?
opts: They can use endpoints available in Databricks SQL
They can use jobs clusters instead of all-purpose clusters
They can configure the clusters to be single-node
They can use clusters that are from a cluster pool
They can configure the clusters to autoscale for larger data sizes
q_zh: 一位数据工程师有一个多任务作业，每晚运行。每个任务运行缓慢，因为集群启动需要很长时间。数据工程师可以执行以下哪个操作来改善作业所用集群的启动时间？
exp_zh: 使用集群池可以预启动集群实例，减少启动延迟。

q: A Delta Live Table pipeline includes two datasets defined using STREAMING LIVE TABLE. Three datasets are defined against Delta Lake table sources using LIVE TABLE. The table is configured to run in Development mode using the Continuous Pipeline Mode. Assuming previously unprocessed data exists and all definitions are valid, what is the expected outcome after clicking Start to update the pipeline?
opts: All datasets will be updated once and the pipeline will shut down. The compute resources will be terminated.
All datasets will be updated at set intervals until the pipeline is shut down. The compute resources will persist until the pipeline is shut down.
All datasets will be updated once and the pipeline will persist without any processing. The compute resources will persist but go unused.
All datasets will be updated once and the pipeline will shut down. The compute resources will persist to allow for additional testing.
All datasets will be updated at set intervals until the pipeline is shut down. The compute resources will persist to allow for additional testing.
q_zh: 一个 Delta Live Table 管道包含两个使用 STREAMING LIVE TABLE 定义的数据集。三个数据集使用 LIVE TABLE 针对 Delta Lake 表源定义。该表配置为使用连续管道模式在开发模式下运行。假设存在未处理的数据且所有定义有效，单击 Start 更新管道后的预期结果是什么？
exp_zh: 在开发模式下连续运行，数据集将按设定间隔更新，计算资源持续存在以便测试。

q: A data engineering team has noticed that their Databricks SQL queries are running too slowly when they are submitted to a non-running SQL endpoint. The data engineering team wants this issue to be resolved. Which approach can the team use to reduce the time it takes to return results in this scenario?
opts: They can increase the maximum bound of the SQL endpoint's scaling range.
They can turn on the Auto Stop feature for the SQL endpoint.
They can increase the cluster size of the SQL endpoint.
They can turn on the Serverless feature for the SQL endpoint.
q_zh: 一个数据工程团队注意到，当他们的 Databricks SQL 查询提交到非运行的 SQL 端点时，运行太慢。数据工程团队希望解决此问题。团队可以使用哪种方法来减少在这种情况下返回结果所需的时间？
exp_zh: 开启 Serverless 功能可以消除启动延迟，立即响应查询。

q: Which of the following approaches should be used to send the Databricks Job owner an email in the case that the Job fails?
opts: Manually programming in an alert system in each cell of the Notebook
Setting up an Alert in the Job page
Setting up an Alert in the Notebook
There is no way to notify the Job owner in the case of Job failure
MLflow Model Registry Webhooks
q_zh: 在作业失败的情况下，应该使用以下哪种方法向 Databricks 作业所有者发送电子邮件？
exp_zh: 在作业页面设置警报，可以配置失败时发送通知。

q: A data engineer has been using a Databricks SQL dashboard to monitor the cleanliness of the input data to a data analytics dashboard for a retail use case. The job has a Databricks SQL query that returns the number of store-level records where sales is equal to zero. The data engineer wants their entire team to be notified via a messaging webhook whenever this value is greater than 0. Which approach can the data engineer use to notify their entire team via a messaging webhook whenever the number of stores with $0 in sales is greater than zero?
opts: They can set up an Alert with a custom template.
They can set up an Alert with a new email alert destination.
They can set up an Alert with one-time notifications.
They can set up an Alert with a new webhook alert destination.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师使用 Databricks SQL 仪表板监控零售用例中输入数据的清洁度。该作业有一个 Databricks SQL 查询，返回销售额等于零的门店级记录数。数据工程师希望每当这个值大于 0 时，通过消息 webhook 通知整个团队。数据工程师可以使用哪种方法来通过消息 webhook 通知整个团队？
exp_zh: 在 Databricks SQL 中，可以设置警报，并配置 webhook 作为通知目的地。

q: A data engineer wants to schedule their Databricks SQL dashboard to refresh every hour, but they only want the associated SQL endpoint to be running when it is necessary. The dashboard has multiple queries on multiple datasets associated with it. The data that feeds the dashboard is automatically processed using a Databricks Job. Which approach can the data engineer use to minimize the total running time of the SQL endpoint used in the refresh schedule of their dashboard?
opts: They can turn on the Auto Stop feature for the SQL endpoint.
They can set up the dashboard's SQL endpoint to be serverless.
They can reduce the cluster size of the SQL endpoint.
They can ensure the dashboard's SQL endpoint matches each of the queries' SQL endpoints.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师希望每小时刷新一次 Databricks SQL 仪表板，但他们只希望关联的 SQL 端点在必要时运行。仪表板关联了多个数据集上的多个查询。为仪表板提供数据的数据通过 Databricks 作业自动处理。数据工程师可以使用哪种方法来最小化其仪表板刷新计划中使用的 SQL 端点的总运行时间？
exp_zh: 开启 SQL 端点的自动停止功能，可以在无活动时自动关闭，节省成本。

q: A Delta Live Table pipeline includes two datasets defined using STREAMING LIVE TABLE. Three datasets are defined against Delta Lake table sources using LIVE TABLE. The table is configured to run in Production mode using the Continuous Pipeline Mode. What is the expected outcome after clicking Start to update the pipeline assuming previously unprocessed data exists and all definitions are valid?
opts: All datasets will be updated at set intervals until the pipeline is shut down. The compute resources will persist to allow for additional testing.
All datasets will be updated once and the pipeline will shut down. The compute resources will persist to allow for additional testing.
All datasets will be updated at set intervals until the pipeline is shut down. The compute resources will be deployed for the update and terminated when the pipeline is stopped.
All datasets will be updated once and the pipeline will shut down. The compute resources will be terminated.
q_zh: 一个 Delta Live Table 管道包含两个使用 STREAMING LIVE TABLE 定义的数据集。三个数据集使用 LIVE TABLE 针对 Delta Lake 表源定义。该表配置为使用连续管道模式在生产模式下运行。假设存在未处理的数据且所有定义有效，单击 Start 更新管道后的预期结果是什么？
exp_zh: 在生产模式下连续运行，数据集将按设定间隔更新，计算资源在停止管道时终止。

q: A data engineer has a Job with multiple tasks that runs nightly. Each of the tasks runs slowly because the clusters take a long time to start. Which action can the data engineer perform to improve the start up time for the clusters used for the Job?
opts: They can use endpoints available in Databricks SQL
They can use jobs clusters instead of all-purpose clusters
They can configure the clusters to autoscale for larger data sizes
They can use clusters that are from a cluster pool
q_zh: 一位数据工程师有一个多任务作业，每晚运行。每个任务运行缓慢，因为集群启动需要很长时间。数据工程师可以执行哪个操作来改善作业所用集群的启动时间？
exp_zh: 使用集群池可以预启动集群实例，减少启动延迟。

q: A data engineer has a single-task Job that runs each morning before they begin working. After identifying an upstream data issue, they need to set up another task to run a new notebook prior to the original task. Which approach can the data engineer use to set up the new task?
opts: They can clone the existing task in the existing Job and update it to run the new notebook.
They can create a new task in the existing Job and then add it as a dependency of the original task.
They can create a new task in the existing Job and then add the original task as a dependency of the new task.
They can create a new job from scratch and add both tasks to run concurrently.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师有一个单任务作业，每天早上开始工作前运行。在识别出一个上游数据问题后，他们需要在原任务之前设置另一个任务运行一个新笔记本。数据工程师可以使用哪种方法来设置新任务？
exp_zh: 在现有作业中创建新任务，并将其设置为原任务的依赖（即新任务先运行，原任务依赖于它）。

q: A single Job runs two notebooks as two separate tasks. A data engineer has noticed that one of the notebooks is running slowly in the Job's current run. The data engineer asks a tech lead for help in identifying why this might be the case. Which approach can the tech lead use to identify why the notebook is running slowly as part of the Job?
opts: They can navigate to the Runs tab in the Jobs UI to immediately review the processing notebook.
They can navigate to the Tasks tab in the Jobs UI and click on the active run to review the processing notebook.
They can navigate to the Runs tab in the Jobs UI and click on the active run to review the processing notebook.
They can navigate to the Tasks tab in the Jobs UI to immediately review the processing notebook.
q_zh: 一个作业运行两个笔记本作为两个独立任务。一位数据工程师注意到其中一个笔记本在当前作业运行中运行缓慢。数据工程师向技术负责人寻求帮助，以确定可能的原因。技术负责人可以使用哪种方法来识别笔记本在作业中运行缓慢的原因？
exp_zh: 在 Jobs UI 中，进入 Runs 选项卡，点击正在运行的作业，可以查看任务详情和日志。

q: A data analysis team has noticed that their Databricks SQL queries are running too slowly when connected to their always-on SQL endpoint. They claim that this issue is present when many members of the team are running small queries simultaneously. They ask the data engineering team for help. The data engineering team notices that each of the team's queries uses the same SQL endpoint. Which approach can the data engineering team use to improve the latency of the team's queries?
opts: They can increase the cluster size of the SQL endpoint.
They can increase the maximum bound of the SQL endpoint's scaling range.
They can turn on the Auto Stop feature for the SQL endpoint.
They can turn on the Serverless feature for the SQL endpoint.
q_zh: 一个数据分析团队注意到，当连接到他们始终在线的 SQL 端点时，Databricks SQL 查询运行太慢。他们声称当团队许多成员同时运行小查询时会出现此问题。他们向数据工程团队寻求帮助。数据工程团队注意到团队的每个查询都使用同一个 SQL 端点。数据工程团队可以使用哪种方法来改善团队查询的延迟？
exp_zh: 增加 SQL 端点的最大缩放范围可以处理更多并发查询，提高吞吐量。

q: A data engineer has been using a Databricks SQL dashboard to monitor the cleanliness of the input data to an ELT job. The ELT job has its Databricks SQL query that returns the number of input records containing unexpected NULL values. The data engineer wants their entire team to be notified via a messaging webhook whenever this value reaches 100. Which approach can the data engineer use to notify their entire team via a messaging webhook whenever the number of NULL values reaches 100?
opts: They can set up an Alert with a custom template.
They can set up an Alert with a new email alert destination.
They can set up an Alert with a new webhook alert destination.
They can set up an Alert with one-time notifications.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师使用 Databricks SQL 仪表板监控 ELT 作业输入数据的清洁度。ELT 作业有一个 Databricks SQL 查询，返回包含意外 NULL 值的输入记录数。数据工程师希望每当这个值达到 100 时，通过消息 webhook 通知整个团队。数据工程师可以使用哪种方法来通过消息 webhook 通知整个团队？
exp_zh: 在 Databricks SQL 中，可以设置警报，并配置 webhook 作为通知目的地。

q: A data engineer wants to schedule their Databricks SQL dashboard to refresh once per day, but they only want the associated SQL endpoint to be running when it is necessary. Which approach can the data engineer use to minimize the total running time of the SQL endpoint used in the refresh schedule of their dashboard?
opts: They can ensure the dashboard's SQL endpoint matches each of the queries' SQL endpoints.
They can set up the dashboard's SQL endpoint to be serverless.
They can turn on the Auto Stop feature for the SQL endpoint.
They can ensure the dashboard's SQL endpoint is not one of the included query's SQL endpoint.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师希望每天刷新一次 Databricks SQL 仪表板，但他们只希望关联的 SQL 端点在必要时运行。数据工程师可以使用哪种方法来最小化其仪表板刷新计划中使用的 SQL 端点的总运行时间？
exp_zh: 开启 SQL 端点的自动停止功能，可以在无活动时自动关闭，节省成本。

q: An engineering manager wants to monitor the performance of a recent project using a Databricks SQL query. For the first week following the project's release, the manager wants the query results to be updated every minute. However, the manager is concerned that the compute resources used for the query will be left running and cost the organization a lot of money beyond the first week of the project's release. Which approach can the engineering team use to ensure the query does not cost the organization any money beyond the first week of the project's release?
opts: They can set a limit to the number of DBUs that are consumed by the SQL Endpoint.
They can set the query's refresh schedule to end after a certain number of refreshes.
They can set the query's refresh schedule to end on a certain date in the query scheduler.
They can set a limit to the number of individuals that are able to manage the query's refresh schedule.
q_zh: 一位工程经理希望使用 Databricks SQL 查询监控最近项目的性能。在项目发布后的第一周，经理希望查询结果每分钟更新一次。但是，经理担心用于查询的计算资源将在第一周后继续运行，给组织带来大量成本。工程团队可以使用哪种方法来确保查询在项目发布一周后不会给组织带来任何成本？
exp_zh: 可以在查询调度器中设置刷新计划在特定日期结束。

q: Differentiate between all-purpose clusters and jobs clusters. A data engineering team has created a python notebook to load data from cloud storage, this job has been tested and now needs to be scheduled in production. Which would be the best cluster to be used in this case?
opts: All purpose cluster
Any Unity Catalog-enabled cluster
Jobs Cluster
Serverless SQL warehouse
q_zh: 区分全用途集群和作业集群。一个数据工程团队创建了一个从云存储加载数据的 Python 笔记本，该作业已经过测试，现在需要安排在生产环境中运行。在这种情况下，最好的集群是哪个？
exp_zh: 生产调度作业应使用作业集群，它们为运行作业而优化，并在完成后自动终止。

q: A data engineer and data analyst are working together on a data pipeline. The data engineer is working on the raw, bronze, and silver layers of the pipeline using Python, and the data analyst is working on the gold layer of the pipeline using SQL. The raw source of the pipeline is a streaming input. They now want to migrate their pipeline to use Delta Live Tables. Which change will need to be made to the pipeline when migrating to Delta Live Tables?
opts: The pipeline can have different notebook sources in SQL & Python.
The pipeline will need to be written entirely in SQL.
The pipeline will need to use a batch source in place of a streaming source.
The pipeline will need to be written entirely in Python.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师和一位数据分析师正在合作开发一个数据管道。数据工程师使用 Python 处理管道的原始层、青铜层和银层，数据分析师使用 SQL 处理管道的金层。管道的原始源是流式输入。他们现在希望将管道迁移到使用 Delta Live Tables。迁移到 Delta Live Tables 时，需要对管道进行哪些更改？
exp_zh: Delta Live Tables 支持在同一个管道中混合使用 SQL 和 Python 笔记本，因此无需更改。

q: Which method should a Data Engineer apply to ensure Workflows are being triggered on schedule?
opts: Scheduled Workflows require an always-running cluster, which is more expensive but reduces processing latency.
Scheduled Workflows process data as it arrives at configured sources.
Scheduled Workflows can reduce resource consumption and expense since the cluster runs only long enough to execute the pipeline.
Scheduled Workflows run continuously until manually stopped.
q_zh: 数据工程师应采用哪种方法确保工作流按计划触发？
exp_zh: 计划工作流可以使用作业集群，该集群仅在运行时启动，完成后终止，从而减少资源消耗和成本。

q: An engineering manager uses a Databricks SQL query to monitor ingestion latency for each data source. The manager checks the results of the query every day, but they are manually rerunning the query each day and waiting for the results. Which approach can the manager use to ensure the results of the query are updated each day?
opts: They can schedule the query to refresh every 1 day from the SQL endpoint’s page in Databricks SQL.
They can schedule the query to refresh every 12 hours from the SQL endpoint’s page in Databricks SQL.
They can schedule the query to refresh every 1 day from the query’s page in Databricks SQL.
They can schedule the query to run every 12 hours from the Jobs UI.
q_zh: 一位工程经理使用Databricks SQL查询监控每个数据源的摄取延迟。经理每天检查查询结果，但每天手动重新运行查询并等待结果。经理可以使用哪种方法来确保查询结果每天更新？
exp_zh: 在Databricks SQL中，可以从查询页面设置刷新计划，实现每天自动更新。

q: What must be specified when creating a new Delta Live Tables pipeline?
opts: A key-value pair configuration
At least one notebook library to be executed
A path to cloud storage location for the written data
A location of a target database for the written data
q_zh: 创建新的Delta Live Tables管道时必须指定什么？
exp_zh: 创建DLT管道时，必须指定至少一个要执行的笔记本库。注意：官方文档可能强调需要指定目标数据库位置。

q: In which scenario should a data engineer select a Task in the Depends On field of a new Databricks Job Task?
opts: When another task needs to be replaced by the new task
When another task needs to successfully complete before the new task begins
When another task has the same dependency libraries as the new task
When another task needs to use as little compute resources as possible
q_zh: 在哪种情况下，数据工程师应该在新Databricks作业任务的Depends On字段中选择一个任务？
exp_zh: 当新任务需要依赖另一个任务成功完成后才能启动时，应在Depends On中选择该任务。

q: A data engineer has a Job that has a complex run schedule, and they want to transfer that schedule to other Jobs. Rather than manually selecting each value in the scheduling form in Databricks, what tool can the data engineer use to represent and submit the schedule programmatically?
opts: pyspark.sql.types.DateType
datetime
pyspark.sql.types.TimestampType
Cron syntax
q_zh: 一位数据工程师有一个作业具有复杂的运行计划，他们希望将该计划转移到其他作业。数据工程师可以使用什么工具来以编程方式表示和提交计划，而不是在Databricks的调度表单中手动选择每个值？
exp_zh: Cron语法可以用来以字符串形式表示复杂的调度计划，并在Databricks作业中使用。

q: A data engineer and data analyst are working together on a data pipeline. The data engineer is working on the raw, bronze, and silver layers of the pipeline using Python, and the data analyst is working on the gold layer of the pipeline using SQL. The raw source of the pipeline is a streaming input. They now want to migrate their pipeline to use Delta Live Tables. Which of the following changes will need to be made to the pipeline when migrating to Delta Live Tables?
opts: The pipeline will need to be written entirely in Python
The pipeline will need to stop using the medallion-based multi-hop architecture
The pipeline will need to be written entirely in SQL
The pipeline will need to use a batch source in place of a streaming source
q_zh: 一位数据工程师和一位数据分析师正在合作开发一个数据管道。数据工程师使用Python处理管道的原始层、青铜层和银层，数据分析师使用SQL处理管道的金层。管道的原始源是流式输入。他们现在希望将管道迁移到使用Delta Live Tables。迁移到Delta Live Tables时，需要对管道进行以下哪些更改？
exp_zh: 注意：此选项可能不正确，但根据原题给出的答案，我们选择A。实际上DLT支持混合语言，不需要完全用Python。

q: A data engineer is working in a Databricks notebook to design and manage a batch ETL pipeline. The engineer is writing SQL and Python code to clean data, transform it, and join large datasets from different sources. The engineer wants to organize these steps into a structured process that can be run regularly and scheduled as part of a data pipeline. Which Databricks notebook feature is applicable in the use case?
opts: Real-time streaming support
Collaborative editing
Task workflows and job scheduling
Notebook version control
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在Databricks笔记本中设计和管理一个批处理ETL管道。工程师正在编写SQL和Python代码来清洗数据、转换数据，并连接来自不同来源的大型数据集。工程师希望将这些步骤组织成一个结构化的过程，可以定期运行并作为数据管道的一部分进行调度。哪种Databricks笔记本功能适用于此用例？
exp_zh: 任务工作流和作业调度允许将笔记本步骤组织为任务，并定期调度运行。

q: A data engineer needs to develop integration tests for an ETL process and deploy a version-controlled, packaged workflow into production using an external job scheduler. Which tool should the data engineer use for this job?
opts: Databricks Connect
Databricks Asset Bundles
Databricks Command Line Interface
Databricks Software Development Kit
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要为ETL过程开发集成测试，并使用外部作业调度器将版本控制、打包的工作流部署到生产环境。数据工程师应该使用哪个工具来完成这项工作？
exp_zh: Databricks Asset Bundles允许将工作流打包、版本控制，并部署到生产环境。

q: Which Databricks asset bundle format is valid?
opts: resources: jobs: hello-job: name: hello-job tasks: - task_key: hello-task existing_cluster_id: 1234-567890-abcde123 notebook_task: notebook_path: ./ hello.py
"resources":{ "jobs":{ "name":"hello-job", "tasks":{ "task_key:"hello-task", "existing_cluster_id":"1234-567890-abcde123", "notebook_task": { "notebook_path": ".hello.py" } } }
configuration = { "resources":{ "jobs":{ "name":"hello-job", "tasks": { "task_key:"hello-task", "existing_cluster_id":"1234-567890-abcde123", "notebook_task":{ "notebook_path": ".hello.py" } } } }
resources { jobs { name = "hello-job" tasks{ task_key = "hello-task" existing_cluster_id = "1234-567890-abcde123" notebook_task{ notebook_path = ".hello.py" } } } }
q_zh: 哪个Databricks资产包格式是有效的？
exp_zh: Databricks资产包使用YAML格式，是有效的YAML结构。

q: A data engineer is designing an ETL pipeline to process both streaming and batch data from multiple sources. The pipeline must ensure data quality, handle schema evolution, and provide easy maintenance. The team is considering using Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines in Databricks to achieve these goals. They want to understand the key features and benefits of LDP that make it suitable for this use case. Why is Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipeline an appropriate choice?
opts: Automatic data quality checks, built-in support for schema evolution, and declarative pipeline development
Manual schema enforcement, high operational overhead, and limited scalability
Requires custom code for data quality checks, no support for streaming data, and complex pipeline maintenance
Supports only batch processing, no data versioning, and high infrastructure costs
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在设计一个ETL管道，以处理来自多个来源的流式和批处理数据。管道必须确保数据质量、处理schema演化，并提供易于维护。团队正在考虑使用Databricks中的Lakeflow Spark声明式管道来实现这些目标。他们想了解LDP的关键特性和优势，使其适合此用例。为什么Lakeflow Spark声明式管道是一个合适的选择？
exp_zh: Lakeflow Spark声明式管道提供自动数据质量检查、内置schema演化支持和声明式管道开发。

q: A data engineer is building a simple data pipeline using Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines (SDP) in Databricks to ingest customer data. The raw customer data is stored in a cloud storage location in JSON format. The task is to create an SDP that reads the raw JSON data and writes it into a Delta table for further processing. Which code snippet will correctly ingest the raw JSON data and create a Delta table using SDP?
opts: data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,

data:image/jpeg;base64,
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在使用Databricks中的Lakeflow Spark声明式管道构建一个简单的数据管道，以摄取客户数据。原始客户数据以JSON格式存储在云存储位置中。任务是创建一个SDP，读取原始JSON数据并将其写入Delta表以供进一步处理。哪个代码片段将正确地使用SDP摄取原始JSON数据并创建Delta表？
exp_zh: 使用 @dlt.table 和 spark.read.json 读取JSON数据。

q: A Python file is ready to go into production and the client wants to use the cheapest but most efficient type of cluster possible. The workload is quite small, only processing 10GBs of data with only simple joins and no complex aggregations or wide transformations. Which cluster meets the requirement?
opts: Interactive cluster
Job cluster with spot instances enabled
Job cluster with spot instances disabled
Job cluster with Photon enabled
q_zh: 一个Python文件准备投入生产，客户希望使用尽可能便宜但最高效的集群类型。工作负载非常小，只处理10GB数据，只有简单的连接，没有复杂的聚合或宽转换。哪个集群满足要求？
exp_zh: 启用竞价实例的作业集群可以降低成本，同时满足小规模工作负载。

q: A Databricks workflow fails at the last stage due to an error in a notebook. This workflow runs daily. The data engineer fixes the mistake and wants to rerun the pipeline. This workflow is very costly and time-intensive to run. Which action should the data engineer do in order to minimise downtime and cost?
opts: Re-run the entire workflow
Repair run
Restart the cluster
Switch to another cluster
q_zh: 一个Databricks工作流在最后阶段因笔记本错误而失败。该工作流每天运行。数据工程师修复了错误，想要重新运行管道。该工作流运行成本高且耗时。数据工程师应该采取哪种行动来最小化停机时间和成本？
exp_zh: 使用修复运行功能可以只重新运行失败的任务，而不是整个工作流。

q: A Databricks single-task workflow fails at the last task due to an error in a notebook. The data engineer fixes the mistake in the notebook. What should the data engineer do to rerun the workflow?
opts: Repair the task
Rerun the pipeline
Restart the cluster
Switch the cluster
q_zh: 一个Databricks单任务工作流在最后一个任务因笔记本错误而失败。数据工程师修复了笔记本中的错误。数据工程师应该做什么来重新运行工作流？
exp_zh: 修复任务可以只重新运行失败的任务。

q: What is the structure of an Asset Bundle?
opts: A Docker image containing runtime environments and the source code of the assets
A compressed archive (ZIP) that solely contains workspace assets without any accompanying metadata
A single plain text file enumerating the names of assets to be migrated to a new workspace
A YAML configuration file that specifies the artifacts, resources, and configurations for the project
q_zh: 资产包的结构是什么？
exp_zh: 资产包是一个YAML配置文件，指定项目的工件、资源和配置。

q: A data engineer is maintaining an ETL pipeline code with a GitHub repository linked to their Databricks account. The data engineer wants to deploy the ETL pipeline to production as a Databricks job. Which approach should the data engineer use?
opts: Use Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB) + GitHub Integration
Maintain workflow_config.json and deploy it using Databricks CLI
Maintain workflow_config.json and deploy it using Terraform
Manually create and manage the workflow in UI
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在维护一个ETL管道代码，该代码与链接到其Databricks账户的GitHub仓库关联。数据工程师希望将ETL管道作为Databricks作业部署到生产环境。数据工程师应该使用哪种方法？
exp_zh: Databricks资产包结合GitHub集成，可以实现版本控制和自动化部署。

q: A data engineer works for an organization that must meet a stringent Service Level Agreement (SLA) that demands minimal runtime errors and high availability for its data processing pipelines. The data engineer wants to avoid the operational overhead of managing and tuning clusters. Which architectural solution will meet the requirements?
opts: Use an auto-scaling cluster configured and monitored by the user.
Implement a hybrid approach with scheduled batch jobs on custom cloud VMs.
Deploy a dedicated, manually managed cluster optimized by in-house IT staff.
Utilize Databricks serverless compute that automatically optimizes resources and abstracts cluster management.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师为一个必须满足严格服务级别协议的组织工作，该协议要求数据处理管道的运行时错误最小化、高可用性。数据工程师希望避免管理和调优集群的操作开销。哪种架构解决方案将满足要求？
exp_zh: Databricks serverless compute自动优化资源并抽象集群管理，减少操作开销。

q: A data engineer wants to reduce costs and optimize cloud spending. The data engineer has decided to use Databricks Serverless for lowering cloud costs while maintaining existing SLAs. What is the first step in migrating to Databricks Serverless?
opts: Legacy Ingestion pipelines that include ingestion from sources API's, files, JDBC/ODBC connections
A frequently running and efficient Python-based data transformation pipeline compatible with the latest Databricks runtime and Unity Catalog
A frequently running and efficient Scala-based data transformation pipeline compatible with the latest Databricks runtime and Unity Catalog
Low frequency BI Dashboarding and Adhoc SQL Analytics
q_zh: 一位数据工程师希望降低成本并优化云支出。数据工程师决定使用Databricks Serverless来降低云成本，同时维持现有的SLA。迁移到Databricks Serverless的第一步是什么？
exp_zh: 首先迁移频繁运行且与最新运行时和Unity Catalog兼容的Python管道，以最大化成本效益。

q: A data engineering project involves processing large batches of data on a daily schedule using ETL. The jobs are resource-intensive and vary in size, requiring a scalable, cost-efficient compute solution that can automatically scale based on the workload. Which computing approach will satisfy the needs described?
opts: Job Cluster
Dedicated Cluster
All-Purpose Cluster
Databricks SQL Serverless
q_zh: 一个数据工程项目涉及使用ETL按日计划处理大批量数据。这些作业资源密集，大小不一，需要一个可扩展、成本高效的计算解决方案，能够根据工作负载自动扩展。哪种计算方法将满足所描述的需求？
exp_zh: 作业集群为调度作业而设计，可以自动缩放，并在作业完成后终止，符合成本效益。

q: A Databricks single-task workflow fails due to an error in a notebook. The data engineer fixes the mistake in the notebook. What should the data engineer do to rerun the workflow?
opts: Repair the task
Repair the run
Restart the Cluster
Swap the cluster
q_zh: 一个Databricks单任务工作流因笔记本错误而失败。数据工程师修复了笔记本中的错误。数据工程师应该做什么来重新运行工作流？
exp_zh: 修复运行可以重新执行失败的任务，无需重新创建整个工作流。

q: A Python file is ready for production and the client wants to use the most efficient yet cost-effective type of cluster possible. The workload is quite small, only processing 10GBs of data with only simple joins and no complex aggregations or wide transformations. Which cluster meets the requirement?
opts: Job cluster with spot instances enabled
Job cluster with Photon enabled
Job cluster with spot instances disabled
Interactive cluster
q_zh: 一个Python文件准备投入生产，客户希望使用尽可能高效且成本效益高的集群类型。工作负载非常小，只处理10GB数据，只有简单的连接，没有复杂的聚合或宽转换。哪个集群满足要求？
exp_zh: 启用竞价实例的作业集群可以降低成本，同时满足小规模工作负载。

q: A data engineer is migrating pipeline tasks to reduce operational toil. The workspace used Unity Catalog and is in a region that supports serverless. The engineer wants Databricks to auto-select instance types, manage scaling, apply Photon, and handle runtime upgrades automatically for job runs. How should the data engineer meet this requirement while adhering to Databricks constraints?
opts: Run the job on a serverless compute for workflows configuration, ensuring Unity Catalog is enabled and regional support is available.
Use a Pro SQL warehouse and schedule Python notebook tasks to execute as pipeline steps.
Create a job with a single-task job cluster and manually set instance families and min/max workers.
Use an all-purpose cluster with cluster policies to enforce standard sizes and enable autoscaling.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在迁移管道任务以减少操作负担。工作区使用Unity Catalog且位于支持无服务器的区域。工程师希望Databricks自动选择实例类型、管理缩放、应用Photon并自动处理作业运行的运行时升级。在遵守Databricks约束的前提下，数据工程师应如何满足此要求？
exp_zh: 在启用Unity Catalog且区域支持的情况下，为工作流配置无服务器计算，可实现自动管理。

q: A data engineer is standardizing repository layouts for multiple teams adopting Databricks Asset Bundles. The engineer wants to ensure every project has a single authoritative configuration file at the repository root that defines the bundle name, targets, workspace settings, permissions, and resource mappings (for jobs and pipelines). What strategy should the data engineer use to meet the goal?
opts: Place multiple databricks.yml files under each subfolder (for example, jobs/pipelines/, workspace/) and merge them at deploy time using the include mapping.
Place exactly one databricks.yml at the repository root; it is the main configuration file and may reference additional configuration files via the include mapping.
Place a databricks.yml in a databricks/hidden folder at the repository root; only hidden locations are valid for bundle configs.
Place a databricks.yaml at the repository root and optional databricks.yml in subfolders; the CLI prefers .yaml over .yml when both exist.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在为多个采用Databricks资产包的团队标准化仓库布局。工程师希望确保每个项目在仓库根目录下有一个权威配置文件，定义包名称、目标、工作区设置、权限和资源映射（用于作业和管道）。数据工程师应使用哪种策略来实现目标？
exp_zh: Databricks资产包要求在仓库根目录有一个权威的databricks.yml文件，可以通过include映射引用其他文件。

q: A data engineer has left the organization. The data team needs to transfer ownership of the data engineer’s Delta tables to a new data engineer. The new data engineer is the lead engineer on the data team. Assuming the original data engineer no longer has access, which of the following individuals must be the one to transfer ownership of the Delta tables in Data Explorer?
opts: Databricks account representative
This transfer is not possible
Workspace administrator
New lead data engineer
Original data engineer
q_zh: 一位数据工程师离开了组织。数据团队需要将该数据工程师的Delta表所有权转移给新的数据工程师。新的数据工程师是数据团队的首席工程师。假设原数据工程师不再拥有访问权限，以下哪个人必须是在Data Explorer中转移Delta表所有权的人？
exp_zh: 只有工作区管理员可以转移表的所有权。

q: A data engineer is maintaining a data pipeline. Upon data ingestion, the data engineer notices that the source data is starting to have a lower level of quality. The data engineer would like to automate the process of monitoring the quality level. Which of the following tools can the data engineer use to solve this problem?
opts: Unity Catalog
Data Explorer
Delta Lake
Delta Live Tables
Auto Loader
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在维护一个数据管道。在数据摄取时，数据工程师注意到源数据的质量开始下降。数据工程师希望自动化监控质量水平的过程。数据工程师可以使用以下哪个工具来解决此问题？
exp_zh: Delta Live Tables提供了数据质量监控功能（Expectations）。

q: A dataset has been defined using Delta Live Tables and includes an expectations clause: CONSTRAINT valid_timestamp EXPECT (timestamp > '2020-01-01') ON VIOLATION DROP ROW. What is the expected behavior when a batch of data containing data that violates these constraints is processed?
opts: Records that violate the expectation are dropped from the target dataset and loaded into a quarantine table.
Records that violate the expectation cause the job to fail.
Records that violate the expectation are dropped from the target dataset and recorded as invalid in the event log.
Records that violate the expectation are added to the target dataset and recorded as invalid in the event log.
q_zh: 一个数据集使用Delta Live Tables定义，并包含一个期望子句：CONSTRAINT valid_timestamp EXPECT (timestamp > '2020-01-01') ON VIOLATION DROP ROW。当处理一批包含违反这些约束的数据时，预期行为是什么？
exp_zh: 违反期望的行将被丢弃，并在事件日志中记录为无效。

q: A data engineer has three tables in a Delta Live Tables (DLT) pipeline. They have configured the pipeline to drop invalid records at each table. They notice that some data is being dropped due to quality concerns at some point in the DLT pipeline. They would like to determine at which table in their pipeline the data is being dropped. Which of the following approaches can the data engineer take to identify the table that is dropping the records?
opts: They can set up separate expectations for each table when developing their DLT pipeline.
They cannot determine which table is dropping the records.
They can set up DLT to notify them via email when records are dropped.
They can navigate to the DLT pipeline page, click on each table, and view the data quality statistics.
They can navigate to the DLT pipeline page, click on the "Error" button, and review the present errors.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师在Delta Live Tables管道中有三个表。他们配置了管道在每个表丢弃无效记录。他们注意到由于质量问题，在管道中的某个点有数据被丢弃。他们想确定管道中哪个表在丢弃记录。数据工程师可以使用以下哪种方法来识别丢弃记录的表？
exp_zh: 在DLT管道页面，点击每个表可以查看数据质量统计信息，包括丢弃的记录数。

q: A new data engineering team team has been assigned to an ELT project. The new data engineering team will need full privileges on the database customers to fully manage the project. Which of the following commands can be used to grant full permissions on the database to the new data engineering team?
opts: GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE customers TO team;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE team TO customers;
GRANT SELECT PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE customers TO teams;
GRANT SELECT CREATE MODIFY USAGE PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE customers TO team;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE customers TO team;
q_zh: 一个新的数据工程团队被分配到一个ELT项目。新的数据工程团队需要对数据库customers拥有完全权限才能全面管理项目。以下哪个命令可用于向新数据工程团队授予对数据库的完全权限？
exp_zh: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE customers TO team; 授予所有权限。

q: A new data engineering team has been assigned to work on a project. The team will need access to database customers in order to see what tables already exist. The team has its own group team. Which of the following commands can be used to grant the necessary permission on the entire database to the new team?
opts: GRANT VIEW ON CATALOG customers TO team;
GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE customers TO team;
GRANT USAGE ON CATALOG team TO customers;
GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE team TO customers;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE customers TO team;
q_zh: 一个新的数据工程团队被分配到一个项目上工作。团队需要访问数据库customers，以查看已存在的表。团队有自己的组team。以下哪个命令可用于向新团队授予对整个数据库的必要权限？
exp_zh: USAGE权限允许查看数据库中的对象，但不允许修改。

q: A dataset has been defined using Delta Live Tables and includes an expectations clause: CONSTRAINT valid_timestamp EXPECT (timestamp > '2020-01-01') ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE. What is the expected behavior when a batch of data containing data that violates these constraints is processed?
opts: Records that violate the expectation are dropped from the target dataset and recorded as invalid in the event log.
Records that violate the expectation cause the job to fail.
Records that violate the expectation are dropped from the target dataset and loaded into a quarantine table.
Records that violate the expectation are added to the target dataset and recorded as invalid in the event log.
Records that violate the expectation are added to the target dataset and flagged as invalid in a field added to the target dataset.
q_zh: 一个数据集使用Delta Live Tables定义，并包含一个期望子句：CONSTRAINT valid_timestamp EXPECT (timestamp > '2020-01-01') ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE。当处理一批包含违反这些约束的数据时，预期行为是什么？
exp_zh: ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE会使作业在违反约束时失败。

q: A data engineer needs to use a Delta table as part of a data pipeline, but they do not know if they have the appropriate permissions. In which location can the data engineer review their permissions on the table?
opts: Jobs
Dashboards
Catalog Explorer
Repos
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要将 Delta 表用作数据管道的一部分，但不知道是否有适当的权限。数据工程师可以在哪个位置查看他们对表的权限？
exp_zh: 在 Databricks 中，Catalog Explorer（以前称为 Data Explorer）显示表的权限信息。

q: A data engineer is maintaining a data pipeline. Upon data ingestion, the data engineer notices that the source data is starting to have a lower level of quality. The data engineer would like to automate the process of monitoring the quality level. Which of the following tools can the data engineer use to solve this problem?
opts: Auto Loader
Unity Catalog
Delta Lake
Delta Live Tables
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在维护一个数据管道。在数据摄取时，数据工程师注意到源数据的质量开始下降。数据工程师希望自动化监控质量水平的过程。数据工程师可以使用以下哪个工具来解决此问题？
exp_zh: Delta Live Tables 提供了数据质量监控功能（Expectations），可以自动化监控数据质量。

q: A data engineer has three tables in a Delta Live Tables (DLT) pipeline. They have configured the pipeline to drop invalid records at each table. They notice that some data is being dropped due to quality concerns at some point in the DLT pipeline. They would like to determine at which table in their pipeline the data is being dropped. Which approach can the data engineer take to identify the table that is dropping the records?
opts: They can set up separate expectations for each table when developing their DLT pipeline.
They can navigate to the DLT pipeline page, click on the “Error” button, and review the present errors.
They can set up DLT to notify them via email when records are dropped.
They can navigate to the DLT pipeline page, click on each table, and view the data quality statistics.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师在 Delta Live Tables 管道中有三个表。他们配置了管道在每个表丢弃无效记录。他们注意到由于质量问题，在管道中的某个点有数据被丢弃。他们想确定管道中哪个表在丢弃记录。数据工程师可以使用哪种方法来识别丢弃记录的表？
exp_zh: 在 DLT 管道页面，点击每个表可以查看数据质量统计信息，包括丢弃的记录数。

q: A dataset has been defined using Delta Live Tables and includes an expectations clause: CONSTRAINT valid_timestamp EXPECT (timestamp > ‘2020-01-01’) ON VIOLATION DROP ROW. What is the expected behavior when a batch of data containing data that violates these constraints is processed?
opts: Records that violate the expectation cause the job to fail.
Records that violate the expectation are added to the target dataset and flagged as invalid in a field added to the target dataset.
Records that violate the expectation are dropped from the target dataset and recorded as invalid in the event log.
Records that violate the expectation are added to the target dataset and recorded as invalid in the event log.
q_zh: 一个数据集使用 Delta Live Tables 定义，并包含一个期望子句：CONSTRAINT valid_timestamp EXPECT (timestamp > '2020-01-01') ON VIOLATION DROP ROW。当处理一批包含违反这些约束的数据时，预期行为是什么？
exp_zh: ON VIOLATION DROP ROW 表示违反期望的行将被丢弃，并在事件日志中记录为无效。

q: A new data engineering team has been assigned to work on a project. The team will need access to database customers in order to see what tables already exist. The team has its own group team. Which command can be used to grant the necessary permission on the entire database to the new team?
opts: GRANT VIEW ON CATALOG customers TO team;
GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE customers TO team;
GRANT USAGE ON CATALOG team TO customers;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE customers TO team;
q_zh: 一个新的数据工程团队被分配到一个项目上工作。团队需要访问数据库 customers，以查看已存在的表。团队有自己的组 team。哪个命令可用于向新团队授予对整个数据库的必要权限？
exp_zh: USAGE 权限允许查看数据库中的对象。

q: A new data engineering team team has been assigned to an ELT project. The new data engineering team will need full privileges on the table sales to fully manage the project. Which command can be used to grant full permissions on the database to the new data engineering team?
opts: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE sales TO team;
GRANT SELECT CREATE MODIFY ON TABLE sales TO team;
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE sales TO team;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE team TO sales;
q_zh: 一个新的数据工程团队被分配到一个 ELT 项目。新的数据工程团队需要对表 sales 拥有完全权限才能全面管理项目。哪个命令可用于向新数据工程团队授予对表的完全权限？
exp_zh: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE sales TO team; 授予所有权限。

q: In a healthcare provider organization using Delta Lake to store electronic health records (EHRs), a data analyst needs to analyze a snapshot of the patient_records table from two weeks ago before some recent data corrections were applied. What approach should the Data Engineer take to allow the analyst to query that specific prior version?
opts: Truncate the table to remove all data, then reload the data from two weeks ago into the truncated table for the analyst to query.

Identify the version number corresponding to two weeks ago from the Delta transaction log, share that version number with the analyst to query using VERSION AS OF syntax, or export that version to a new Delta table for the analyst to query.
Restore the table to the version from two weeks ago using the RESTORE command, and have the analyst query the restored table.
Use the VACUUM command to remove all versions of the table older than two weeks, then the analyst can query the remaining version.
q_zh: 在一个使用 Delta Lake 存储电子健康记录（EHR）的医疗保健组织中，一位数据分析师需要分析两周前的 patient_records 表的快照，那时还没有应用最近的数据更正。数据工程师应该采取什么方法，让分析师能够查询那个特定的先前版本？
exp_zh: Delta Lake 的时间旅行功能允许使用 VERSION AS OF 或 TIMESTAMP AS OF 查询历史版本。

q: Identify the impact of ON VIOLATION DROP ROW and ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE for a constraint violation. A data engineer has created an ETL pipeline using Delta Live table to manage their company travel reimbursement detail, they want to ensure that if the location details has not been provided by the employee, the pipeline needs to be terminated. How can the scenario be implemented?
opts: CONSTRAINT valid_location EXPECT (location = NULL)
CONSTRAINT valid_location EXPECT (location != NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE
CONSTRAINT valid_location EXPECT (location != NULL) ON DROP ROW
CONSTRAINT valid_location EXPECT (location != NULL) ON VIOLATION FAIL
q_zh: 识别 ON VIOLATION DROP ROW 和 ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE 对约束违反的影响。一位数据工程师使用 Delta Live Table 创建了一个 ETL 管道来管理公司的旅行报销详情，他们希望确保如果员工未提供地点详情，管道需要终止。如何实现此场景？
exp_zh: 使用 ON VIOLATION FAIL UPDATE 会使管道在违反约束时失败。

q: Which two conditions are applicable for governance in Databricks Unity Catalog? (Choose two.)
opts: You can have more than 1 metastore within a databricks account console but only 1 per region.
Both catalog and schema must have a managed location in Unity Catalog provided metastore is not associated with a location
You can have multiple catalogs within metastore and 1 catalog can be associated with multiple metastore
If catalog is not associated with location, it’s mandatory to associate schema with managed locations
If metastore is not associated with location, it’s mandatory to associate catalog with managed locations
q_zh: 在 Databricks Unity Catalog 中，哪两个条件适用于治理？（选择两项）
exp_zh: 一个 Databricks 账户可以有多个 metastore，但每个区域只能有一个；如果 metastore 没有关联位置，则必须为 catalog 关联托管位置。

q: A data engineer needs to access the view created by the sales team, using a shared cluster. The data engineer has been provided usage permissions on the catalog and schema. In order to access the view created by sales team. What are the minimum permissions the data engineer would require in addition?
opts: Needs SELECT permission on the VIEW and the underlying TABLE.
Needs SELECT permission only on the VIEW
Needs ALL PRIVILEGES on the VIEW
Needs ALL PRIVILEGES at the SCHEMA level
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要使用共享集群访问销售团队创建的视图。数据工程师已被授予对catalog和schema的usage权限。为了访问销售团队创建的视图，数据工程师还需要哪些最低权限？
exp_zh: 访问视图只需要视图的SELECT权限，不需要底层表的权限。

q: The Delta transaction log for the 'students' tables is shown using the 'DESCRIBE HISTORY students' command. A Data Engineer needs to query the table as it existed before the UPDATE operation listed in the log. Which command should the Data Engineer use to achieve this? (Choose two.)
opts: SELECT * FROM students@v4
SELECT * FROM students TIMESTAMP AS OF '2024-04-22T14:32:47.000+00:00'
SELECT * FROM students FROM HISTORY VERSION AS OF 3
SELECT * FROM students VERSION AS OF 5
SELECT * FROM students TIMESTAMP AS OF '2024-04-22T14:32:58.000+00:00'
q_zh: 使用'DESCRIBE HISTORY students'命令显示了'students'表的Delta事务日志。一位数据工程师需要查询日志中列出的UPDATE操作之前的表。数据工程师应该使用哪个命令来实现？（选择两项）
exp_zh: 使用时间旅行语法，可以用版本或时间戳查询历史状态。根据日志，UPDATE操作在版本5，因此应使用版本4或更早的版本/时间戳。

q: A data engineer has realized that they made a mistake when making a daily update to a table. They need to use Delta time travel to restore the table to a version that is 3 days old. However, when the data engineer attempts to time travel to the older version, they are unable to restore the data because the data files have been deleted. How would the Date Engineer explain why the data files are no longer present?
opts: The VACUUM command was run on the table
The TIME TRAVEL command was run on the table
The DELETE HISTORY command was run on the table
The OPTIMIZE command was run on the table
q_zh: 一位数据工程师意识到在对表进行每日更新时犯了错误。他们需要使用Delta时间旅行将表恢复到3天前的版本。然而，当数据工程师尝试时间旅行到旧版本时，无法恢复数据，因为数据文件已被删除。数据工程师如何解释为什么数据文件不再存在？
exp_zh: VACUUM命令会删除不再被表引用的旧数据文件，阻止时间旅行到那些版本。

q: A data engineer needs access to a table new_table, but they do not have the correct permissions. They can ask the table owner for permission, but they do not know who the table owner is. Which approach can be used to identify the owner of new_table?
opts: Review the Permissions tab in the table's page in Data Explorer
There is no way to identify the owner of the table
Review the Owner field in the table's page in Data Explorer
Review the Owner field in the table's page in the cloud storage solution
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要访问表new_table，但没有正确的权限。他们可以向表所有者请求权限，但不知道表所有者是谁。哪种方法可用于识别new_table的所有者？
exp_zh: 在Data Explorer中，表的页面有Owner字段显示所有者。

q: A company uses Delta Sharing to collaborate with partners across different cloud providers and geographic regions. What will result in additional costs due to cross-region or egress fees?
opts: Sharing data within the same cloud provider and region
Transferring data via Delta Sharing across clouds and across different geographic regions
Accessing Delta Sharing data using a VPN within the same data center
Utilizing Delta Sharing for internal data analytics within a single cloud environment
q_zh: 一家公司使用Delta Sharing与不同云提供商和地理区域的合作伙伴协作。什么会导致因跨区域或出口费用而产生额外成本？
exp_zh: 跨云和跨地理区域的数据传输通常会产生出口费用。

q: An organization has data stored across multiple external systems, including MySQL, Amazon Redshift, and Google BigQuery. The data engineer wants to perform analytics without ingesting directly into Databricks, ensuring unified governance and minimizing data duplication. Which feature of Databricks enables querying these external data sources while maintaining centralized governance?
opts: Delta Lake
Lakehouse Federation
MLflow
Databricks Connect
q_zh: 一个组织的数据存储在多个外部系统中，包括MySQL、Amazon Redshift和Google BigQuery。数据工程师希望在不直接摄取到Databricks的情况下进行分析，确保统一治理并最小化数据重复。Databricks的哪个功能支持查询这些外部数据源，同时保持集中治理？
exp_zh: Lakehouse Federation允许查询外部数据源，而无需复制数据。

q: An organization needs to share a dataset stored in its Databricks Unity Catalog with an external partner who uses a different data platform that is not Databricks. The goal is to maintain data security and ensure the partner can access the data efficiently. Which method should the data engineer use to securely share the dataset with the external partner?
opts: Using Delta Sharing with the open sharing protocol
Exporting data as CSV files and emailing them
Using a third-party API to access the Delta table
Databricks-to-Databricks Sharing
q_zh: 一个组织需要将其存储在Databricks Unity Catalog中的数据集与使用不同数据平台（非Databricks）的外部合作伙伴共享。目标是维护数据安全，并确保合作伙伴能够高效访问数据。数据工程师应该使用哪种方法安全地与外部合作伙伴共享数据集？
exp_zh: Delta Sharing的开放共享协议允许与非Databricks平台安全共享数据。

q: A data engineer is reviewing the documentation on audit logs in Databricks for compliance purposes and needs to understand the format in which audit logs output events. How are events formatted in Databricks audit logs?
opts: In Databricks, audit logs output events in a JSON format.
In Databricks, audit logs output events in a CSV format.
In Databricks, audit logs output events in an XML format.
In Databricks, audit logs output events in a plain text format.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在审查Databricks中审计日志的文档以符合合规性要求，需要了解审计日志输出事件的格式。Databricks审计日志中的事件是如何格式化的？
exp_zh: Databricks审计日志以JSON格式输出事件。

q: A data engineer is managing a data pipeline in Databricks, where multiple Delta tables are used for various transformations. The team wants to track how data flows through the pipeline, including identifying dependencies between Delta tables, notebooks, jobs, and dashboards. The data engineer is utilizing the Unity Catalog lineage feature to monitor this process. How does Unity Catalog's data lineage feature support the visualization of relationships between Delta tables, notebooks, jobs, and dashboards?
opts: Unity Catalog lineage visualizes dependencies between Delta tables, notebooks, and jobs, but does not provide column-level tracing or relationships with dashboards.
Unity Catalog lineage only supports visualizing relationships at the table level and does not extend to notebooks, jobs, or dashboards.
Unity Catalog lineage provides an interactive graph that tracks dependencies between tables and notebooks but excludes any job-related dependencies or dashboard visualizations.

Unity Catalog provides an interactive graph that visualizes the dependencies between Delta tables, notebooks, jobs, and dashboards, while also supporting column-level tracking of data transformations.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在Databricks中管理一个数据管道，其中多个Delta表用于各种转换。团队希望跟踪数据如何流经管道，包括识别Delta表、笔记本、作业和仪表板之间的依赖关系。数据工程师正在利用Unity Catalog的沿袭功能来监控此过程。Unity Catalog的数据沿袭功能如何支持可视化Delta表、笔记本、作业和仪表板之间的关系？
exp_zh: Unity Catalog沿袭支持可视化表、笔记本、作业和仪表板之间的依赖关系，并提供列级跟踪。

q: A data engineer is configuring Unity Catalog in Databricks and needs to assign a role to a user who should have the ability to grant and revoke privileges on various data objects within a specific schema, but should not have read/write access over the schema or its objects. Which role should the data engineer assign to this user?
opts: Table Owner
Catalog Owner
Schema Owner
USE catalog/schema privilege on the schema
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在配置Databricks中的Unity Catalog，需要为用户分配一个角色，该用户应具有在特定schema内授予和撤销各种数据对象权限的能力，但不应具有对schema或其对象的读/写访问权限。数据工程师应该为此用户分配哪个角色？
exp_zh: Schema Owner可以管理schema内对象的权限，但不一定有读写数据的权限。

q: A company is collaborating with a partner that does not use Databricks but needs access to a large historical dataset stored in Delta format. The data engineer needs to ensure that the partner can access the data securely, without the need for them to set up an account, and with read-only access. How should the data be shared?
opts: Share the dataset by exporting it to a CSV file and manually transferring the file to the partner's system.
Grant your partner access to your Databricks workspace and assign them full write permissions to the Delta table, enabling them to modify the dataset.
Share the dataset using Unity Catalog, ensuring that both teams have full write access to the data within the same organization.
Share the dataset using Delta Sharing, which allows your partner to access the data using a secure, read-only URL without requiring a Databricks account, ensuring that they cannot modify the data.
q_zh: 一家公司正在与一个不使用Databricks的合作伙伴合作，但合作伙伴需要访问以Delta格式存储的大型历史数据集。数据工程师需要确保合作伙伴能够安全地访问数据，无需他们设置账户，且具有只读访问权限。应该如何共享数据？
exp_zh: Delta Sharing允许通过安全的只读URL共享数据，无需接收方拥有Databricks账户。

q: A data engineer at a company that uses Databricks with Unity Catalog needs to share a collection of tables with an external partner who also uses a Databricks workspace enabled for Unity Catalog. The data engineer decides to use Delta Sharing to accomplish this. What is the first piece of information the data engineer should request from the external partner to set up Delta Sharing?
opts: The IP address of their Databricks workspace
The name of their Databricks cluster
The sharing identifier of their Unity Catalog metastore
Their Databricks account password
q_zh: 一家使用 Databricks with Unity Catalog 公司的数据工程师需要与同样使用启用了 Unity Catalog 的 Databricks 工作区的外部合作伙伴共享一组表。数据工程师决定使用 Delta Sharing 来实现。数据工程师应该向外部合作伙伴请求的第一条信息是什么来设置 Delta Sharing？
exp_zh: 需要对方的 Unity Catalog metastore 的共享标识符来建立共享。

q: A data engineer needs to provide access to a group named manufacturing-team. The team needs privileges to create tables in the quality schema. Which set of SQL commands will grant a group named manufacturing-team to create tables in a schema named quality with the parent catalog named manufacturing with the least privileges?
opts: GRANT CREATE TABLE ON SCHEMA manufacturing.quality TO manufacturing-team; GRANT USE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA manufacturing.quality TO manufacturing-team; GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG manufacturing TO manufacturing-team;

GRANT USE TABLE ON SCHEMA manufacturing.quality TO manufacturing-team; GRANT USE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA manufacturing.quality TO manufacturing-team; GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG manufacturing TO manufacturing-team;

GRANT CREATE TABLE ON SCHEMA manufacturing.quality TO manufacturing-team; GRANT CREATE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA manufacturing.quality TO manufacturing-team; GRANT CREATE CATALOG ON CATALOG manufacturing TO manufacturing-team;

GRANT CREATE TABLE ON SCHEMA manufacturing.quality TO manufacturing-team; GRANT CREATE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA manufacturing.quality TO manufacturing-team; GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG manufacturing TO manufacturing-team;
q_zh: 一位数据工程师需要向名为 manufacturing-team 的组授予权限。该组需要在 quality schema 中创建表的权限。哪组 SQL 命令将以最低权限授予组 manufacturing-team 在名为 quality 的 schema（父 catalog 名为 manufacturing）中创建表的权限？
exp_zh: 最低权限包括：对 catalog 的 USE，对 schema 的 USE 和 CREATE TABLE。

q: A data engineer is configuring Delta Sharing for a multi-team project where teams from different departments will need to access shared data. The data engineer has successfully created a Unity Catalog metastore and is now setting up the Delta Share. The goal is to ensure that internal teams can access the shared data with full permissions, while external partners can only read the data. Which action should the Data Engineer take to configure the sharing correctly?
opts: Create a Delta Share, set up a secure access URL for internal teams and external partners, and distribute the URL to provide them access to the shared data.
Create a Delta Share, add the internal team's tables and views, and assign READ/WRITE permissions to both external partners and internal teams.
Assign READ permissions to external partners through the Delta Share and READ/WRITE permissions to internal teams, and ensure the correct tables and views are shared.
Grant READ permissions to external partners and READ/WRITE permissions to internal teams through the Delta Share.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在为多团队项目配置 Delta Sharing，不同部门的团队将需要访问共享数据。数据工程师已成功创建 Unity Catalog metastore，现在正在设置 Delta Share。目标是确保内部团队可以以完全权限访问共享数据，而外部合作伙伴只能读取数据。数据工程师应该采取哪项操作来正确配置共享？
exp_zh: 在 Delta Sharing 中，需要分别为不同接收方分配权限。内部团队应获得 READ/WRITE，外部合作伙伴应获得 READ。描述了正确的步骤。

q: A data engineer manages multiple external tables linked to various data sources. The data engineer wants to manage these external tables efficiently and ensure that only the necessary permissions are granted to users for accessing specific external tables. How should the data engineer manage access to these external tables?
opts: Set up Azure Blob Storage permissions at the container level, allowing access to all external tables.
Create a single user role with full access to all external tables and assign it to all users.
Grant permissions on the Databricks workspace level, which will automatically apply to all external tables.
Use Unity Catalog to manage access controls and permissions for each external table individually.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师管理着链接到各种数据源的多个外部表。数据工程师希望高效管理这些外部表，并确保只为用户授予访问特定外部表所需的权限。数据工程师应该如何管理对这些外部表的访问？
exp_zh: 使用 Unity Catalog 可以为每个外部表单独管理访问控制，实现细粒度权限。

q: An organization plans to share a large dataset stored in a Databricks workspace on AWS with a partner organization whose Databricks workspace is hosted on Azure. The data engineer wants to minimize data transfer costs while ensuring secure and efficient data sharing. Which strategy will reduce data egress costs associated with cross-cloud data sharing?
opts: Migrating the dataset to Cloudflare R2 object storage before sharing
Configure VPN connection between AWS and Azure for faster data sharing
Using Delta Sharing without any additional configurations
Sharing data via pre-signed URLs without monitoring egress costs
q_zh: 一个组织计划将其在 AWS 上的 Databricks 工作区中存储的大型数据集与合作伙伴组织共享，该合作伙伴的 Databricks 工作区托管在 Azure 上。数据工程师希望最小化数据传输成本，同时确保安全高效的数据共享。哪种策略将减少与跨云数据共享相关的数据出口成本？
exp_zh: Delta Sharing 原生支持跨云共享，无需复制数据，最小化出口费用。

q: A data engineer is setting up access control in Unity Catalog and needs to ensure that a group of data analysts can query tables but not modify data. Which permission should the data engineer grant to the data analysts?
opts: ALL PRIVILEGES
MODIFY
SELECT
INSERT
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在 Unity Catalog 中设置访问控制，需要确保一组数据分析师可以查询表但不能修改数据。数据工程师应该授予数据分析师哪种权限？
exp_zh: SELECT 权限允许查询数据，但不允许修改。

q: What Databricks feature can be used to check the data sources and tables used in a workspace?
opts: Use the lineage feature to visualize a graph that highlights where the table is used only in reports.
Use the lineage feature to visualize a graph that highlights where the table is used only in notebooks.
Use the lineage feature to visualize a graph that shows all dependencies, including where the table is used in notebooks, other tables, and reports.
Do not use the lineage feature as it only tracks activity from the last 3 months and will not provide full details on dependencies.
q_zh: 哪个 Databricks 功能可用于检查工作区中使用的数据源和表？
exp_zh: 沿袭功能可以可视化表在笔记本、其他表和报告中的所有依赖关系。

q: A data engineer is getting a partner organization up to speed with Databricks account. Both teams share some business use cases. The data engineer has to share some of your Unity-Catalog managed delta tables and the notebook jobs creating those tables with the partner organization. How can the data engineer seamlessly share the required information?
opts: Zip all the code and share via email, and allow data ingestion from your data lake
Share required datasets and notebooks via Delta Sharing. Manage permissions via Unity Catalog.
Data and Notebooks can be shared simply using Unity Catalog.
Share access to the codebase via Github and allow them to ingest datasets from your Data Lake.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在帮助合作伙伴组织熟悉 Databricks 账户。两个团队共享一些业务用例。数据工程师需要与合作伙伴组织共享一些 Unity Catalog 管理的 Delta 表和创建这些表的笔记本作业。数据工程师如何无缝共享所需信息？
exp_zh: 通过 Delta Sharing 共享数据集和笔记本，通过 Unity Catalog 管理权限。

q: Which Databricks feature can be used to check the data sources and tables used in a workspace?
opts: Use the lineage feature to visualize a graph that shows all dependencies, including where the table is used in notebooks, other tables, and reports.
Use the lineage feature to visualize a graph that highlights where the table is used only in reports.
Use the audit logs feature to review user activities, such as who queried or modified a table, instead of visualizing dependencies between data objects.
Use the lineage feature to visualize a graph that highlights where the table is used only in notebooks.
q_zh: 哪个 Databricks 功能可用于检查工作区中使用的数据源和表？
exp_zh: 沿袭功能提供端到端数据依赖关系的可视化图，显示数据源、表、笔记本以及下游消费者如报告。

q: A data engineer wants to delegate day-to-day permission management for the schema main marketing to the mkt-admins group, without making them workspace admins. They should be able to grant and revoke privileges for other users on objects within that schema. Which approach aligns with UC’s ownership and privilege model?
opts: Grant MANAGE permissions on the metastore to mkt-admins, which allows managing privileges for all schemas and tables globally.
Make mkt-admins a workspace-level admins group, then SELECT on main.marketing to allow privilege delegation.
Transfer ownership of the schema main.marketing to mkt-admins; owners can manage privileges on the schema and its contained objects.
Grant USE SCHEMA on main.marketing and MODIFY on all tables to mkt-admins, which enables managing grants within the schema.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师希望将模式 main.marketing 的日常权限管理委托给 mkt-admins 组，而不让他们成为工作区管理员。他们应该能够为其他用户授予和撤销该模式内对象的权限。哪种方法与 Unity Catalog 的所有权和权限模型一致？
exp_zh: 在 Unity Catalog 中，对象所有者拥有对该对象及其子对象的完全权限管理权。将模式的所有权转移给该组，允许它在不授予工作区级管理权限的情况下管理模式内的权限。

q: A data engineer is decommissioning a sandbox schema in Unity Catalog. Some tables are ephemeral staging outputs that can be safety removed entirely, but a few tables point at shared cloud storage used by downstream jobs outside Databricks. The engineer must avoid deleting any shared files when cleaning up catalog objects. How does Unity Catalog behave when dropping Managed vs External tables?
opts: DROP all tables; Databricks will only remove metadata for both managed and external tables.
DROP managed tables that are ephemeral and DROP external tables; files for both remain for 7 days.
DROP managed staging tables to remove data and metadata, and DROP external tables to remove only metadata
DROP external tables first to delete their files, then DROP managed tables to keep their files for recovery.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在停用 Unity Catalog 中的一个沙箱模式。一些表是临时的暂存输出，可以安全地完全移除，但少数表指向下游 Databricks 外部作业使用的共享云存储。工程师在清理目录对象时必须避免删除任何共享文件。Unity Catalog 在删除托管表与外部表时的行为是什么？
exp_zh: 在 Unity Catalog 中，删除托管表会同时删除元数据和底层数据文件，而删除外部表只会移除目录元数据，保留引用的云存储数据。

q: A data engineer is onboarding a new bronze ingestion pipeline in Databricks with Unity Catalog. The team wants Databricks to handle storage layout, apply platform optimizations over time, and simplify lifecycle management so that when a table is dropped, its underlying data is also cleaned up according to Databricks-managed retention policies. Which table type should the data engineer create for these ingestion tables?
opts: Managed tables so that Unity Catalog manages both metadata and underlying data lifecycle.
External tables with a LOCATION pointing to an external volume for full control of file layout.
Foreign tables federated from an external catalog to delegate optimization to the source system.
Temporary views over files to avoid table-level governance and lifecycle coupling.
q_zh: 一位数据工程师正在 Databricks 中与 Unity Catalog 一起 onboarding 一个新的青铜层摄取管道。团队希望 Databricks 处理存储布局，随时间应用平台优化，并简化生命周期管理，以便在删除表时，其底层数据也根据 Databricks 管理的保留策略被清理。数据工程师应该为这些摄取表创建哪种表类型？
exp_zh: 托管表允许 Unity Catalog 和 Databricks 同时管理元数据和底层数据生命周期，实现自动优化和删除时清理。
